projects.description: A股全栈数据工具包：行情K线·当日逐笔·研报·信号·资金面·新闻·财务·公告·打板·ETF期权·舆情·宏观利率·期货大宗(含大商所日K)·事件驱动·可转债 | 15层·87端点·34数据源·除iwencai外免Key | A-share data for AI agents: K-lines, ticks, reports, fund flow, news, financials, filings, options, macro, futures, events, convertibles | 15 layers·87 endpoints·34 sources
projects.summary: A 股數據工具包，可以攞 K 線、逐筆、公告、資金面同可轉債。作者話除 iwencai 外唔使 key。佢係行情庫，唔係券商，報價要你自己核。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An A-share data toolkit. It can fetch K-lines, tick trades, filings, fund flow, and convertible bonds. The author says every source except iwencai needs no key. It is a quote library, not a broker, and you should check the quotes. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: narrator-ai-cli-skill
projects.description: AI 解说大师 — Agent skill；封装 narrator-ai-cli 供 Claude/Codex 等工具调用
projects.summary: agent skill，教 coding agent 呼叫 narrator-ai-cli 做解說片。要另外裝個 CLI。片要用你有權用嘅素材。佢係技能，唔係新影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that teaches a coding agent to call narrator-ai-cli and make a narration video. You install that CLI separately. The footage has to be material you have the rights to use. It is a skill, not a new video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: DynamiCrafter
projects.description: [ECCV 2024, Oral] DynamiCrafter: Animating Open-domain Images with Video Diffusion Priors
projects.summary: 研究模型，用影片擴散先驗把一張開放領域嘅圖做成短片。ECCV 2024。權重要另外下載。2024 年後少更新。佢係影片模型本身。授權係 Apache-2.0。效果要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: A research model. It uses a video-diffusion prior to turn one open-domain image into a short clip. It was presented at ECCV 2024. You download the weights separately. It has had few updates since 2024. It is the video model itself. The license is Apache-2.0. Measure the result yourself.

projects.name: TripoSplat
projects.description: TripoSplat converts a single 2D image into high-quality and variable number of 3D Gaussians, developed by TripoAI.
projects.summary: 推理代碼，把一張圖轉成數量可變嘅 3D Gaussian，用嚟做資產。訓練代碼喺另一個 repo。權重要跟倉庫說明下載。佢係高斯濺射模型，唔係剪片軟件。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Inference code. One image becomes a variable number of 3D Gaussians you can use as an asset. The training code is in another repository. Download the weights as the repo explains. It is a Gaussian-splatting model, not an editor. The license is MIT.

projects.name: objaverse-xl
projects.description: 🪐 Objaverse-XL is a Universe of 10M+ 3D Objects. Contains API Scripts for Downloading and Processing!
projects.summary: 下載同處理腳本，對象超過一千萬個立體檔。代碼授權係 Apache-2.0。每個檔嘅使用權要你自己核，唔好當全部都可以商用。下載之前先睇來源。佢係資料集工具，唔係新嘅立體生成模型。
projects.summary_en: Scripts that download and process more than ten million 3D files. The code license is Apache-2.0. Check the rights for each file, and do not assume every file is free for commercial use. Read the source before you download. It is a dataset tool, not a new 3D generator.

projects.name: pandacode
projects.description: PandaCode: a calm desktop workspace for coding agents
projects.summary: 桌面工作區，用嚟開你已有嘅 coding CLI，例如 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot。佢係工作區，唔係新模型。PandaCode License 係 MIT，商用或公開發佈嘅 fork 要寫明 This is a fork of PandaCode，並連去呢個 repo。
projects.summary_en: A desktop workspace for coding CLIs you already have, such as Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot. It is a workspace, not a new model. The PandaCode License is the MIT License plus one rule: a fork used commercially or released publicly must say “This is a fork of PandaCode” and link this repository.

projects.name: mcd-saver-strategist
projects.description: 麦当劳省钱点餐助手（麦门精算师）｜麦当劳优惠券组合优化 Skill：拉取麦当劳菜单与全部可用优惠券，算出最省的点餐组合，巨无霸套餐 ¥47 → ¥21.9（省 53%）。McDonalds MCP（麦当劳 MCP）coupon optimizer · McDonalds China MCP Server · Agent Skill for WorkBuddy · 麦当劳程序员创意开发大赛参赛作品
projects.summary: 非官方嘅麥當勞中國優惠券組合 skill，係比賽作品，唔係麥當勞官方產品。佢經 MCP 攞菜單同優惠，計最平嘅合法組合，落單前要你確認。作者舉過 ¥47 變 ¥21.9，嗰個係佢當時嘅例子，唔係保證。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial McDonald's China coupon skill, entered in a contest. It is not an official McDonald's product. Through an MCP it reads the menu and coupons, finds the cheapest valid combination, and can place the order only after you confirm. The author's ¥47 to ¥21.9 example is their snapshot, not a guarantee. The license is MIT.

projects.name: talorys
projects.description: Your personal AI agent in your own Cloudflare account. Chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, deployed with one command: npx create-talorys@latest. Free-tier friendly, single-user, no telemetry.
projects.summary: 個人 agent，部署喺你自己嘅 Cloudflare 帳戶，一條 npx create-talorys@latest。單人用。傾偈用 Workers AI 嘅 glm-4.7-flash，有每日免費額。即使嗰個模型停咗，任務、筆記同提醒仍然行到。佢係殼，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A personal agent you deploy into your own Cloudflare account with npx create-talorys@latest. It is single-user. Chat uses Workers AI glm-4.7-flash, which has a free daily allocation. Tasks, notes, and reminders still run if that model is down. It is a shell, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ta-lib
projects.description: Technical analysis library: indicators and candlestick patterns, batch and streaming, native in C, Rust, Java, C#... and more
projects.summary: 技術分析庫，有指標同蠟燭形態，可以批量或者串流計。有 C、Rust、Java、C# 等。安裝說明喺 ta-lib.org/install。佢係指標庫，唔係券商，亦唔係自動交易程式。授權係 BSD-3-Clause。
projects.summary_en: A technical-analysis library with indicators and candlestick patterns, for batch and streaming use. Bindings include C, Rust, Java, and C#. Install notes are at ta-lib.org/install. It is an indicator library, not a broker and not an automated trading program. The license is BSD-3-Clause.

projects.name: algotrading
projects.description: Algorithmic trading framework for cryptocurrencies.
projects.summary: 加密貨幣嘅演算法交易框架，用 Python 寫。目錄放喺股票分類，佢做嘅係加密貨幣，唔係股票券商。有 quickstart。2026 年 1 月之後少更新。回測同實盤都唔代表賺到錢。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An algorithmic-trading framework for cryptocurrencies, written in Python. The catalog lists it under stocks, but it is for crypto, not a stock broker. It includes a quickstart. It has had few updates since January 2026. A backtest or a live run is not a profit. The license is MIT.

projects.name: EA31337
projects.description: 🤖📈 EA31337 Lite, Advanced and Rider - Forex multi-strategy trading robot for MT4/MT5 platforms
projects.summary: 外匯自動交易機械人，有 Lite、Advanced 同 Rider，行喺 MT4 同 MT5。目錄放喺加密貨幣分類，佢做嘅係外匯，唔係幣圈策略。2026 年 4 月之後少更新。跑到唔代表賺到。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A Forex trading robot with Lite, Advanced, and Rider builds, for MT4 and MT5. The catalog lists it under crypto, but it trades Forex, not a crypto strategy. It has had few updates since April 2026. Running it is not a profit. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: vue-lottie
projects.description: Render After Effects animations on Vue based on Bodymovin
projects.summary: Vue 播放器，用 Bodymovin 播 After Effects 匯出嘅動畫。你要自己出 JSON。同作者嘅 react-lottie 係另一個 repo。2022 年 12 月之後少更新。佢係播放器，唔係 After Effects。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Vue player. It uses Bodymovin to play animations exported from After Effects, and you supply the JSON. The same author's react-lottie is a different repository. It has had few updates since December 2022. It is a player, not After Effects. The license is MIT.

projects.name: Difix3D
projects.description: [CVPR 2025 Oral & Best Paper Finalist] Difix3D+: Improving 3D Reconstructions with Single-Step Diffusion Models
projects.summary: 研究模型，用單步擴散改善三維重建，包括 Gaussian。CVPR 2025 oral。權重喺 Hugging Face 嘅 nvidia/difix。2025 年 6 月之後少更新。佢係修復模型，唔係新嘅濺射訓練器。授權係 NVIDIA License。效果要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: A research model. Single-step diffusion improves a 3D reconstruction, including Gaussian splats. It was a CVPR 2025 oral. Weights are on Hugging Face as nvidia/difix. It has had few updates since June 2025. It is a repair model, not a new splatting trainer. The license is the NVIDIA License. Measure the result yourself.

projects.name: ib-gateway-docker
projects.description: Docker image with IB Gateway/TWS and IBC
projects.summary: Docker 映像，包住 Interactive Brokers 嘅 Gateway 或者 TWS，再加 IBC。目錄放喺加密貨幣分類，佢係券商閘道，用嚟連你自己嘅 IB 帳戶，唔係交易策略。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Docker image that packages the Interactive Brokers Gateway or TWS, plus IBC. The catalog lists it under crypto. It is a broker gateway for your own IB account, not a trading strategy. The license is MIT.

projects.name: FastGS
projects.description: [CVPR 2026 Highlight, the CVPR Compute Gold Star] Offical code for "FastGS: Training 3D Gaussian Splatting in 100 Seconds"
projects.summary: 3D Gaussian 訓練加速。作者話 Deep Blending 可以大約一百秒訓完，比 DashGaussian 快 3.32 倍、比原版快 15.45 倍。數字係作者嘅，要你自己量。預訓練權重喺 Hugging Face。佢係加速器，唔係新檢視器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A training accelerator for 3D Gaussian splatting. The author says Deep Blending can finish in about 100 seconds, 3.32 times faster than DashGaussian and 15.45 times faster than the original. Those figures are the author's, so measure them yourself. Pretrained weights are on Hugging Face. It is an accelerator, not a new viewer. The license is MIT.

projects.name: rakazo
projects.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative. Choose your own model and sandbox.
projects.summary: 自托管嘅常駐 agent，有網頁、桌面同手機版。模型同電腦你自己揀，亦可以全本地跑。而家係 beta。佢係 agent，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted persistent agent, on the web, desktop, and phone. You choose the model and the computer, or you can run the whole stack locally. It is in beta. It is an agent, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: shuohao-skills
projects.description: AI 短剧制作的 skill 集合：拆角色、排大纲、出场景与道具设定、写剧本、切分镜 | Agent skills for AI short-drama production — character bibles, adaptation outlines, art bibles, screenplays, storyboards. Runs in Claude Code & codex.
projects.summary: 七個 agent skill，用嚟做短劇前期：角色、大綱、美術設定、劇本同分鏡。任何讀到 SKILL.md 嘅 agent 都可以用，Claude Code 同 Codex 只係例子。片要另用現成工具出。佢係技能，唔係影片模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: Seven agent skills for the early work of a short drama: characters, an outline, an art bible, a screenplay, and storyboards. Any agent that can read SKILL.md can use them. Claude Code and Codex are only examples. The video comes from a separate existing tool. It is a skill pack, not a video model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: Easel
projects.description: An open-source AI agent for social media — discover trends, create content, publish everywhere, and learn what works across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Zhihu, Bilibili, and more.🎨一个开源的 AI 社交媒体智能体——发现热点趋势、创作内容、一键发布至各大平台，并学习分析哪些内容真正有效，覆盖小红书、抖音、知乎、哔哩哔哩等平台。
projects.summary: 社媒內容工作台，建喺 OpenClaw 上面。可以搵熱點、寫稿，再按你需要發去小紅書、抖音、知乎、B 站。帳戶係你自己嘅。佢係 agent，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A social-media workbench built on OpenClaw. It can find trends, draft posts, and publish to Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Zhihu, and Bilibili when you ask. The accounts are yours. It is an agent, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: Imagination-Studio-by-keys-Wasserman
projects.description: Imagination Studio by keys+Wasserman powered by TensorFold: an AI film studio for Mac and NVIDIA DGX Spark. Plan a film like a crew (Slate workflow by Sam Wasserman), render Qwen-Image-2.1 / FLUX3-K pictures and MiniMax H3 / FastH3 video with sound on TensorFold.
projects.summary: 本地電影工作室，喺你部 Mac 或者 NVIDIA 機度，用現成模型出圖同有聲影片。核心安裝大約要 125 GB。佢係工作室，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。效果要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: A local film studio. On your Mac or NVIDIA machine it uses existing models for pictures and video with sound. The core install needs about 125 GB. It is a studio, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0. Measure the result yourself.

projects.name: tvscreener
projects.description: TradingView Screener API - Stock, Crypto, Forex, Bond, Futures, Coin
projects.summary: 非官方 Python 庫，用嚟向 TradingView 篩選器攞表格。同 TradingView 無關，用咗要守佢哋條款。目錄放喺股票，佢亦涵蓋加密貨幣、外匯同期貨。佢係數據客戶端，唔係券商。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial Python library that pulls tables from the TradingView screener. It is not affiliated with TradingView, and use has to follow their terms. The catalog lists it under stocks, and it also covers crypto, forex, and futures. It is a data client, not a broker. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: open-trading-api
projects.description: Korea Investment & Securities Open API Github
projects.summary: 韓國投資證券嘅官方樣本代碼，用嚟接佢哋嘅 Open API。要你自己嘅帳戶。有策略設計同回測，回測唔代表賺到。GitHub 冇標 SPDX 授權。目錄放喺股票分類。
projects.summary_en: Official sample code from Korea Investment & Securities for their Open API. You need your own account. It includes strategy design and a backtest, and a backtest is not a profit. GitHub does not mark an SPDX license. The catalog lists it under stocks.

projects.name: cryptocurrency-arbitrage
projects.description: A cryptocurrency arbitrage opportunity calculator. Over 800 currencies and 50 markets.
projects.summary: 呢個公開版只係加密貨幣價差計算機，覆蓋好多個市場。作者話交易機械人留喺私人代碼，2022 年 5 月之後少有更新。睇到價差唔代表賺到錢。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: The public version is a calculator for crypto price gaps across many markets. The author said the trading bot stayed in private code. It has had few updates since May 2022. Seeing a gap is not a profit. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: react-useanimations
projects.description: React-useanimations is a collection of free animated open source icons for React.js.
projects.summary: React 圖示元件，大約三百個會郁嘅圖示，播放器內置，亦可以播你自己嘅 Lottie。你要自己放入介面。佢係圖示庫，唔係 After Effects。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A React icon component with about 300 animated icons. The player is built in, and it can also play your own Lottie file. You place it in the interface yourself. It is an icon library, not After Effects. The license is MIT.

projects.name: 3dgs-render-blender-addon
projects.description: 3DGS Render by KIRI Engine
projects.summary: Blender 擴充，用嚟匯入、修改同渲染 3D Gaussian。要你自己開住 Blender。部分功能係實驗性，先備份。而家轉做社群維護。佢係擴充，唔係新訓練器。授權係 GPL-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A Blender add-on for importing, editing, and rendering 3D Gaussians. You have to open Blender yourself. Some features are experimental, so back up first. Maintenance is moving to the community. It is an add-on, not a new trainer. The license is GPL-2.0.

projects.name: BitVision
projects.description: Trade Bitcoin and run forecasting models from the terminal
projects.summary: 終端機面板，睇 Bitstamp 嘅比特幣圖，亦可以開自動交易。要你自己嘅帳戶，鑰匙留喺本機。作者話仲係 alpha，有 bug。預測唔代表賺到。2022 年 12 月之後少更新。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A terminal dashboard for Bitcoin charts on Bitstamp. You can also turn on automated trading. You need your own account, and the keys stay on your machine. The author says it is still alpha and has bugs. A forecast is not a profit. It has had few updates since December 2022. The license is MIT.

projects.name: HunyuanWorld-Mirror
projects.description: [ICML 2026] WorldMirror: Fast and Universal 3D reconstruction model for versatile tasks
projects.summary: 前向三維重建模型，一次過出點雲、深度、相機、法線同 3D Gaussian。ICML 2026。權重喺 Hugging Face。同目錄嘅 HunyuanWorld-1.0、Voyager 唔同。騰訊社區協議：歐盟、英國、南韓唔適用，月活過一百萬要書面批准。
projects.summary_en: A feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. One pass can emit a point cloud, depth, cameras, normals, and 3D Gaussians. It was accepted to ICML 2026. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is different from HunyuanWorld-1.0 and Voyager already in the catalog. The Tencent community license does not apply in the EU, the UK, or South Korea, and more than one million monthly active users needs written approval.

projects.name: fast-gaussian-rasterization
projects.description: A geometry-shader-based, global CUDA sorted high-performance 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizer. Can achieve a 5-10x speedup in rendering compared to the vanialla diff-gaussian-rasterization.
projects.summary: 3D Gaussian 渲染器，可以換走 diff-gaussian-rasterization 嘅繪製。作者話有時快 5 到 10 倍，密點雲未必更快，而且未有反向。2025 年 2 月之後少更新。數字要你自己量。佢係渲染器，唔係新訓練器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A 3D Gaussian renderer that can replace the draw path in diff-gaussian-rasterization. The author says it is sometimes 5 to 10 times faster. Dense clouds may not be faster, and there is no backward pass. It has had few updates since February 2025. Measure the numbers yourself. It is a renderer, not a new trainer. The license is MIT.

projects.name: mesh-avatar-studio
projects.description: Turn one illustration into an animated 2D mesh avatar with a coding agent and a local editor
projects.summary: 本地工作室，用一張圖做成會眨眼、講嘢、轉頭嘅二維 mesh 頭像。Claude Code 或 Codex 先按指南砌，你再喺編輯器改。要 Node.js 22.17 或更新。佢係編輯器，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A local studio. One picture becomes a 2D mesh avatar that blinks, talks, and turns its head. Claude Code or Codex rigs it from the guide, then you edit it. It needs Node.js 22.17 or newer. It is an editor, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: git-ai
projects.description: Git designed for AI agents. Open-source, in the spirit of Anthropic's Scion and OpenAI's Pando. Not affiliated with either.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅版本控制，獨立實作一個公開設計，同 Anthropic 無關。伺服器唔會呼叫語言模型。底下仍然係普通 Git 倉庫。主體授權係 MIT。佢係版本控制，唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: Version control for a coding agent. It is an independent implementation of a publicly described design, and it is not affiliated with Anthropic. The server does not call a language model. Underneath it is still a normal Git repository. The main license is MIT. It is version control, not a new model.

projects.name: scroll-craft
projects.description: An agent skill for building premium, immersive, scroll-driven websites. Works with Codex, Claude Code, and other coding agents. Also available as a Claude Code plugin.
projects.summary: agent skill，用嚟做沉浸式滾動網站。Codex、Claude Code 或者其他識改檔同開瀏覽器嘅 agent 都可以用，亦有 Claude Code 插件。佢係技能，唔係網站產生器，亦唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill for immersive scrolling websites. Codex, Claude Code, or another agent that can edit files and open a browser can use it. It also ships as a Claude Code plugin. It is a skill, not a website generator and not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: OSkhQuant
projects.description: 看海量化回测平台 khQuant 开源版 V2.2：免费开源的 A 股量化回测桌面软件。不用开户、不用装 QMT，BaoStock / Tushare 下载数据到本地 DuckDB，Python 写策略，一键出回测报告。
projects.summary: A 股回測桌面軟件，唔使開戶，亦唔使裝 QMT。行情由 BaoStock 或 Tushare 落去本機 DuckDB，策略用 Python 寫。只支援 Windows。回測唔代表賺到。授權係 CC BY-NC 4.0，唔可以商用。
projects.summary_en: A desktop backtester for A-shares. You do not need a brokerage account or QMT. Quotes come from BaoStock or Tushare into a local DuckDB, and strategies are written in Python. It only supports Windows. A backtest is not a profit. The license is CC BY-NC 4.0, so commercial use is not allowed.

projects.name: alpaca-py
projects.description: The Official Python SDK for Alpaca API
projects.summary: Alpaca 官方 Python SDK，用嚟接佢哋嘅行情同交易介面。要你自己嘅帳戶同 key。佢係 SDK，唔係交易策略，亦唔保證賺。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: The official Python SDK for Alpaca. It connects to their market-data and trading interfaces. You need your own account and key. It is an SDK, not a trading strategy, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: node-binance-trader
projects.description: 💰 Cryptocurrency Trading Strategy & Portfolio Management Development Framework for Binance. 🤖
projects.summary: Binance 嘅策略同組合框架。README 話原網站已停，項目唔再維護，2024 年 8 月之後少更新。同目錄嘅 node-binance-api 唔同。要你自己嘅帳戶。框架唔代表賺到。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A strategy and portfolio framework for Binance. The README says the original site has shut down and the project is no longer maintained. It has had few updates since August 2024. It is different from node-binance-api in the catalog. You need your own account. A framework is not a profit. The license is MIT.

projects.name: LottieXamarin
projects.description: Render After Effects animations natively on Android, iOS, MacOS and TvOS for Xamarin
projects.summary: Xamarin 播放器，用 Bodymovin 喺 Android、iOS、Mac 同 tvOS 播 After Effects 匯出嘅 JSON。你要自己出檔。2024 年 4 月之後少更新。佢係播放器，唔係 After Effects。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A Xamarin player. It uses Bodymovin to play JSON exported from After Effects on Android, iOS, Mac, and tvOS. You supply the file. It has had few updates since April 2024. It is a player, not After Effects. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: GaussianObject
projects.description: GaussianObject: High-Quality 3D Object Reconstruction from Four Views with Gaussian Splatting (SIGGRAPH Asia 2024, TOG)
projects.summary: 研究框架，用四張圖重建物件嘅 3D Gaussian，可以唔靠 COLMAP。SIGGRAPH Asia 2024。修復步驟用擴散模型。2024 年 9 月之後少更新。repo 冇附開源授權檔。佢係重建方法，唔係檢視器。
projects.summary_en: A research framework. Four images become a 3D Gaussian of an object, and it can skip COLMAP. It was presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2024. A diffusion model repairs missing detail. It has had few updates since September 2024. The repository includes no open-source license file. It is a reconstruction method, not a viewer.

projects.name: Gaussian-SLAM
projects.description: Gaussian-SLAM: Photo-realistic Dense SLAM with Gaussian Splatting
projects.summary: 研究系統，用 RGB-D 做寫實密集 SLAM，場景以 3D Gaussian 表示。作者喺 RTX 3090 同 A6000 試過。2024 年 7 月之後少更新。佢係 SLAM，唔係新檢視器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A research system. It does photorealistic dense SLAM from RGB-D, and the scene is a set of 3D Gaussians. The authors tested it on an RTX 3090 and an A6000. It has had few updates since July 2024. It is a SLAM system, not a new viewer. The license is MIT.

projects.name: VGGT-SLAM
projects.description: VGGT-SLAM: Dense RGB SLAM Optimized on the SL(4) Manifold
projects.summary: 密集 RGB SLAM，用現成 VGGT 做前向重建。呢個 repo 授權係 BSD-2-Clause。SAM 3 同 Perception Encoder 係可選，授權各自唔同。同目錄嘅 VGGT、VGGT Omega 唔同。佢係 SLAM，唔係新幾何模型。
projects.summary_en: Dense RGB SLAM that uses the existing VGGT model for feed-forward reconstruction. This repository is BSD-2-Clause. SAM 3 and Perception Encoder are optional, and each has its own license. It is different from VGGT and VGGT Omega already in the catalog. It is a SLAM system, not a new geometry model.

projects.name: RynnVLA-002
projects.description: RynnVLA-002: A Unified Vision-Language-Action and World Model
projects.summary: 研究模型，將動作模型同世界模型放喺一個框架。世界模型按動作預測下一幀。權重喺 Hugging Face。作者話 LIBERO 成功率 97.4%，要你自己量。README 標 Apache-2.0，根目錄冇 LICENSE 檔。
projects.summary_en: A research model that puts an action model and a world model in one framework. The world model predicts the next frame from an action. Weights are on Hugging Face. The authors report a 97.4% success rate on LIBERO, so measure it yourself. The README says Apache-2.0, and the repository root has no LICENSE file.

projects.name: lieflat-charts
projects.description: Data visualization Skill for AI Agents, turning data into polished, interactive HTML charts. 面向 AI Agents 的数据可视化 Skill，将数据快速生成精致、可交互的 HTML 图表。
projects.summary: agent skill，用嚟出互動 HTML 圖表，預設係圖，你明確要求先至出 PPT 或整頁報告。moxt、Claude Code、Codex 等讀到 SKILL.md 嘅 agent 可以用。佢係技能，唔係新模型。授權係 PolyForm Noncommercial，唔可以商用。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill for interactive HTML charts. Charts are the default, and a PPT or a full-page report appears only when you ask for one. moxt, Claude Code, Codex, and other agents that read SKILL.md can use it. It is a skill, not a new model. The license is PolyForm Noncommercial, so commercial use is not allowed.

projects.name: Tracely-ai
projects.description: Trace-native CI/CD for AI agents: grade production traces, cluster failures, freeze them into replayable regression tests, and block PRs that regress. Self-hostable.
projects.summary: 自托管嘅 agent CI。生產 trace 入嚟會評分，失敗例子凍結成可以重播嘅回歸測試，退步可以擋 pull request。另有技能教 agent 用佢。佢係測試閘，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted CI for agents. Production traces are graded, failed runs are frozen into replayable regression tests, and a regression can block a pull request. A separate skill teaches an agent how to use it. It is a test gate, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: lcu
projects.description: Codex computer use, decoupled from the app, for usage inside any harness.
projects.summary: Codex 電腦操作嘅執行層，拆出嚟畀其他 harness 用。要本機裝住官方 ChatGPT 桌面 app。控制 app 之前要你批准。佢係執行層，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: The Codex computer-use runtime, split out for other harnesses. The official ChatGPT desktop app has to be installed on your machine. You approve an app before it is controlled. It is a runtime, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: drama-skills
projects.description: AI 短剧与漫剧制作 skill 合集：小说改剧本、角色设定三视图、分镜脚本、生图/生视频提示词与成片审片，适配 Claude Code / Codex 等 ｜ Open-source agent skills for AI short dramas & motion comics
projects.summary: 十一個 agent skill，由點子或原著去到分集劇本、分鏡同圖片影片提示詞。片要用現成模型出。同目錄嘅 shuohao-skills 唔同。佢係技能，唔係影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Eleven agent skills. An idea or a source text becomes episode scripts, storyboards, and image and video prompts. The footage comes from existing models. This is a different repository from shuohao-skills. It is a skill pack, not a video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: optopsy
projects.description: A nimble options research and backtesting library for Python
projects.summary: 呢個期權回測同統計庫，內置三十八種策略。你要自己準備行情。回測唔代表賺到錢。另有一個 MCP repo，唔係呢個套件。佢係庫，唔係券商。授權係 AGPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: An options backtesting and statistics library with thirty-eight built-in strategies. You supply the quotes. A backtest is not a profit. The MCP server is a different repository, not this package. It is a library, not a broker. The license is AGPL-3.0.

projects.name: giga-world-1
projects.description: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
projects.summary: 機械人世界模型嘅訓練同推理代碼，用嚟評估策略。權重喺 Hugging Face 嘅 open-gigaai/Giga-World-1。佢係世界模型，唔係聊天機械人。授權係 Apache-2.0。效果要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: Training and inference code for a robot world model, used to evaluate a policy. Weights are on Hugging Face as open-gigaai/Giga-World-1. It is a world model, not a chatbot. The license is Apache-2.0. Measure the result yourself.

projects.name: aholo-viewer
projects.description: A high performance 3DGS renderer
projects.summary: 高效 3DGS 同 mesh 渲染器，用分塊串流 LOD 睇大型場景。要 Node.js 22.22.1 或更新。附一個整合 skill，但主體係渲染器，唔係訓練器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A high-performance renderer for 3D Gaussian splats and meshes. Chunked streaming LOD is how it shows a large scene. It needs Node.js 22.22.1 or newer. An integration skill is included, but the product is the renderer, not a trainer. The license is MIT.

projects.name: motion-skills
projects.description: 50 open-source skills that teach your AI coding agent to make motion graphics, animation & video — kinetic typography, data-viz, explainers, TikTok/Reels, WebGL, Manim. 14 installable packs. By iart.ai, the AI motion agent.
projects.summary: 五十六個 agent skill，分成十九個包，教 coding agent 做動態圖形、動畫同短片。你用自己嘅 agent 出片。佢係技能，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係新影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Fifty-six agent skills in nineteen packs. They teach a coding agent to make motion graphics, animation, and short video. You render with the agent you already use. It is a skill pack, not After Effects and not a new video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: AnimatableGaussians
projects.description: Code of [CVPR 2024] "Animatable Gaussians: Learning Pose-dependent Gaussian Maps for High-fidelity Human Avatar Modeling"
projects.summary: 研究代碼，由影片學一個可動畫嘅人體，姿態對應 3D Gaussian。CVPR 2024。清華授權只限非商業研究、教育同藝術，商用要另外申請。2024 年 11 月之後少更新。佢係化身模型，唔係檢視器。
projects.summary_en: Research code. Video is used to learn an animatable human body, with pose mapped to 3D Gaussians. It was presented at CVPR 2024. The Tsinghua license allows only non-commercial research, education, and art, and commercial use needs a separate grant. It has had few updates since November 2024. It is an avatar model, not a viewer.

projects.name: T3Bench
projects.description: T3Bench: Benchmarking Current Progress in Text-to-3D Generation
projects.summary: 文字到三維嘅基準，一共三百條提示，用現成方法出結果再評質量同對齊。2023 年 10 月之後少有更新。repo 冇附開源授權檔。佢係基準，唔係新嘅三維生成模型。
projects.summary_en: A text-to-3D benchmark with three hundred prompts. Existing methods produce the results, which are then scored for quality and alignment. It has had few updates since October 2023. The repository includes no open-source license file. It is a benchmark, not a new 3D generator.

projects.name: Multi-Agent-CAD
projects.description: MAC (Multi-Agent CAD): A decoupled multi-agent framework for text-to-CAD generation via constrained test-time compute
projects.summary: 多 agent 框架，把一句設計說明變成可編輯 CAD，輸出 STEP、STL 或 GLB。組件組裝仲係實驗，落機前要你自己核。要 Python 3.11 或更新。佢係 CAD 生成，唔係相片轉 mesh。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent framework. A design brief becomes editable CAD, exported as STEP, STL, or GLB. Assembly generation is still experimental, so check it before you manufacture. It needs Python 3.11 or newer. It generates CAD, not a mesh from a photo. The license is MIT.

projects.name: skill-recorder
projects.description: Desktop app that records your on-screen work session and uses the GitHub Copilot SDK to reconstruct it as an intent + ordered steps, then builds a reusable Skill or Automation for Microsoft Autopilots like Scout, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, or Copilot Studio.
projects.summary: 桌面 app，錄低你喺螢幕做嘅一次工序，再用 GitHub Copilot CLI 整理成意圖同步驟。你核准之後先變成 SKILL.md 或者排程自動化。要 Copilot。佢係錄製器，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A desktop app. It records one task you do on your screen, then GitHub Copilot CLI turns that into an intent and ordered steps. A SKILL.md or a scheduled automation is saved only after you approve it. You need Copilot. It is a recorder, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: thinkrail
projects.description: ThinkRail is the agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it
projects.summary: JetBrains 孵化嘅輕量 IDE，包住 pi coding agent。工作用 git worktree 隔開。佢可以記住專案同重用技能，但係 IDE，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight IDE from the JetBrains incubator, built around the pi coding agent. Work is isolated in git worktrees. It can remember a project and reuse skills, but it is an IDE, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: linkedin-agent-skill
projects.description: Eleven free Claude skills that run a LinkedIn account: posts off 21 hook formulas, comments, replies, profile score, weekly plan, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint and scores the draft before it goes out.
projects.summary: 十一個 Claude skill，幫你起草 LinkedIn 帖文、留言、回覆、檔案評分同每週計劃。未得你同意唔會發佈。humanizer 只係改走模板腔。佢係技能，唔係 LinkedIn，亦唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Eleven Claude skills. They draft LinkedIn posts, comments, replies, a profile score, and a weekly plan. Nothing is posted until you agree. The humanizer only rewrites template-sounding copy. It is a skill pack, not LinkedIn and not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: 3DTopia-XL
projects.description: [CVPR 2025 Highlight] 3DTopia-XL: High-Quality 3D PBR Asset Generation via Primitive Diffusion
projects.summary: 研究模型，由一張圖或文字生成帶 PBR 材質嘅三維資產。CVPR 2025 highlight。權重喺 Hugging Face 嘅 FrozenBurning/3DTopia-XL。同目錄嘅 LGM、OpenLRM 唔同。2025 年 7 月之後少更新。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A research model. One image or a text prompt becomes a 3D asset with PBR materials. It was a CVPR 2025 highlight. Weights are on Hugging Face as FrozenBurning/3DTopia-XL. It is different from LGM and OpenLRM already in the catalog. It has had few updates since July 2025. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: image-to-3dlab
projects.description: AssetFurnace: the most complete open-source image-to-3D pipeline (Oct 2026). Prompt or picture → textured, rigged, animated game character, locally on Apple Silicon or NVIDIA. Pixal3D, TRELLIS.2, Hunyuan3D, SF3D, auto-rig and 21 moves. For indie game devs and 3D artists. Free, Apache-2.0.
projects.summary: 本地流水線，用現成模型把一句提示或一張圖做成已綁骨、有材質嘅遊戲角色。支援 Apple Silicon 同 NVIDIA。每個模型嘅授權要你自己核。佢係流水線，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A local pipeline. Existing models turn a prompt or one picture into a textured, rigged game character. It runs on Apple Silicon or NVIDIA. Check the license of each model yourself. It is a pipeline, not a new model. The license of this repository is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: lottie-converter
projects.description: Converts Lottie Animations (.json / .lottie) and Telegram stickers (*.tgs) to GIF / PNG / APNG / WEBP / WEBM
projects.summary: 轉換器，把 Lottie JSON、.lottie 同 Telegram 嘅 TGS 轉成 GIF、PNG、APNG、WEBP 或 WEBM。你要自己出原檔。佢係轉換器，唔係 After Effects。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A converter. It turns Lottie JSON, .lottie files, and Telegram TGS stickers into GIF, PNG, APNG, WEBP, or WEBM. You supply the source file. It is a converter, not After Effects. The license is MIT.

projects.name: react-native-skottie
projects.description: ▶️ Efficient lottie animations using Skia's Skottie module
projects.summary: React Native 播放器，用 Skia 嘅 Skottie 播 Lottie。要先裝 react-native-skia。作者話低階 Android 快啲，數字要你自己量。2025 年 1 月後少更新。佢係播放器，唔係 After Effects。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A React Native player. It uses Skia's Skottie module to play Lottie. Install react-native-skia first. The author says it is faster on a low-end Android phone, so measure that yourself. It has had few updates since January 2025. It is a player, not After Effects. The license is MIT.

projects.name: BlenderNeRF
projects.description: Easy NeRF synthetic dataset creation within Blender
projects.summary: Blender 擴充，一掣匯出畫面同相機，用嚟做 NeRF 或 Gaussian Splatting 嘅合成數據。要 Blender 4.0 或更新。2024 年 12 月之後少更新。佢係數據工具，唔係訓練器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Blender add-on. One click exports images and cameras for a synthetic NeRF or Gaussian-splatting dataset. It needs Blender 4.0 or newer. It has had few updates since December 2024. It is a dataset tool, not a trainer. The license is MIT.

projects.name: threepp
projects.description: A cross-platform C++20 3D library with Python bindings and the high-level API of three.js.
projects.summary: C++20 三維庫，API 跟 three.js，有 OpenGL 同 Vulkan 兩條後端，亦有 Python 綁定。目錄放喺 Gaussian Splatting，佢係通用場景庫，唔係濺射訓練器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A C++20 3D library. The API follows three.js, with OpenGL and Vulkan backends and Python bindings. The catalog lists it under Gaussian splatting, but it is a general scene library, not a splatting trainer. The license is MIT.

projects.name: Evoke
projects.description: Official implementation of EVOKE: Endless Interactive World with Bounded State and Long-Horizon Supervision. A three-step, CFG-free interactive world model. SOTA   on WBench.
projects.summary: 互動世界模型，三步、唔使用 CFG。作者話單張 H200 大約 2.11 秒出 1.5 秒片，WBench 數字係佢報嘅，要你自己量。2026 年 9 月之後少更新。佢係世界模型本身。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An interactive world model. It uses three steps and does not use CFG. The author says one H200 produces about 1.5 seconds of video in 2.11 seconds, and the WBench figure is theirs, so measure it yourself. It has had few updates since September 2026. It is the world model itself. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: sepia
projects.description: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
projects.summary: agent skill，用嚟改寫。小說先修敘事結構，文件就跟場合改。有寫、審、小改同重寫四種。任何讀到 SKILL.md 嘅 agent 都可以用。佢係技能，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill for rewriting. Fiction gets its narrative structure repaired first, and documents follow rules for their setting. The four operations are write, review, a small edit, and a full rewrite. Any agent that can read SKILL.md can use it. It is a skill, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: cumora
projects.description: Where agent teams gather. Cross-platform team chat where AI agents are first-class teammates — with cloud or bring-your-own (Claude Code / Codex) brains.
projects.summary: 團隊聊天，agent 同人一齊喺群組、私訊同看板。雲端用 OpenAI 介面，或者你自己部機跑 Claude Code、Codex 等。伺服器睇唔到你嘅供應商鑰匙。佢係聊天殼，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Team chat. Agents and people share groups, direct messages, and a board. The cloud path uses the OpenAI interface, or you run Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools on your own machine. The server does not see your provider keys. It is a chat shell, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: StreamVGGT
projects.description: [ICLR 2026] Streaming 4D Visual Geometry Transformer
projects.summary: 串流四維幾何模型，新圖入嚟用快取記憶，唔使整段重算。ICLR 2026。權重喺 Hugging Face。同目錄嘅 VGGT 唔同。授權係 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，唔可以商用，改作要同授權分享。2025 年 10 月後少更新。
projects.summary_en: A streaming 4D geometry model. A new image uses cached memory, so the whole clip is not recomputed. It was accepted to ICLR 2026. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is different from VGGT already in the catalog. The license is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: no commercial use, and adaptations stay under the same license. It has had few updates since October 2025.

projects.name: lottie-react
projects.description: Lottie animations in React: one component for the easy path, the whole engine when you need control.
projects.summary: React 播放器，包住 lottie-web 播 JSON。要 React 18.2 或更新。同目錄嘅 lottie-react-native 唔同，呢個係網頁。你要自己出動畫。佢係播放器，唔係 After Effects。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A React player. It wraps lottie-web and plays a JSON file. It needs React 18.2 or newer. It is different from lottie-react-native in the catalog: this one is for the web. You supply the animation. It is a player, not After Effects. The license is MIT.

projects.name: MIDI-3D
projects.description: [CVPR 2025] MIDI: Multi-Instance Diffusion for Single Image to 3D Scene Generation
projects.summary: 研究模型，一張圖同時生成多個三維物件同佢哋嘅位置。CVPR 2025。權重喺 Hugging Face 嘅 VAST-AI/MIDI-3D。同目錄嘅 TripoSplat 唔同。2025 年 6 月後少更新。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A research model. One image generates several 3D objects and their positions at the same time. It was presented at CVPR 2025. Weights are on Hugging Face as VAST-AI/MIDI-3D. It is different from TripoSplat already in the catalog. It has had few updates since June 2025. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: TriplaneGaussian
projects.description: TriplaneGaussian: A new hybrid representation for single-view 3D reconstruction.
projects.summary: 研究模型，一張圖幾秒內重建成 3D Gaussian。權重喺 Hugging Face 嘅 VAST-AI/TriplaneGaussian。作者話大約一秒，要你自己量。2024 年 3 月後少更新。佢係重建模型，唔係檢視器。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A research model. One image becomes 3D Gaussians in a few seconds. Weights are on Hugging Face as VAST-AI/TriplaneGaussian. The author says about one second, so measure it yourself. It has had few updates since March 2024. It is a reconstruction model, not a viewer. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: MaterialDialog-Android
projects.description: 📱Android Library to implement animated, 😍beautiful, 🎨stylish Material Dialog in android apps easily.
projects.summary: Android 對話框庫，可以播 Lottie 動畫。動畫要你自己用 After Effects 出。2022 年 1 月後少更新。目錄放喺動態圖形，佢係介面庫，唔係剪片軟件。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An Android dialog library. It can play a Lottie animation, and you still export that animation from After Effects. It has had few updates since January 2022. The catalog lists it under motion graphics, but it is a UI library, not an editor. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: ContinuousSR
projects.description: Official Code for “Pixel to Gaussian: Ultra-Fast Continuous Super-Resolution with 2D Gaussian Modeling” ICLR 2026
projects.summary: 圖像超分研究代碼，用二維 Gaussian 由低清重建連續高清。ICLR 2026。只得測試代碼同權重，訓練代碼未放。目錄放喺 Gaussian Splatting，佢唔係三維濺射。repo 冇附開源授權檔。
projects.summary_en: Research code for image super-resolution. It rebuilds a continuous high-resolution image from a low-resolution one with 2D Gaussians. It was accepted to ICLR 2026. Only test code and weights are released, and the training code is not. The catalog lists it under Gaussian splatting, but it is not 3D splatting. The repository includes no open-source license file.

projects.name: SolarWM
projects.description: Open data and scalable training for long-horizon video world models.
projects.summary: 互動世界模型框架，有長片生成、訓練同即時部署。數據同權重喺 Hugging Face，部分數據要申請。佢係世界模型框架，唔係聊天機械人。授權係 Apache-2.0。效果要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: A framework for interactive world models, with long-video generation, training, and real-time deployment. Data and weights are on Hugging Face, and some of the data requires an application. It is a world-model framework, not a chatbot. The license is Apache-2.0. Measure the result yourself.

projects.name: Nucleoid
projects.description: World Model 🌱🐋🌍
projects.summary: 邏輯語言，用最少 token 寫物件同關係，執行係宣告式。世界模型可以用佢記結構。有終端工作區，cargo install nucleoid。佢係語言，唔係影片世界模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A logic language. It writes objects and relationships in few tokens, and execution is declarative. A world model can use it to store structure. There is a terminal workspace, installed with cargo install nucleoid. It is a language, not a video world model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: skills
projects.description: An agent skill that builds award-caliber websites from one line
projects.summary: agent skill，一句 brief 做成網站。要 Node.js 22.20 或更新。Claude Code、Codex 等讀到 SKILL.md 嘅 agent 可以用。佢係技能，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill. One brief becomes a website. It needs Node.js 22.20 or newer. Claude Code, Codex, and other agents that read SKILL.md can use it. It is a skill, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: unlazy
projects.description: Anti-laziness skill for AI agents. Core: the Depth Tree method, which splits a task N layers deep and gives every leaf the full time budget of the whole task, so effort multiplies with depth. Grounded in 2025-2026 research on model laziness, underthinking and premature completion.
projects.summary: agent skill，逼 agent 先寫驗收清單，做完再核對，先至報告。核心係 SKILL.md，要 Node.js 16 或更新。佢係技能，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill. It makes an agent write an acceptance list first, check the work after, and report only then. The core is SKILL.md. It needs Node.js 16 or newer. It is a skill, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: qq-bridge
projects.description: Bridge between QQ (SnowLuma OneBot v11) and DeepSeek Harness agents: social simulation, safe MCP tools, slang learning and more.
projects.summary: 本地橋，經公開 OneBot v11 把 QQ 訊息轉去 DeepSeek Harness。唔係騰訊、QQ、SnowLuma 或 DeepSeek 官方。要你自己開住兩邊服務，Windows 同 Node.js 22.13 或更新。授權係 PolyForm Noncommercial，唔可以商用。
projects.summary_en: A local bridge. It forwards QQ messages to DeepSeek Harness through the public OneBot v11 protocol. It is not an official Tencent, QQ, SnowLuma, or DeepSeek product. You run both services yourself, on Windows, with Node.js 22.13 or newer. The license is PolyForm Noncommercial, so commercial use is not allowed.

projects.name: EdenLive
projects.description: Real-time generative rendering for interactive worlds, from any visual reference.
projects.summary: 即時生成渲染器。參考片入去，外觀片出嚟，世界狀態留喺你嘅程式。權重喺 Hugging Face 嘅 VAST-AI/EdenLive。作者話 RTX 5090 可以 24 fps 或更高，要你自己量。佢係渲染模型，唔係遊戲引擎。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A real-time generative renderer. A reference video goes in and an appearance video comes out, while the world state stays in your program. Weights are on Hugging Face as VAST-AI/EdenLive. The author says an RTX 5090 can reach 24 fps or higher, so measure it yourself. It is a render model, not a game engine. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: PhysX-Anything
projects.description: PhysX-Anything: Simulation-Ready Physical 3D Assets from Single Image (CVPR 2026)
projects.summary: 研究模型，一張圖出可以放進模擬嘅實體三維資產。CVPR 2026。數據集喺 Hugging Face。2026 年 4 月後少更新。授權係 S-Lab License 1.0，只限非商業用途。
projects.summary_en: A research model. One image becomes a physical 3D asset you can drop into a simulation. It was accepted to CVPR 2026. The dataset is on Hugging Face. It has had few updates since April 2026. The license is S-Lab License 1.0, and use is limited to non-commercial purposes.

projects.name: VGGT-Long
projects.description: Official implement of VGGT-Long
projects.summary: 用現成 VGGT 處理公里級長 RGB 序列，分段、對齊、閉環。唔使再訓練，亦唔使相機標定。同目錄嘅 VGGT、StreamVGGT 唔同。2026 年 3 月後少更新。授權係 VGGT License。
projects.summary_en: It uses the existing VGGT model on kilometer-scale RGB sequences, in chunks, with alignment and loop closure. It does not retrain the model and does not need camera calibration. It is different from VGGT and StreamVGGT already in the catalog. It has had few updates since March 2026. The license is the VGGT License.

projects.name: OpenWorldLib
projects.description: Unified Codebase for Advanced World Models.
projects.summary: 呢個世界模型嘅共用代碼庫，訓練同推理放喺一處。目錄放喺 Gaussian Splatting，佢唔係濺射訓練器，亦唔係一個新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A shared codebase for world models. Training and inference live in one place. The catalog lists it under Gaussian splatting, but it is not a splatting trainer and it is not one new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: Open-DiffusionGS
projects.description: Baking Gaussian Splatting into Diffusion Denoiser for Fast and Scalable Single-stage Image-to-3D Generation and Reconstruction (ICCV 2025)
projects.summary: 研究模型，把 Gaussian Splatting 烤入擴散去噪器，一張圖一次過出三維。ICCV 2025。數據喺 Hugging Face。佢係生成模型，唔係檢視器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A research model. It bakes Gaussian splatting into a diffusion denoiser, so one image becomes 3D in a single stage. It was presented at ICCV 2025. The data is on Hugging Face. It is a generator, not a viewer. The license is MIT.

projects.name: after-effects-mcp
projects.description: MCP Server for Adobe After Effects. Enables remote control (compositions, text, shapes, solids, properties) via the Model Context Protocol using ExtendScript.
projects.summary: MCP 伺服器，用 ExtendScript 控制你開住嘅 After Effects，可以加合成、文字同形狀。要你自己有 AE。2026 年 4 月後少更新。佢係遙控，唔係 After Effects 本身。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An MCP server. It uses ExtendScript to control After Effects while you have it open, and it can add compositions, text, and shapes. You need your own copy of After Effects. It has had few updates since April 2026. It is a remote control, not After Effects itself. The license is MIT.

projects.name: nwm
projects.description: Official code for the CVPR 2025 paper "Navigation World Models".
projects.summary: 導航世界模型，按條件擴散預測行路之後嘅畫面。CVPR 2025 oral。權重喺 Hugging Face 嘅 facebook/nwm。2025 年 11 月後少更新。授權係 CC BY-NC 4.0，唔可以商用。佢係世界模型本身。
projects.summary_en: A navigation world model. Conditional diffusion predicts the view after a move. It was a CVPR 2025 oral. Weights are on Hugging Face as facebook/nwm. It has had few updates since November 2025. The license is CC BY-NC 4.0, so commercial use is not allowed. It is the world model itself.

projects.name: robotic_world_model
projects.description: Repository for our papers: Robotic World Model: A Neural Network Simulator for Robust Policy Optimization in Robotics and Uncertainty-Aware Robotic World Model Makes Offline Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Work on Real Robots
projects.summary: Isaac Lab 擴充，用神經動力學做機械人策略。可以同模擬器一齊訓練，或者離線用學到嘅模型。要 Isaac Sim。佢係機械人世界模型，唔係影片模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An Isaac Lab extension. It learns robot policies with a neural dynamics model. You can train it together with the simulator, or offline with the learned model. It needs Isaac Sim. It is a robotic world model, not a video model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: Aleph
projects.description: Give satellite imagery, terrain data, buildings, streetview photos to your LLM
projects.summary: 本地工具，喺地圖畫範圍，下載建築、地形、衛星圖、街景同有材質三維，畀你或者 LLM 用。Python 3.11 或更新，唔使 key。程式碼 MIT，OSM 係 ODbL，地形用 AWS 圖磚。作者話街景、衛星同三維屬 Google，下載違反條款，用未公開介面，可能會壞。呢個係下載器，唔係圖像模型。
projects.summary_en: A local tool. Draw an area on the map and it downloads buildings, terrain, a satellite image, Street View photos, and a textured 3D mesh, for you or for an LLM. It needs Python 3.11 or newer and no API key. The code is MIT. OSM data is ODbL. Terrain uses AWS open tiles. The author says Street View, satellite imagery, and the 3D meshes belong to Google, downloading them breaks Google's terms, and the tool uses undocumented interfaces, so it can break. It is a downloader listed under Image, not an image model.

projects.name: reanimate
projects.description: A Claude Code skill that reverse-engineers any animation frame by frame, then proves the copy moves the same.
projects.summary: Claude Code 技能，用嚟抄動畫。畀網頁、錄影、mp4、gif 或 Lottie，拍低再用你已有嘅 CSS、Framer Motion、GSAP 或 three.js 重做並對比。要 Bun 1.1+，macOS 或 Linux，唔使 key。MIT。別人素材仍屬原主。技能，唔係新動態模型。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code skill for copying an animation. Give it a web page, a recording, an mp4, a gif, or a Lottie file. It films the motion, then rebuilds it with the CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, or three.js you already use, and compares the copy. It needs Bun 1.1 or newer, on macOS or Linux, and no API key. The license is MIT. Other people's assets still belong to their owners. It is a skill, not a new motion model.

projects.name: appllama-skills
projects.description: A builder, not just a researcher. Agent skills that turn top-grossing app patterns into native-quality mobile screens.
projects.summary: 兩份 agent 技能，用嚟做手機畫面。研究嗰份要 Appllama MCP 同你自己嘅 Pro 帳戶。設計嗰份寫 Expo 同 React Native，唔接 MCP 都用得。Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 都裝得。程式碼 MIT。個名同標誌係商標，授權唔包括。唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: Two agent skills for mobile screens. The research skill needs the Appllama MCP and your own Pro account. The design skill writes Expo and React Native screens and works without the MCP. Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex can install them. The code is MIT. The name and logo are trademarks, and the license does not include them. It is not a new model.

projects.name: human-writing
projects.description: 让 AI 写的中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话。通用创作与改稿 Skill，开箱即用。
projects.summary: 中文寫作技能，要模型寫出嚟似一個具體嘅人講嘢。現實題材先核事實，虛構都要有動作同變化，初稿再砍重複、報告腔同翻案句。任何讀 SKILL.md 嘅 agent 都裝得，亦有一份短文可以貼去聊天窗。MIT。唔係新語言模型。2026 年 8 月之後少更新。
projects.summary_en: A Chinese writing skill. It asks the model to sound like one specific person speaking. Real topics have to be checked against the facts, and fiction still needs action and change. The draft then cuts repetition, report-voice, and reversal sentences. Any agent that reads SKILL.md can install it, and a short version can be pasted into a chat window. The license is MIT. It is not a new language model. It has had few updates since August 2026.

projects.name: gsgen
projects.description: [CVPR 2024] Text-to-3D using Gaussian Splatting
projects.summary: CVPR 2024 嘅文字生成三維高斯。用現有 Point-E 或 Shap-E 做起點再訓練，可以輸出 ply 同 splat。網格而家只匯出形狀。作者話 M1 Pro 上個檢視器可以超過每秒 40 格，你自己量。MIT。2024 年 1 月之後少更新。同 GaussianDreamer 唔同。
projects.summary_en: CVPR 2024 text-to-3D Gaussians. It starts from the existing Point-E or Shap-E model and then trains, and it can export ply and splat. The mesh export is shape only for now. The author says the viewer can pass 40 frames per second on an M1 Pro, so measure it yourself. The license is MIT. It has had few updates since January 2024. It is different from GaussianDreamer.

projects.name: GaussianDreamer
projects.description: [CVPR 2024] GaussianDreamer: Fast Generation from Text to 3D Gaussians by Bridging 2D and 3D Diffusion Models
projects.summary: CVPR 2024，一句文字生成三維高斯。用現有 Shap-E 做三維起點，再靠二維擴散補幾何同外觀，亦可以做人體化身。作者話一張 GPU 大約 15 分鐘，你自己量。有 Hugging Face 示範。Apache-2.0。2025 年 1 月之後少更新。同 GSGEN 唔同。
projects.summary_en: CVPR 2024. One sentence becomes 3D Gaussians. It uses the existing Shap-E model as the 3D start, then a 2D diffusion model fills in geometry and appearance, and it can also make a human avatar. The author says one GPU takes about 15 minutes, so measure it yourself. There is a Hugging Face demo. The license is Apache-2.0. It has had few updates since January 2025. It is different from GSGEN.

projects.name: LucidDreamer
projects.description: Official implementation of "LucidDreamer: Towards High-Fidelity Text-to-3D Generation via Interval Score Matching"
projects.summary: CVPR 2024 highlight，用區間分數匹配由文字蒸餾高質三維，底層係三維高斯同現有二維擴散。作者話 A100 大約 35 分鐘，你自己量。MIT。2024 年 5 月之後少更新。呢個係文字生成三維，同 luciddreamer-cvlab 嘅場景版唔同。
projects.summary_en: A CVPR 2024 highlight. Interval score matching distills a high-quality 3D asset from text, on top of 3D Gaussians and an existing 2D diffusion model. The author says an A100 takes about 35 minutes, so measure it yourself. The license is MIT. It has had few updates since May 2024. This is text-to-3D, and it is different from the scene version at luciddreamer-cvlab.

projects.name: PartPacker
projects.description: Efficient Part-level 3D Object Generation via Dual Volume Packing
projects.summary: 一張圖生成拆到零件嘅三維。權重喺 Hugging Face nvidia/PartPacker，推理約 10GB。作者喺 3090 同 4090 試過。NVIDIA Source Code License，只限非商業，NVIDIA 可以商業用。2025 年 6 月後少更新。同 TRELLIS 唔同。
projects.summary_en: One image generates a 3D object split into parts. The weights are on Hugging Face at nvidia/PartPacker, and inference is about 10 GB. The author tested it on a 3090 and a 4090. The NVIDIA Source Code License allows non-commercial use only, while NVIDIA itself may use it commercially. It has had few updates since June 2025. It is different from TRELLIS.

projects.name: NeoVerse
projects.description: [CVPR 2026 Highlight & Best Paper of VideoWorldModel Workshop] NeoVerse: Enhancing 4D World Model with in-the-wild Monocular Videos
projects.summary: CVPR 2026 highlight，亦係 VideoWorldModel workshop 最佳論文。用單目片重建，再沿新鏡頭出片。權重喺 Hugging Face Yuppie1204/NeoVerse，用現有 Wan 2.1。作者話 A800 少過 30 秒，你自己量。Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A CVPR 2026 highlight, and the best paper of the VideoWorldModel workshop. It reconstructs a monocular clip, then renders a video along a new camera path. The weights are on Hugging Face at Yuppie1204/NeoVerse, and it uses the existing Wan 2.1. The author says one A800 can finish in under 30 seconds, so measure it yourself. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: AI-Cross-Border-Ecommerce-Agent-Toolkit
projects.description: AI 跨境电商运营智能体工具箱 · 把运营 SOP 拆成 7 个可复用的 AI Agent 工作流，含 Prompt、模板与真实案例
projects.summary: 跨境電商 skill 包，七個流程：市場、策略、標題、主圖、短片、廣告、評論。你填模板，再交畀任何 LLM，唔使 key。有計算腳本計價格帶同淨利率，模型只負責解讀。成個資料夾可以裝成 SKILL.md。MIT，而家係 beta。唔係商店程式，亦唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A cross-border ecommerce skill pack with seven workflows: market, strategy, title, main image, short video, ads, and reviews. You fill in a template and hand it to any LLM, with no API key. Calculation scripts handle price bands and net margin, and the model only interprets them. The whole folder can be installed as SKILL.md. The license is MIT, and it is still beta. It is not a store program and not a new model.

projects.name: monocode
projects.description: A GUI for your coding agents
projects.summary: 程式 agent 嘅桌面介面。Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 呢類你已經裝好同登入嘅工具，可以分頁一齊跑。佢唔賣 token。MIT。仲係早期。原生預覽係實驗版，會寫入同一個資料庫，試之前先備份。唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A desktop interface for coding agents. Tools you already installed and signed into, such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, can run side by side in tabs. It does not sell tokens. The license is MIT. It is still early. The native preview is experimental and writes into the same database, so back up before you try it. It is not a new model.

projects.name: WeChatBridge
projects.description: 微信聊天记录一键转发到 AI Agent 与 Obsidian 的原生 macOS 工具
projects.summary: macOS 同 Windows 嘅分享擴充。微信 4.1.13 或更新本身會匯出聊天 ZIP，呢個 app 接收之後貼去你已有嘅 Codex、Claude，或者存成 Obsidian Markdown。唔讀微信資料庫，亦唔注入微信。唔係騰訊官方。MIT。你要自己嘅微信同目標程式。
projects.summary_en: A share extension for macOS and Windows. WeChat 4.1.13 or newer already exports a chat ZIP, and this app receives it, pastes it into the Codex or Claude you already have, or saves Obsidian Markdown. It does not read the WeChat database and does not inject into WeChat. It is not official Tencent. The license is MIT. You need your own WeChat and the target app.

projects.name: FastVGGT
projects.description: [ICLR 2026] FastVGGT: Fast Visual Geometry Transformer
projects.summary: ICLR 2026，唔使再訓練就加快現有 VGGT 嘅長序列重建。作者話最快大約 4 倍，你自己量。要 Hugging Face 嘅 VGGT 權重。授權係 VGGT License。同目錄嘅 VGGT、StreamVGGT、VGGT-Long 唔同。2026 年 1 月後少更新。唔係新幾何模型。
projects.summary_en: ICLR 2026. It speeds up long-sequence reconstruction with the existing VGGT model and does not retrain it. The author says it can be about 4 times faster, so measure it yourself. It needs the VGGT weights on Hugging Face. The license is the VGGT License. It is different from VGGT, StreamVGGT, and VGGT-Long already in the catalog. It has had few updates since January 2026. It is not a new geometry model.

projects.name: 3DGS-to-PC
projects.description: 3DGS-to-PC: 3D Gaussian Splatting to Dense Point Clouds [3D-VAST: ICCVW 2025]
projects.summary: 把三維高斯 ply 或 splat 轉成密點雲，裝咗 Open3D 亦可以出網格。顏色要相機變換，否則會唔似原場景。CUDA 擴充裝唔到可以用純 Python。Apache-2.0。ICCVW 2025。2025 年 11 月後少更新。呢個係轉換器，唔係訓練器。
projects.summary_en: It turns a 3D Gaussian ply or splat into a dense point cloud, and with Open3D it can also make a mesh. Colours need the camera transforms, or they will not look like the original scene. If the CUDA extension will not install, a pure Python renderer is available. The license is Apache-2.0. It is from ICCVW 2025. It has had few updates since November 2025. It is a converter, not a trainer.

projects.name: LongSplat
projects.description: [ICCV 2025] LongSplat: Robust Unposed 3D Gaussian Splatting for Casual Long Videos
projects.summary: ICCV 2025，隨手拍嘅長片、冇相機姿態，重建三維高斯。姿態用現有 MASt3R。可以轉成一般 3DGS 檢視器格式。NVIDIA License，只限非商業研究或評估，NVIDIA 可以商業用。2026 年 1 月後少更新。
projects.summary_en: ICCV 2025. A casual long video with no camera poses is reconstructed as 3D Gaussians. Poses come from the existing MASt3R model. The result can be converted for ordinary 3DGS viewers. The NVIDIA License allows only non-commercial research or evaluation, while NVIDIA may use it commercially. It has had few updates since January 2026.

projects.name: 3D-VLA
projects.description: [ICML 2024] 3D-VLA: A 3D Vision-Language-Action Generative World Model
projects.summary: ICML 2024 嘅具身世界模型。建喺現有 3D-LLM 上，預測目標圖像同點雲，再出動作。權重喺 Hugging Face anyezhy。repo 冇授權檔。2024 年 10 月後少更新。唔係影片世界模型。
projects.summary_en: An embodied world model from ICML 2024. It is built on the existing 3D-LLM, predicts a goal image and a point cloud, then outputs an action. The weights are on Hugging Face at anyezhy. The repository has no license file. It has had few updates since October 2024. It is not a video world model.

projects.name: HelixWorld
projects.description: 🪐 HelixWorld: real-time interactive audio-visual world model.
projects.summary: 即時聲畫世界模型。一張圖加一句提示，行前或轉頭，畫面同空間聲一齊變。預覽權重喺 Hugging Face NoizAI/HelixWorld-preview。程式碼 Apache-2.0，權重授權另計。用現有 Gemma 3 做文字編碼。作者話 H800 可以 24 格，你自己量。約 70 GB。
projects.summary_en: A real-time audio-visual world model. Give it an image and a prompt, then walk or turn, and the picture and the spatial sound change together. The preview weights are on Hugging Face at NoizAI/HelixWorld-preview. The code is Apache-2.0, and the weight license is separate. The text encoder is the existing Gemma 3. The author says an H800 can do 24 frames per second, so measure it yourself. It needs about 70 GB of VRAM.

projects.name: harnessrouter
projects.description: HarnessRouter Community Edition: the self-hosted, Apache-2.0 edition of the unified interface for agent harnesses. Run Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, PI, DSH, and more through one API, with sessions, streaming, files, cancellation, and failure handling. Implements the Unified Harness Protocol (UHP), an open standard. Your keys, your infrastructure.
projects.summary: 自己托管嘅介面，用一個 API 跑你已有嘅 Codex、Claude Code 等 harness。要 Docker、大約 4 GB 磁碟，同你自己嘅 provider key，冇內置模型。Apache-2.0。對外開放之前要改走預設登入。唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted interface. One API runs harnesses you already have, such as Codex and Claude Code. It needs Docker, about 4 GB of disk, and your own provider key. There is no bundled model. The license is Apache-2.0. Change the default login before you expose it. It is not a new model.

projects.name: fx
projects.description: Unix like coding agent
projects.summary: 實驗版 Unix 風格程式 agent。一個 Zig 二進位，macOS 同 Linux，唔使裝 runtime。模型用你自己嘅 Vercel、ChatGPT、Grok 或相容接口。可以讀 skill，但佢自己係 agent。預設會自動改檔同跑測試。Apache-2.0。唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An experimental Unix-style coding agent. It is one Zig binary for macOS and Linux, with no runtime to install. The model is yours: Vercel, ChatGPT, Grok, or a compatible endpoint. It can read skills, but it is the agent. By default it edits files and runs tests without asking. The license is Apache-2.0. It is not a new model.

projects.name: KiroCrew
projects.description: A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.
projects.summary: 本地或你自己機器上嘅開發工作區，任務可以跨對話繼續，亦可以無人值守。預設 agent 係要另外安裝同登入嘅 kiro-cli。macOS、Linux、Windows。每日有一次匿名用量心跳，可以關掉。Apache-2.0。唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A development workspace on your own machine, local or remote. Tasks can continue across sessions, and they can run unattended. The default agent is kiro-cli, which you install and sign in to separately. It runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It sends one anonymous usage heartbeat a day, and you can turn that off. The license is Apache-2.0. It is not a new model.

projects.name: VLA-JEPA
projects.description: [ECCV 2026] VLA-JEPA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Model with Latent World Model
projects.summary: ECCV 2026，用潛在世界模型加強視覺語言動作模型。基於現有 starVLA，要 Qwen3-VL-2B 同 V-JEPA2。權重喺 Hugging Face ginwind/VLA-JEPA。程式碼 Apache-2.0，第三方部分跟原授權。2026 年 9 月後少更新。唔係影片世界模型。
projects.summary_en: ECCV 2026. A latent world model that strengthens a vision-language-action model. It is based on the existing starVLA project and needs Qwen3-VL-2B and V-JEPA2. The weights are on Hugging Face at ginwind/VLA-JEPA. The code is Apache-2.0, and third-party portions keep their own licenses. It has had few updates since September 2026. It is not a video world model.

projects.name: GR00T-Dreams
projects.description: DreamGen: Nvidia GEAR Lab's initiative to solve the robotics data problem using world models
projects.summary: 用現有 Cosmos 世界模型，由一張圖同指示生成機械人片，再抽出動作去微調 GR00T N1。呢個 repo 係條流程，唔係新影片模型。Apache-2.0。2025 年 10 月後少更新。
projects.summary_en: It uses the existing Cosmos world model. One image and an instruction become a robot video, then actions are extracted to fine-tune GR00T N1. This repository is that pipeline, not a new video model. The license is Apache-2.0. It has had few updates since October 2025.

projects.name: stop-that-shit
projects.description: Stop That Shit（别再造史了）｜面向 Codex/GPT 场景的多平台 Hook + Skill Guard：拦截 AI coding agent 无需求的哈希、校验和与任务范围膨胀。 A multi-platform Hook + Skill Guard for AI coding agents in Codex/GPT workflows: stop unrequested hashes, checksums, and task-scope creep.
projects.summary: Coding agent 嘅 skill 同攔截。攔住冇人要嘅校驗和、範圍膨脹、只讀審查時改檔，同重複做完嘅檢查。Codex、Claude Code 等用到。MIT。佢係技能，唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill and a guard for coding agents. It stops unrequested checksums, scope creep, file edits during a read-only review, and repeats of checks that are already done. Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools can use it. The license is MIT. It is a skill, not a new model.

projects.name: axuse
projects.description: Accessibility-first browser & computer use for AI agents — one MCP server for every harness (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity). Instruments the DOM/accessibility tree via CDP instead of screenshot loops: diffed snapshots, stable element refs, trusted input, typed errors. Zero dependencies
projects.summary: 本地 MCP，用無障礙樹操作瀏覽器同電腦，唔靠截圖循環。Node.js 22 或更新，要 Chromium。Codex、Claude Code 等 MCP 宿主用到。Windows 桌面已試過，macOS 要另外開權限。PolyForm Noncommercial，唔可以商用。唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local MCP. It drives a browser and a computer from the accessibility tree, not a screenshot loop. It needs Node.js 22 or newer and Chromium. MCP hosts such as Codex and Claude Code can use it. Windows desktop control has been tested. macOS needs an extra permission. The license is PolyForm Noncommercial, so commercial use is not allowed. It is not a new model.

projects.name: skills
projects.description: Agent skills for building with TypeSafe's System One API
projects.summary: 一份 agent skill，設計 TypeSafe System One 接入：狀態、問題同請求。要你自己嘅 TypeSafe 帳戶同 API。Claude Code 可裝插件，其他 agent 用 skills.sh。同目錄另外三個同名 skills repo 唔同。MIT。唔係模型本身。
projects.summary_en: One agent skill for designing a TypeSafe System One integration: states, questions, and requests. You need your own TypeSafe account and API. Claude Code can install it as a plugin, and other agents use skills.sh. It is different from the three other repositories in this catalog that are also named skills. The license is MIT. It is not the model itself.

projects.name: oil-motion
projects.description: Web animation skill for Claude Code & Codex. 帮你做跟着滚动和鼠标动的网页动画。
projects.summary: 網頁交互動畫 skill。你講表達同跟邊種操作，agent 用已有影片模型生成連續畫面，再接到滾動、滑鼠或拖動。瀏覽器只播做好嘅畫面。列喺影片，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係新影片模型。MIT。
projects.summary_en: A skill for interactive web animation. You say what it should express and which input it follows. The agent uses a video model you already have to make the frames, then connects them to scroll, the mouse, or a drag. The browser only plays the finished frames. It is listed under Video. It is not After Effects and not a new video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ArcReel
projects.description: AI Agent 驱动的开源可自部署视频工作台：将小说与剧本转为角色、场景、道具资产、分镜、视频和剪映草稿，支持跨镜头一致性、多供应商与费用追踪 | Self-hosted AI video workspace for stories, storyboards and short-form video production
projects.summary: 自己托管嘅短片工作台。小說或劇本變成角色、分鏡同片，可以出中國大陸版剪映草稿，CapCut 相容未驗證。片用你自己接嘅模型 API，要 Docker。AGPL-3.0。唔係新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted short-video workspace. A novel or a script becomes characters, a storyboard, and a video, and it can export a mainland-China Jianying draft. CapCut compatibility is not verified. The video comes from model APIs you connect yourself. It needs Docker. The license is AGPL-3.0. It is not a new video model.

projects.name: Aether
projects.description: [ICCV 2025 & ICCV 2025 RIWM Outstanding Paper] Aether: Geometric-Aware Unified World Modeling
projects.summary: ICCV 2025，亦係該 workshop 傑出論文。一個世界模型做四維重建、按動作預測下一條片，同由目標圖做規劃。權重喺 Hugging Face AetherWorldModel/AetherV1。程式碼 MIT。2025 年 10 月後少更新。作者話可以零樣本用喺真實場景，你自己量。
projects.summary_en: ICCV 2025, and an outstanding paper of that workshop. One world model does 4D reconstruction, predicts the next clip from an action, and plans from a goal image. The weights are on Hugging Face at AetherWorldModel/AetherV1. The code is MIT. It has had few updates since October 2025. The author says it can generalize to real scenes without extra training, so measure it yourself.

projects.name: sapper-v2
projects.description: Autonomous pentest legion — AI commander + worker swarm + layered fact-intent graph. 3rd Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online champion (634 teams · 8h unattended · 1B tokens beat 4.5B). The Nüwa Test: give AIs Create/Language/History, let a civilization grow.
projects.summary: 多 agent 攻防程式，指揮員分工人群，用你已裝嘅 Claude Code。作者話喺騰訊智能攻防網上賽無人值守跑完。只可測自己擁有或者有書面授權嘅系統。MIT。呢個係 agent，唔係新語言模型。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent attack-and-defense program. A commander splits work across a group, using Claude Code you already installed. The author says an unattended run finished a Tencent intelligent attack-defense qualifier. Use it only on systems you own or have written permission to test. MIT. It is an agent, not a new language model.

projects.name: idol-sdk
projects.description: Idol: a single image to 3D Gaussians. Inference SDK and demo.
projects.summary: 一張物件相變三維高斯，輸出普通 ply。Python 3.10、PyTorch 2.5 起。權重喺 HF speridlabs/idol，程式碼 Apache-2.0。DINOv3 同 FLUX.2-dev 要另外申請，許可跟佢哋。作者話峰值約 7.2GB。同 TripoSplat 唔同，係推理。
projects.summary_en: One object photo becomes 3D Gaussians and a standard ply. Python 3.10 or newer and PyTorch 2.5 or newer. Weights are on Hugging Face at speridlabs/idol. The code is Apache-2.0. DINOv3 and FLUX.2-dev need separate access, and their licenses stay theirs. The author says peak use is about 7.2 GB of VRAM. This inference kit is a different project from TripoSplat.

projects.name: ai-startup-skills
projects.description: 创业公司做 AI 产品的 7 步 Agent Skill 合集：验证 → BP → 政策 → 路演 → 获客 → 定价 → 注册。
projects.summary: Agent skill 包，七步加總入口：驗證、商業計劃、政策、路演、獲客、定價、註冊。畀喺中國做 AI 產品嘅一人公司，Codex、Claude Code 同 Cursor 用。政策同稅務只係資料參考，唔係專業意見。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill pack with seven steps plus a router: validation, a business plan, policy, a pitch, growth, pricing, and registration. It is for one-person companies building AI products in China, on Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. Policy and tax notes are information, not professional advice. MIT. It is not a new model.

projects.name: SimpleEnglish
projects.description: Agent skill: make LLMs write docs in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical
projects.summary: 寫作 skill，要已有嘅模型用短句、主動語態寫技術說明，風格跟簡化技術英語。Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等識讀 skill 嘅 agent 都裝到。MIT。非官方，同 ASD 無關，標準原文冇收喺度。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A writing skill that asks a model you already have to write technical instructions in short sentences and the active voice, in the style of Simplified Technical English. It installs on Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other agents that read skills. MIT. Unofficial, not affiliated with ASD, and the standard text is not in the repo. It is not a new model.

projects.name: awesome-claude-video-skills
projects.description: Open-source skills and toolkits that let Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents make video. 180 repos by type, each security-graded. English / 中文.
projects.summary: 技能目錄，收錄其他人寫嘅影片 skill，畀 Claude Code、Codex 等 coding agent 用。清單文字 CC0，每個項目各自有授權。作者話逐個做過安全評級，頁面會再更新。呢個係目錄，唔係影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A directory of other people's video skills for Claude Code, Codex, and similar coding agents. The list text is CC0. Each listed project keeps its own license. The author says every entry has a security grade, and the page is updated. This is a catalog, not a video model.

projects.name: headcount
projects.description: An agent organization structured as a company — 15+ departments, 125+ skills, each independently installable, citing the standards and regulators that settle the question. Runs in Claude Code and ChatGPT.
projects.summary: Agent skill 包，16 個部門、172 個 skill，可以只裝需要嘅部門。Claude Code、ChatGPT 同 Codex 用。引用外部標準同法規，文字寫死，唔會自動跟上最新規定。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill pack: 16 departments and 172 skills, and you can install only the departments you need. It runs in Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Codex. It cites outside standards and regulations, but the text is written once and does not track a regulator's latest publication. MIT. It is not a new model.

projects.name: Grandet
projects.description: Find the cheapest API for any model and connect it from your AI agent: Grandet Skill and an anonymous MCP server, backed by listed prices from 1,800+ official, inference and relay providers on grandet.ai.
projects.summary: 查模型 API 標價嘅 skill，連匿名 MCP。比較官方、推理商同轉售站嘅公開標價，再接你自己嘅 key。安裝要 Node.js 20 或更新，或者直接抄 skill 資料夾。Skill 係 Apache-2.0，目錄程式係 AGPL-3.0，標價數據唔喺呢兩個許可入面。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill, plus an anonymous MCP, that compares published prices for model APIs across official providers, inference hosts, and resellers, then connects a key you already have. Install needs Node.js 20 or newer, or you can copy the skill folder. The skill is Apache-2.0. The catalogue program is AGPL-3.0-only. The price data is under neither license. It is not a new model.

projects.name: thinking-orbs
projects.description: Dotted thought-orb loading indicators for AI & agent UIs, 9 tuned types, two sizes, auto dark/light
projects.summary: AI 介面用嘅載入動畫，九種狀態、兩種尺寸，畫喺普通 canvas。npm 包裝好，React 用。自動跟深淺色，減少動態時停喺一格。MIT。最近推送到 2026-08。呢個係介面元件，唔係 agent，亦唔係模型。
projects.summary_en: Loading animations for AI interfaces: nine states and two sizes, drawn on a plain canvas. It ships as an npm package for React. It follows light and dark theme, and it holds one frame when the user prefers less motion. MIT. The last push was in August 2026. It is a UI component, not an agent and not a model.

projects.name: zvec-grep
projects.description: Local-first search across your workspace, built for humans and AI agents.
projects.summary: 本機搜尋，建喺現有嘅 zvec 上面，將文字搜尋、BM25 同向量搜尋放喺同一個介面。終端或者經 MCP 畀 agent 用。Node.js 22 或更新。索引同本機模型留喺你部機，遠端嵌入要你同意先送。Apache-2.0。呢個係搜尋工具，唔係新語言模型。
projects.summary_en: Local search built on the existing zvec engine: text search, BM25, and vector search in one interface. Use it in the terminal or over MCP from an agent. Node.js 22 or newer. The index and local models stay on your machine. Remote embeddings are sent only if you allow it. Apache-2.0. It is a search tool, not a new language model.

projects.name: BrowserKitten
projects.description: A Chrome side-panel agent for your signed-in browser. Read pages, take action, create files, and run local follow-ups. Bring your own models.
projects.summary: Chrome 側欄網頁 agent，喺你已登入嘅分頁做任務，要自己嘅 OpenAI 相容 key。未上商店，開發者模式載入，Chrome 135 或更新。MIT。README 叫佢 PawWork，同 browser-use 唔同。最近推送到 2026-09。呢個係瀏覽器 agent，唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A Chrome side-panel web agent. It works on a tab where you are already logged in, and it needs your own OpenAI-compatible key. It is not in the Chrome Web Store. Load it in developer mode. Chrome 135 or newer. MIT. The README calls it PawWork, and it is a different project from browser-use. The last push was in September 2026. It is a browser agent, not a new model.

projects.name: awesome-claude-5-5-videos
projects.description: Source-linked Claude 5.5 video workflows: Opus and Sonnet demos, separately labeled next-Fable testing reports, prompts, tools and production evidence.
projects.summary: 作品目錄，收其他人用 Claude 5.5 做嘅影片同動畫，附來源帖同製作紀錄。作者話截至 2026-10-11 有 424 條去重來源，九幀預覽睇唔到成片。Fable 只係作者自報。清單 CC-BY-4.0。同 awesome-claude-video-skills 唔同，呢個唔係影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A directory of other people's videos and animations made with Claude 5.5, with source posts and production notes. The author says that as of 11 October 2026 there were 424 distinct sources, and nine-frame previews do not show the full film. Fable entries are only what creators reported. The list is CC-BY-4.0. It is a different project from awesome-claude-video-skills, and it is not a video model.

projects.name: awesome-opus5-5-videos
projects.description: A growing collection of viral videos made with Claude Opus 5.5 and the prompts behind them. Watch each original next to a live remake on Skillry. Updated regularly.
projects.summary: 作品目錄，收其他人用 Claude Opus 5.5 寫網頁動畫畫出嚟嘅影片，附原帖。作者話有 703 條提示，418 條喺 Skillry 有重製。片同提示屬創作者，清單 MIT。同 awesome-claude-5-5-videos 唔同，呢個唔係影片模型。最近推送到 2026-10-13。
projects.summary_en: A directory of other people's videos, drawn as web animation with Claude Opus 5.5, plus links to the original posts. The author says there are 703 prompts, and 418 have a remake on Skillry. The videos and prompts belong to their creators. The list code is MIT. It is a different project from awesome-claude-5-5-videos, and it is not a video model. The last push was on 13 October 2026.

projects.name: awesome-reverse-engineered
projects.description: Don't reverse engineer it twice. 17,000+ open-source tools built by reverse engineering closed apps, APIs, devices, protocols, file formats, games and AI tools. Search site + agent skill + MCP server, refreshed nightly.
projects.summary: 開源項目索引，收別人已經做出嚟嘅開源客戶端同工具，附搜尋頁、skill 同 MCP。作者話而家有一萬七千幾個項目。程式 MIT，索引資料 CC0，列出嘅項目各自有授權。呢個係索引，唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An index of open-source clients and tools other people already published, with a search page, a skill, and an MCP server. The author says it now lists more than seventeen thousand projects. The program is MIT. The index data is CC0. Each listed project keeps its own license. This is an index, not a new model.

projects.name: native-subtitle-quote-image
projects.description: 保留视频内嵌字幕，精确取帧并生成 3:4 社交长图的 Agent Skill
projects.summary: Agent skill，將影片帧拼成社交長圖。原生模式只裁畫面裡已有嘅字幕，腳本模式先畫你審過嘅台詞，兩種唔會混。本地檔或者 YouTube 連結都行，Python 腳本可以單獨跑。Codex、Claude Code 用。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that turns video frames into a tall social image. Native mode only crops subtitles already burned into the picture. Script mode draws lines you have already checked, and the two modes are not mixed. A local file or a YouTube link both work, and the Python scripts can run on their own. Codex and Claude Code. MIT. It is not a new model.

projects.name: openqodex
projects.description: Open source AI code review for coding agents. A separate reviewer checks every change your agent writes before you push, in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Cline. No account or key of its own.
projects.summary: 本機程式檢查，喺你 push 之前用另一個已登入嘅 agent 審改動。Claude Code 同 Codex 可以做審查員，Cursor 同 Cline 只能發起。要 Node.js 22 或更新，macOS 或 Linux。冇自己嘅帳戶同 key。Apache-2.0。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local code review that uses another agent you already signed into, before you push. Claude Code and Codex can be the reviewer. Cursor and Cline can only start the review. Node.js 22 or newer, on macOS or Linux. It has no account or key of its own. Apache-2.0. It is not a new model.

projects.name: awesome-seedance
projects.description: 🎬 Evidence-led Seedance 2.5 / 2.0 prompt library: 840+ cases traced to original posts, 490+ cross-model retest runs, 27 copy-ready templates, 79 installable AI-video Skills. Synced daily from goodcase.ai. EN / 中文 / 日本語.
projects.summary: Seedance 案例目錄，作者話有 840 多條來源帖、27 個模板同 79 個 skill，每日由 goodcase.ai 同步。片要你自己喺即夢或 Dreamina 用現成 Seedance 出。清單 MIT。呢個係目錄，唔係新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A Seedance case directory. The author says it has more than 840 source posts, 27 templates, and 79 skills, synced daily from goodcase.ai. You still generate the video yourself with the existing Seedance model on Jimeng or Dreamina. The list is MIT. It is a directory, not a new video model.

projects.name: vox-director
projects.description: Turn one topic into a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer/ad video — automated end to end on Atlas Cloud + ffmpeg. An agent skill.
projects.summary: Agent skill，用一個題目做紙拼貼解說片。你要先批節奏同畫面。圖、動態、旁白同音樂用你自己嘅 Atlas Cloud key 呼叫現成模型，ffmpeg 拼片。要 Python 3、Pillow 同 ffmpeg。MIT。呢個唔係新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that turns one topic into a paper-collage explainer. You approve the beats and the look first. Pictures, motion, narration, and music come from existing models through your own Atlas Cloud key, and ffmpeg assembles the film. It needs Python 3, Pillow, and ffmpeg. MIT. It is not a new video model.

projects.name: awesome-ai-motion
projects.description: 发现惊艳动效、创意视频与交互艺术，探索背后的源码、提示词与制作过程。Curated motion design, creative video & interactive art — with source code, prompts & making-of resources.
projects.summary: 動效同創意影片目錄，作者話畫廊有 1728 個作品，附原帖同提示。作品跟原帖，清單程式 MIT。同 awesome-opus5-5-videos 唔同。呢個係目錄，唔係影片模型。最近推送到 2026-10-27。
projects.summary_en: A directory of motion design and creative videos. The author says the gallery has 1,728 works, with original posts and prompts. The works stay with those posts. The list program is MIT. It is a different project from awesome-opus5-5-videos. It is a directory, not a video model. The last push was on 27 October 2026.

projects.name: golive-skill
projects.description: Take your agent-built product live: hosting, database, domain, email, payments — on your own accounts. Open-source Agent Skill + zero-dependency Node CLI: detect → plan → approve → apply → verify. No GoLive account, backend or telemetry.
projects.summary: Agent skill，幫 agent 做好嘅產品上線：主機、資料庫、網域、電郵、付款都用你自己帳戶。要你批准先寫入。Node.js 20 或更新，Codex 同 Claude Code 試過。早期 alpha，冇 GoLive 帳戶同遙測。金鑰放喺 repo 外明文檔。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that puts a product your agent built online: hosting, a database, a domain, email, and payments, all on accounts you already have. It writes only after you approve. Node.js 20 or newer. Codex and Claude Code have been tried. Early alpha. No GoLive account and no telemetry. Keys sit in a plaintext file outside the repo. MIT. It is not a new model.

projects.name: big-arrow-on-the-screen
projects.description: Let your AI agents paint big arrows, boxes and text on your Mac screen. One CLI, click-through, gone by itself. Skill for Claude Code and Codex. MIT.
projects.summary: macOS 技能同命令列，畀 Claude Code 同 Codex 喺螢幕畫大箭咀、框同字。點擊會穿透，過一陣自己消失。找元件要輔助使用權限。MIT。呢個只會指，唔會代你撳。唔係新模型。
