projects.summary_en: A macOS skill and command-line tool. Claude Code and Codex can draw big arrows, boxes, and text on the screen. Clicks pass through, and the marks go away on their own. Finding an element needs Accessibility permission. MIT. It only points. It does not press for you. It is not a new model.

projects.name: squadra
projects.description: Coordinate Claude, Codex and Cursor windows with shared tasks, acknowledgements, prechecks, parallel tests, source-bound proofs and independent review. Built-in skills recall lessons, simplify code and forecast work. Track progress, decisions and evidence in a bilingual local dashboard, with MCP plugins. Browse skills and verified security audits.
projects.summary: 本機協調工具，用嚟畀 Claude Code、Codex 同 Cursor 幾個視窗一齊做同一個項目。任務、檢查同審查嘅紀錄放喺你部機，附 skill、命令列同本機面板。要 Python 3.12 或更新，macOS 或 POSIX，只用標準庫。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local coordinator used so Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor windows can share one project's tasks, checks, and reviews on your machine. It ships a skill, a CLI, and a local dashboard. Needs Python 3.12 or newer on macOS or POSIX, and uses only the standard library. MIT. This is not a new model.

projects.name: screenwriting-skills
projects.description: Professional agent skills for screenwriting, television writing and dramaturgy
projects.summary: Agent skill 包，有 26 個用嚟寫劇本、電視劇同戲劇技巧嘅 skill，畀 Claude Code 同 Codex 用。內文用中文寫，檔案放喺 repo，你用其他語言問就用嗰種語言答。裝一次兩邊都用到。MIT。呢個係寫作技能，唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A pack of 26 agent skills for screenwriting, television writing, and dramaturgy, for Claude Code and Codex. The skill text is written in Chinese and lives in the repo; ask in another language and the agent answers in that language. Install once and both agents can use it. MIT. These are writing skills, not a new model.

projects.name: codeAgent
projects.description: CodeAgent is an open-source coding agent that lives in your terminal. It understands your repository, plans multi-step changes, writes and edits files, runs commands and tests, and iterates until the task is done — all with a transparent, extensible tool loop.
projects.summary: 終端編程 agent，用嚟畀你用自然語言叫佢讀碼、改檔同跑命令。要自己接 OpenAI 相容或 Anthropic 協議嘅現成模型，預設 DeepSeek。有審批、記憶同技能，跑喺你部機。Windows 優先，Python 3.11 或更新。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A terminal coding agent you talk to in natural language so it reads code, edits files, and runs commands on your machine. You bring your own OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-protocol model; DeepSeek is the default. It includes approvals, memory, and skills. Windows first, Python 3.11 or newer. MIT. This is not a new model.

projects.name: baoyan-agent-benchmark
projects.description: Sprix AI at 屿智同行 × 保研岛 — an open-source benchmark for AI agents in Baoyan advising and application planning.
projects.summary: 開源基準，用嚟評保研諮詢同申請規劃嘅 agent 配置。而家有 70 條中文任務、23 個案例同 83 個答題階段。公開數據唔使審批，評分材料要收起，唔畀被測 agent 睇到。跑喺你自己接嘅現成 agent。MIT。呢個係測試集，唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An open benchmark for agent setups that advise on Baoyan admissions and application planning. It has 70 Chinese tasks, 23 cases, and 83 answer stages. The public data needs no approval, but scoring materials stay hidden from the agent under test. You run it on your own existing agent. MIT. This is a test set, not a new model.

projects.name: arena-skill
projects.description: When Claude keeps giving you bad answers, make 100 versions of it fight to the death. Same task, 100 different strategies, a bracket, one answer left. Free Claude Code skill.
projects.summary: Claude Code skill，用嚟喺同一個任務開到 100 個子 agent 打淘汰賽，每個用唔同策略，最後剩一個答案畀你決定用唔用。子 agent 只寫入 .arena/，唔會改你嘅檔案。要 Claude Code 同 Python 3.8 或更新。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code skill that runs up to 100 sub-agents on the same task in a knockout bracket, each with a different strategy, and leaves you one answer to accept or ignore. Sub-agents only write inside .arena/ and do not change your files. Needs Claude Code and Python 3.8 or newer. MIT. This is not a new model.

projects.name: shrt
projects.description: A contract-driven gRPC regression harness for AI coding agents, with human-approved baselines. Snapshot the valid call chains of an API so an agent can look one up instead of tracing for it. gRPC today, OpenAPI next
projects.summary: API 回歸工具，用嚟記低登入、建立同讀回嘅呼叫鍊。你批准一次合格跑做基準，之後喺你部機重播，改動會話畀你知係邊步。shrt init 會裝 Claude Code skill，命令亦可以人手跑。要 Go 1.26 同 buf。而家只支援 Connect，唔係純 gRPC。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An API regression tool that records call chains such as login, create, and read-back. You approve one passing run as the baseline, then replay it on your machine, and a change tells you which step moved. shrt init installs a Claude Code skill, and the commands also run by hand. Needs Go 1.26 and buf. It speaks Connect today, not plain gRPC. MIT. This is not a new model.

projects.name: zeron
projects.description: A native control plane for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin and other coding agents.
projects.summary: 本機控制台，用嚟喺你部機管 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Devin 等編程 agent。桌面版有 macOS、Windows 同 Linux，唔使帳戶。無畫面只有 Linux 命令列。跨裝置同步要登入，讀寫權畀同一帳戶嘅裝置，只登你信得過嘅機。MIT。呢個唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local control plane for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin. The desktop app runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux with no account. Headless use is a Linux command line. Multi-device sync needs a login, and signed-in devices can read and write each other's files, so only sign in machines you trust. MIT. This is not a new model.

projects.name: dsh-agent-teams
projects.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent Teams 多智能体协作插件，支持多个 AI Agent 组成团队，协同完成复杂任务，实现任务分配、并行执行、成员通信与团队协作。 AgentTeams plugin for DeepSeek Harness
projects.summary: DeepSeek Harness 插件，用嚟把而家呢個工作階段變成隊長，喺宿主入面拆任務、派子 agent 同傳訊息。建議 Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 配插件 0.1.28，宿主仍然係 RC。模型係你自己接嘅，唔會畀你新模型。MIT。
projects.summary_en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the current session into a captain, splitting tasks, assigning sub-agents, and passing messages inside the host. The suggested pair is Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 with plugin 0.1.28, and the host is still a release candidate. Sub-agents use the model you already connected. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: EAC-design-world
projects.description: DeepSeek Harness 本地视频制作与设计插件：多轨剪辑、模板与设计体系、原生预览画布和真实文件导出
projects.summary: DeepSeek Harness 嘅本機影片同設計插件，用嚟喺你部機剪片、排模板、預覽同匯出。要 Node.js 22 同 FFmpeg 7。桌面錄影只得 Windows。轉錄同配音要用你自己嘅本機模型，程式唔會下載。匯出可以畀你續剪。v0.6.0 預覽，AGPL-3.0。呢個唔係新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A local video and design plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It edits, lays out templates, previews, and exports real files on your machine. It needs Node.js 22 and FFmpeg 7. Desktop recording is Windows only. Transcription and voiceover use a local model you download yourself; the program does not download one. Exports can be handed on for further editing. v0.6.0 preview, AGPL-3.0. This is not a new video model.

projects.name: stack-diagram
projects.description: Agent skill: describe your stack in a sentence, get an architecture diagram with official logos
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟用一句說話畫架構圖，圖入面用官方標誌。喺 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 同其他跟 agentskills.io 嘅 agent 用。用 npx skills 安裝。MIT。呢個只畫圖，唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that turns one sentence about your stack into an architecture diagram with official logos. It works in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents that follow agentskills.io. Install it with npx skills. MIT. It only draws the diagram and does not give you a new model.

projects.name: dream-loop
projects.description: Agent skill for impressive 3D visuals using Blender + image gen + subagent critic
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟做有畫面嘅遊戲、應用或場景。先叫圖像模型出目標圖，再喺你部機做出嚟，另一個子 agent 對住實拍提意見，做到滿意為止。要 agent 識睇圖同生圖，3D 要自己裝 Blender。作者只試過 Codex 嘅 GPT-6 Astra。MIT。呢個唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill for a game, app, or scene with strong visuals. An image model makes a target picture, the agent builds it on your machine, and another sub-agent compares a live screenshot until it is satisfied. The agent needs vision and image generation; custom 3D needs Blender installed by you. The author only tested GPT-6 Astra in Codex. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: qwen-audio-agent
projects.description: A realtime voice runtime that keeps Agents talking, working, and present.  Real-time Voice Runtime for AI Agents
projects.summary: 即時語音 runtime，用嚟喺 agent 做緊嘢嗰陣繼續傾偈。要 Node.js 22.22.2 或更新。語音同後端用你自己嘅 API key，預設接 Qwen Audio 3.1，亦可以接其他現成語音模型。Apache-2.0。呢個唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A realtime voice runtime so the conversation keeps going while an agent is working. It needs Node.js 22.22.2 or newer. Voice and the backend use your own API key. The default voice model is Qwen Audio 3.1, and other existing voice models can be connected. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: gpt_image_playground
projects.description: 支持 GPT Image、Gemini（Nano Banana）和 Grok 的图片生成与编辑工具
projects.summary: 網頁工具，用嚟喺瀏覽器出圖同改圖。呼叫 OpenAI gpt-image-2.5 或相容接口、fal.ai，同你匯入嘅 HTTP 供應商。金鑰係你自己嘅，歷史同參數只存喺本機。MIT。呢個係介面，唔會畀你新圖像模型。
projects.summary_en: A web tool for generating and editing images in the browser. It calls OpenAI gpt-image-2.5 or a compatible endpoint, fal.ai, and HTTP providers you import. The key is yours, and history and settings stay on your machine. MIT. This is an interface and does not give you a new image model.

projects.name: agentcraft
projects.description: Manage your real AI agents, using Minecraft as your interface!
projects.summary: Minecraft 介面，用嚟喺遊戲裡睇 Claude 或 Codex agent 改你嘅 repo。要 Minecraft Java、Java 25、Node 22 同 git。Agent 用你嘅 Claude API 或已登入 Codex。未撳 Merge 唔推送。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A Minecraft interface where Claude or Codex agents edit your repo inside the game. It needs Minecraft Java, Java 25, Node 22, and git. Agents use your Claude API access or a Codex login you already have. Nothing is pushed until you press Merge. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: pr-lens
projects.description: The fastest way to understand code
projects.summary: 工具同 skill，用嚟把 pull request 畫成架構同資料流圖，貼喺 PR 入面。GitHub App 唔使你嘅模型 key。skill 用你已有嘅 coding agent。CLI 同 Action 可以改用你自己嘅模型。要 Node 20.11 先至自己建。MIT。呢個唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A tool and skill that draws a pull request as architecture and data-flow diagrams and posts them on the pull request. The GitHub App does not need your model key. The skill uses the coding agent you already have. The CLI and Action can use your own model instead. Building it yourself needs Node 20.11 or newer. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: ste-zh
projects.description: Agent skill: 按 ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) 原则用中文向用户汇报结果
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟叫 agent 用簡化技術中文匯報：結論先行、附實證、狀態固定。借 ASD-STE100 嘅原則，只規範對你講嘅話，唔改程式、註解同 commit。未開就唔生效。繁體版喺 ste-zht。MIT。呢個唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that makes an agent report in simplified technical Chinese: conclusion first, with evidence, and a fixed status. It borrows the ASD-STE100 rules and only changes how the agent talks to you, not code, comments, or commits. It does nothing until you turn it on. The Traditional Chinese edition is ste-zht. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: EAC-Desktop
projects.description: Embracing All Creation (Desktop) — Dedicated to the Harmonious Coexistence of Hundreds of DSH Plugins / 揽尽万象（桌面版） —— 致力于让数百个DSH插件和谐共存
projects.summary: DeepSeek Harness 桌面工作台，用嚟喺一個視窗入面傾偈、睇檔案、跑工具同管插件。安裝包自帶 Node 同 dsh，一般唔使另裝。模型由你自己接嘅供應商呼叫。Windows 有 v6.0.0，Linux 同 macOS 係較舊包。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A DeepSeek Harness desktop workbench for chat, files, tools, and plugins in one window. The installer bundles Node and dsh, so a normal install does not need them separately. Models are called through the provider you connect. Windows has v6.0.0; the Linux and macOS packages are older. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Vibe-Research
projects.description: Vibe-Research：A 股、美股、港股的投研工作台 · 自选与持仓、每日复盘、产业资讯、产业研究、个股深挖、回测、研报库，168 个数据端点。支持 Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy 订阅或任意模型 API。 | A research workbench for China A-shares, US and HK stocks.
projects.summary: 投研工作台，用嚟喺你部機睇 A 股、美股同港股嘅自選、持倉、復盤、回測同研報。作者話有 168 個數據端點。AI 要用你自己嘅 Claude Code、Codex 或相容 API，唔接入都可以瀏覽。要 Node.js 22.18 同 Python 3.11。MIT。唔落單，唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A research workbench for China A-shares, US stocks, and Hong Kong stocks: watchlists, holdings, daily review, backtests, and research notes. The author lists 168 data endpoints, and the records stay on your machine. AI uses your own Claude Code, Codex, or a compatible API, and you can browse without connecting one. Needs Node.js 22.18 and Python 3.11. MIT. It does not place orders and does not give you a new model.

projects.name: SculptForge
projects.description: Free, open-source 3D sculpting for Linux, macOS and Windows: dense meshes, remeshing, painting, built-in AI (image/text to 3D), Send to Unreal, game-ready LODs, Gaussian splats and OpenUSD.
projects.summary: 開源雕塑軟件，用嚟喺 Linux、macOS 同 Windows 雕塑，亦處理 Gaussian splat。內置 AI 預設用 Pollinations 嘅 GPT-OSS 20B，離線用本地 Ollama。圖生 3D 可改你自己嘅 ComfyUI 或本機模型。GPL-3.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An open-source sculpting app for Linux, macOS, and Windows that also handles Gaussian splats. The built-in AI defaults to GPT-OSS 20B on Pollinations and uses local Ollama offline. Image-to-3D can use your own ComfyUI or a local model. GPL-3.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: J-Space-Cognition-Suite
projects.description: J-Space Cognition Suite — a model-agnostic inference-time control suite for deep reasoning, long-horizon work, verification, and recovery. Based on Anthropic's J-space global workspace research.
projects.summary: Agent skill 套件，用嚟喺推論時整理長任務嘅證據同檢查。要 Python 3.10 或更新，冇 pip 依賴。模型同工具由你嘅 host 提供，安裝本身唔會開 agent。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill suite that organizes evidence and checks for a long task at inference time. It needs Python 3.10 or newer and has no pip dependencies. The host you already use supplies the model and tools, and installing the files does not start an agent. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: univer-workspace
projects.description: Manage the Office content your agents create. An open-source, self-hosted workspace where people and AI agents edit, collaborate, and review changes. Built with Univer Office SDK.
projects.summary: 開源 Office 工作區，用嚟喺同一個 runtime 編表格、文件、簡報同畫板。Agent 喺隔離 worktree 改完，要你審過先合併。要 Node.js 24 或更新，模型 key 係你自己嘅。可以本機或自建。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An open-source Office workspace for sheets, documents, slides, and boards in one runtime. An agent edits in an isolated worktree, and you review the change before it is merged. It needs Node.js 24 or newer, and the model key is yours. Run it locally or on your own server. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: cinetic
projects.description: Cinematic launch films and motion design from code, directed by your coding agent.
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟叫 coding agent 用 Remotion 或 HyperFrames 做短片。支援 Claude Code、Codex 同 Cursor。要 Node 22、ffmpeg 6、Python 3.11 同 Chromium。片喺你嘅機渲。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that has a coding agent make a short film with Remotion or HyperFrames. It works in Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. You need Node 22, ffmpeg 6, Python 3.11, and Chromium. The film renders on your machine. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: SeeCode
projects.description: Animated, explorable diagrams for Claude and other coding agents, from a short JSON spec.
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟把短規格畫成可互動嘅動畫圖。一個 HTML 檔可以喺瀏覽器懸停、撳，再匯出 SVG、PNG、GIF 或 MP4。圖表數字讀 CSV 或 JSON，唔使經過模型。支援 Claude Code、Codex 同 Cursor。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that turns a short spec into an animated diagram you can explore. One HTML file can be hovered and clicked in the browser, then exported as SVG, PNG, GIF, or MP4. Chart numbers come from CSV or JSON and do not pass through the model. It works in Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: pinvou-agent
projects.description: Open-source desktop AI agent for tools, files, knowledge, workflows, and real deliverables.
projects.summary: 桌面 agent，用嚟喺 Windows、macOS 同 Linux 做檔案、知識庫同工作流。可以用本地 vLLM，或者任何 OpenAI 相容接口，key 係你自己嘅。語音模型要另下載。資料走唔走得出部機，視乎你開嘅模型。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A desktop agent for files, a knowledge base, and workflows on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It can use local vLLM or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and the key is yours. The speech model is a separate download. Whether data leaves the machine depends on the model you turn on. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: GPT-Image2-Skill
projects.description: GPT Image 2/2.5 prompt gallery, image prompt library, agentic skill, and CLI for OpenAI image generation/editing
projects.summary: 兩個 agent skill 加命令列，用嚟喺 Claude Code 或 Codex 叫 GPT Image 2 或 2.5 出圖同改圖，附提示圖庫。要 Python 3.11 同你自己嘅 OpenAI key。MIT。唔會畀你新圖像模型。
projects.summary_en: Two agent skills and a command-line tool that ask GPT Image 2 or 2.5 to generate and edit images from Claude Code or Codex, plus a prompt gallery. It needs Python 3.11 and your own OpenAI key. MIT. This does not give you a new image model.

projects.name: mcode-stack
projects.description: The workflows and skills the MiniMax Code team uses to build MiniMax Code. Open source, install and use.
projects.summary: Skill 包，用嚟把 MiniMax Code 團隊日常用嘅工作流裝入 MiniMax Code、Claude Code 或 Codex。每份係 SKILL.md，唔係提示合集，裝喺你部機。模型仍然係你已登入嘅 agent。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill pack that installs the workflows the MiniMax Code team uses into MiniMax Code, Claude Code, or Codex. Each piece is a SKILL.md, not a prompt collection, and it installs on your machine. The model is still the agent you already signed in to. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: invisible_playwright_mcp
projects.description: Playwright MCP server undetected by anti-bots and captchas: AI agent browses the web on anti-detect stealth Firefox, Python, undetected browser automation, scraping, computer use.
projects.summary: MCP，用嚟畀 Claude Code 或 Codex 喺你部機開 Firefox，撳頁同讀內容。用 uv 裝。專案想減少網站當佢係機器人嘅機會。MIT。呢個只係瀏覽器工具，唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: An MCP server that lets Claude Code or Codex open Firefox on your machine, click through pages, and read them. Install it with uv. The project is built to make sites less likely to treat the browser as a bot. MIT. This is only a browser tool, not a new model.

projects.name: ripwire
projects.description: The ripgrep of AI context: a zero-dependency C++23 CLI + MCP server for coding agents. Find what you want without reading the repo, then check you built what you meant — blast radius, tests-to-run, quality deltas. Signatures at 74.7% fewer bytes than bodies; every guess labelled, every loss published. Paddle out with a map.
projects.summary: 本機命令列同可選 MCP，用嚟畀 coding agent 喺讀成個 repo 之前先搵到要睇嘅位。離線跑，冇 runtime 依賴。安裝亦會教 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cursor 幾時叫佢。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local command-line tool and optional MCP server that helps a coding agent find what to read before it opens the whole repo. It runs offline and has no runtime dependencies. Installing it also teaches Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor when to call it. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: aid-studio
projects.description: 开源AI漫剧、AI短剧、AI电影与AI漫画创作平台，支持剧本、角色场景、智能分镜、图片与视频生成、配音及成片预览，多模型接入，可自行部署。预：无限画布、导演台。
projects.summary: 自建平台，用嚟喺你部伺服器做 AI 漫劇、短劇同漫畫：劇本、分鏡、圖、片同配音。文字、圖像、影片同語音都要你自己嘅模型 key。可以用 Docker 或 systemd。MIT。唔會畀你新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted platform for AI motion comics, short dramas, and comics: scripts, storyboards, images, video, and voiceover. Text, image, video, and speech all use model keys you provide. Deploy it with Docker or systemd. MIT. This does not give you a new video model.

projects.name: ai-manju-skills
projects.description: 21 个题材的 AI 漫剧全流程 Skill：一句点子生成企划案、资产图提示词、分集剧本、分镜与视频提示词。可用于 Claude Code、WorkBuddy、DeepSeek
projects.summary: 21 個題材嘅 skill，用嚟由一句點子寫企劃、資產圖提示詞、分集劇本、分鏡同影片提示詞。可以喺 Claude Code、WorkBuddy 用，或者貼去 DeepSeek。冇依賴，唔會自己出片。MIT。唔會畀你新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: Twenty-one genre skills that turn one idea into a plan, asset-image prompts, episode scripts, storyboards, and video prompts. Use them in Claude Code or WorkBuddy, or paste them into DeepSeek. There are no dependencies, and they do not render the film. MIT. This does not give you a new video model.

projects.name: skills
projects.description: Skills for AI coding agents.
projects.summary: Agent skill Stageshow，用嚟叫你嘅 coding agent 喺 React 做假產品界面：靜態圖、功能卡、游標示範同 bento。可以拍低結果畀 agent 檢查。用 npx skills 裝。skill 檔係 MIT。唔係新模型。
projects.summary_en: The Stageshow agent skill asks your coding agent to build fake product UI in React: stills, feature cards, cursor demos, and bento grids. It can film the result so the agent can check its work. Install it with npx skills. The skill file is MIT. This is not a new model.

projects.name: Octopus-SI-OS
projects.description: A self-evolving agentic OS. A new architecture for agent execution, built on operating-system principles, with the harness as a path toward superintelligence.
projects.summary: 研究預覽嘅 agent 系統，用嚟喺 macOS 14 或更新跑 Codex 一類 agent，可以讀寫檔、用瀏覽器同桌面。要 Node 24、穩定 Rust 同 ChatGPT 帳戶。作者話而家模型唔會自己主動，普通寫程式同 Codex CLI 差唔多。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A research-preview agent system that runs agents such as Codex on macOS 14 or newer. They can read and write files and use the browser and desktop. It needs Node 24, stable Rust, and a ChatGPT account. The author says current models do not take initiative, and ordinary coding is close to Codex CLI. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: OpenChatCut
projects.description: Open-source, local-first conversational AI video editor with a professional multi-track timeline, Agent Skills, MCP integration, and Remotion rendering.
projects.summary: 本機影片編輯器，用嚟喺多軌時間線改片。Codex、Claude Code 或內置 agent 都可以改，改動留喺工程入面。有桌面安裝包，自己建要 Node.js 24。項目同素材預設留喺你嘅機。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A local video editor for cutting on a multitrack timeline. Codex, Claude Code, or the built-in agent can edit, and the changes stay in the project. Desktop installers are available; building it needs Node.js 24. Projects and media stay on your machine by default. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a new video model.

projects.name: kotlin-footguns
projects.description: Battle-tested agent skills mapping the footguns of Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform and the desktop JVM — mined from a production music app, not from documentation.
projects.summary: 十個 agent skill 加一個掃描器，用嚟提醒 Kotlin、Compose Multiplatform 同桌面 JVM 嘅坑。作者話係由佢嘅音樂 app 實戰整理，唔係抄文件。用 npx skills 裝，喺 Claude Code 等 agent 用。GPL-3.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: Ten agent skills plus a scanner that warn about traps in Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform, and the desktop JVM. The author says they were mined from his production music app, not copied from docs. Install with npx skills for agents such as Claude Code. GPL-3.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: framekeeper
projects.description: A local plugin for image-heavy chats in Codex, Claude Code and other agents: earlier images stop going out with every message, and the model fetches the one it needs by its ID, also after compaction.
projects.summary: Agent 插件，用嚟管理對話入面嘅圖：舊圖唔會每次都再上傳，模型要嗰張先拉返嚟。支援 Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy 同 Gemini CLI。圖仍然喺你已有嘅模型處理。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent plugin that manages images in a chat: earlier images are not uploaded again every turn, and the model pulls one back when it needs it. It works with Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and Gemini CLI. The images still go to the model you already use. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: LiveStream-Agent-Studio
projects.description: 面向抖音直播电商的 Windows 本地 AI Agent Studio，贯通主播发现、直播洞察、直播复盘与短视频内容编导的统一智能工作流。
projects.summary: Windows 本機工作台，用嚟喺你部機做抖音直播電商：搵主播、拆直播、復盤同短片編導。要你自己嘅阿里雲百煉 key。v0.2.0 beta，啟動器未商業簽名。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local Windows workspace for Douyin livestream commerce: find hosts, break down a stream, review it, and plan short videos. It needs your own Alibaba Cloud Model Studio key. v0.2.0 beta, and the launcher is not commercially signed. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: ai-security-tool
projects.description: 🛡️ Free open-source AI-powered security terminal & vulnerability scanner (CVE, SBOM). Supports SSH, SFTP, RDP, VNC, Serial, and 12+ autonomous AI agents (DeepSeek, OpenAI) for automated security workflows, CTF & DevSecOps. Cross-platform & Web UI.
projects.summary: 跨平台終端同供應鏈掃描器，用嚟喺你部機查已知漏洞同 SBOM，亦可以開 SSH、SFTP、RDP 同 VNC。AI 要用你自己嘅 DeepSeek 或 OpenAI key。MIT。呢個唔係攻擊教學，唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A cross-platform terminal and supply-chain scanner for checking known vulnerabilities and an SBOM on your machine. It can also open SSH, SFTP, RDP, and VNC sessions. The AI needs your own DeepSeek or OpenAI key. MIT. This is not an attack guide and does not give you a new model.

projects.name: claude-motion
projects.description: A motion design toolkit for coding agents.
projects.summary: 動效 skill，用嚟教你嘅 coding agent 喺 Remotion 做片、對住幀自查，同用 Python 標準庫出聲。Claude Code 同 Cursor 開箱有 skill。要 Node 20、Python 3 同 ffmpeg。MIT。唔會畀你新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A motion-design skill that teaches your coding agent to make a film in Remotion, review its own frames, and synthesize sound with the Python standard library. Claude Code and Cursor include the skills. It needs Node 20, Python 3, and ffmpeg. MIT. This does not give you a new video model.

projects.name: better-harness
projects.description: An open-source Harness Engineering platform for coding agents—define harnesses as code, run controlled experiments, inspect evidence, and compare outcomes. Turn task evidence into actionable team and organization insights.
projects.summary: 插件，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 入面睇工作循環、證據同下一步。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 host。唔包模型，證據不足會寫明。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A plugin that looks at the work loop, evidence, and next steps inside the coding agent you already use. It supports hosts such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. It does not include a model, and missing evidence stays explicit. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: shepherdr
projects.description: Run many coding agents across machines from a phone, tablet or desktop. A herdr plugin.
projects.summary: herdr-core 嘅控制台，用嚟喺手機、平板或電腦睇多部機上嘅 coding agent。每個任務喺自己嘅 git worktree 跑，合併前有人審。要 herdr-core 0.1.14、Bun，同 macOS 或 Linux。用 Tailscale 私網，唔公開。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A control panel for herdr-core so you can watch coding agents across machines from a phone, tablet, or computer. Each task runs in its own git worktree and is reviewed before it merges. It needs herdr-core 0.1.14, Bun, and macOS or Linux. Tailscale keeps it on your private network. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Tov
projects.description: A TypeScript-shaped language built for coding agents. It compiles to small, fast native binaries.
projects.summary: Tov 係一種形狀似 TypeScript 嘅語言，用嚟喺 macOS arm64 或 Linux 編譯成細小本機程式。而家係 0.1.0，Windows 未支援。自己編譯要 Rust 1.95 同 C 編譯器，TypeScript 亦未完全對齊。MIT。呢個係編譯器，唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: Tov is a TypeScript-shaped language that compiles to a small native program. Version 0.1.0 runs on macOS arm64 and Linux, and Windows is not supported yet. Building it yourself needs Rust 1.95 and a C compiler, and TypeScript parity is still incomplete. MIT. This is a compiler. It does not give you a new model.

projects.name: story-to-handdrawn-video
projects.description: Agent skill: convert Chinese story copy or ordered images into a hand-drawn diary-comic animation (silent MP4 picture track).
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺 Codex、Claude Code 等 agent 將中文故事或有序圖片做成 3:4 靜音手繪 MP4。要 Node 20、Python 3.10、FFmpeg 同瀏覽器。新圖靠 agent 嘅生圖工具，預設唔係離線模型。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that turns a Chinese story or ordered images into a 3:4 silent hand-drawn MP4 inside Codex, Claude Code, or a similar agent. It needs Node 20, Python 3.10, FFmpeg, and a browser. New pictures come from the agent's image tool, and the default path is not an offline model. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: labs-OO-Agents
projects.description: NVIDIA Object Oriented Agents: the Pythonic way to build AI Agents.
projects.summary: Python 框架，用嚟喺 class 入面寫 AI agent。有省略號嘅方法交畀模型，模型要你自己嘅 API key。要 Python 3.12 或 3.13。原生 Windows 唔完整，生成程式要放喺沙盒。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A Python framework for writing an AI agent as a class. Fields hold state, and a method whose body is an ellipsis is handed to the model. The model needs your own API key. It needs Python 3.12 or 3.13. Native Windows is incomplete, and generated code should run in a sandbox. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: doop
projects.description: The open-source alternative to Paper.design. A multiplayer design canvas where humans and AI agents design together, live. MCP built in.
projects.summary: 多人設計畫布，用嚟喺瀏覽器同 AI agent 一齊改畫面。內置 MCP，可接 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor。自己架要用 Bun 同 Node，內置 agent 要你自己嘅模型帳戶。版本 0.12.0。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A multiplayer design canvas where you and an AI agent edit frames together in the browser. It has a built-in MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar clients. Self-hosting needs Bun and Node. The built-in agent uses the model account you connect. Version 0.12.0. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: RustXNG
projects.description: Self-hosted metasearch and grounding engine for AI agents, based on SearXNG. Rust, JSON API, optional page text.
projects.summary: 本機元搜尋引擎，用嚟喺你部機幫 AI agent 搜網頁。以 SearXNG 做底，用 Rust 寫，可選拎頁面文字。搜尋字會送到你揀嘅上游引擎。預設只聽 127.0.0.1。有現成二進制，自己編譯要 Rust 1.88。版本 0.26.0。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local metasearch engine that lets an AI agent search the web on your machine. It is a Rust rewrite of SearXNG and can optionally fetch page text. Search terms go to the upstream engines you select. It listens only on 127.0.0.1 by default. Release binaries are published, and building it yourself needs Rust 1.88. Version 0.26.0. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Tourmind-Booking-Skills
projects.description: AI agent skills for end-to-end hotel and flight booking—compare live hotel rates across leading OTAs and suppliers, search and verify real-time airfares worldwide, book stays and flights, and manage reservations, hotel cancellations, and payments via the TourMind API.
projects.summary: 兩份 agent skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 agent 搜酒店同機票，再經 TourMind 落單同付款。搜尋可以先唔用 Token，核實、訂房同付款要 TourMind 帳戶。唔包庫存，亦唔係離線訂票。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: Two agent skills that search hotels and flights inside the agent you already use, then book and pay through TourMind. Search can start without a token. Verification, booking, and payment need a TourMind account. It does not include inventory, and it is not an offline booking desk. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: open-design-agent-kit
projects.description: Make posters, social posts, slides and landing pages in the coding agent or chat you already use (Copilot, Claude, Codex, Cursor), with 198 design systems, checks and PDF/PNG/PowerPoint export.
projects.summary: 設計 skill 套件，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 出簡報、網頁同原型。支援 Copilot、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor。用 agent 自己嘅模型，唔使額外 API key，亦冇獨立程式。成品係 repo 檔案。版本 0.1.0。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A design skill kit that makes pitch decks, web pages, and prototypes inside the coding agent you already use. It supports Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. It uses that agent's own model, needs no extra API key, and has no separate app. The result is files in your repo. Version 0.1.0. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: LongHorizon-Harness
projects.description: The long-horizon computer-use harness. Run AI agents across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods while preserving task state and making reliable progress on complex workflows. Features fresh-context execution, durable verified state, independent auditing, recoverable progress, and native Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw integration.
projects.summary: 執行循環，用嚟喺 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 或 DeepSeek Harness 上做長任務。每步用新上下文，核實過先至當進度。要 Python 3.10 同你已有嘅 agent。版本 0.1.8，Windows 仍有限制。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An execution loop that runs long tasks on Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or DeepSeek Harness. Each step starts with a fresh context, and only a checked result counts as progress. It needs Python 3.10 and the agent you already have. Version 0.1.8 still has Windows limits. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: memmy-agent
projects.description: 🍙  A personal AI agent & local memory hub for all AI agents, gives every AI one shared, fully controlled memory and persistent context — all AI remember the same you. Now supports Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent etc.
projects.summary: 本機記憶中心，用嚟喺 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 agent 之間共用同一份記憶。桌面 app 為主。註冊送試用 token，用完要你自己嘅 API key。CLI 只收指定 Node，而且要 Linux systemd。版本 1.2.401。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local memory hub that shares one memory across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar agents. The desktop app is the main way to use it. Sign-up trial tokens run out, and then it needs your own API key. The CLI accepts only specific Node versions and needs Linux systemd. Version 1.2.401. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Wake
projects.description: All your AI agent sessions in one place — browse, search, resume. Rust + GPUI.
projects.summary: 桌面程式，用嚟喺一部機睇晒 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 agent 嘅對話，再喺終端續跑。只讀本地紀錄，唔上傳。macOS 14 先至穩定，Linux 同 Windows 係測試版。版本 0.10.2。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A desktop app that gathers Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agent sessions on one machine, then resumes them in a terminal. It reads local history and does not upload it. macOS 14 is the stable platform. Linux and Windows are beta. Version 0.10.2. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: icm-architect
projects.description: Agent skill: design any process, idea, or problem into an ICM workspace (folder structure as agent architecture), or restructure an existing folder into one
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Codex、Claude Code 或 Cursor 將一件事拆成資料夾。每個資料夾係步驟或狀態，人都可以打開睇。可選 Python 3 標準庫腳本。唔包編排程式。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that turns a task into a folder layout inside Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor. Each folder is a step or a piece of state a person can open. Optional Python 3 standard-library scripts can check the result. It does not include an orchestrator. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: guizang-social-card-skill
projects.description: 🪧 Claude Code / Codex skill — generate Xiaohongshu carousels & WeChat 21:9+1:1 cover pairs. Editorial × Swiss visual systems, 28 layouts, 10 themes, single-file HTML → PNG. 小红书图文 + 公众号封面对
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺 Claude Code 或 Codex 做小紅書圖文同公眾號封面對。單檔 HTML，再用 Playwright 出 PNG。要 Node。用你 agent 已有嘅模型，冇圖先至搵圖庫。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that makes Xiaohongshu carousels and WeChat cover pairs inside Claude Code or Codex. It writes one HTML file and renders PNGs with Playwright. It needs Node. It uses the model your agent already has, and it looks up a photo library only when you did not supply images. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: fable-method
projects.description: The Fable Workflow: how Claude Fable 5 worked, distilled into skills any model can run, with the eval that keeps it honest. Think / act / prove.
projects.summary: 一組 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅模型行 think、act、prove 流程，並附評測。以 Claude Code plugin 1.4.0 安裝。唔包含 Fable 本身。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill pack that runs a think, act, and prove workflow on the model you already have, with an eval beside it. Install it as Claude Code plugin 1.4.0. It does not include Fable. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: itsaplan
projects.description: ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Open-source, self-hosted alternative to Linear and Plane. Project management and issue tracking where teams and AI agents work side by side to plan and ship products.
projects.summary: 自託管嘅項目板，用嚟喺同一塊板俾人同 AI agent 一齊跟 issue。有 REST、webhook 同 MCP。自己架要用 Bun 或 Docker。唔包模型。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted project board where people and AI agents follow issues on the same board. It exposes REST, webhooks, and MCP. Self-hosting needs Bun or Docker. It does not include a model. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: website-rebuild-skill
projects.description: 复刻网站的 Agent Skill：抓只读镜像、从压缩代码逐行还原、自动比对验收。An agent skill that mirrors a website, rebuilds it from the minified code, and verifies the result with automated diffs.
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 對住網站做只讀鏡像，再還原成可改檔並自動對圖。要 Node 22。成品留喺你部機。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that takes a read-only mirror of a website inside the coding agent you already use, rebuilds it into editable files, and checks the result with a visual diff. The files stay on your machine. It needs Node 22. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: tty7
projects.description: The terminal that outlives its window. Shells survive quitting the app, agents can drive other agents, and remote machines work the same way. Pure Rust, GPU-rendered.
projects.summary: 終端工作台，用嚟喺 macOS、Windows 或 Linux 留住 shell，關咗視窗都仲喺。你已有嘅 agent 可以驅動另一個，遠端機同一套。純 Rust。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A terminal workbench that keeps shells alive on macOS, Windows, or Linux after you close the window. An agent you already have can drive another one, including on a remote machine. It is pure Rust. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: WenetSpeech-Yue
projects.description: A Large-scale Cantonese Speech Corpus with Multi-dimensional Annotation
projects.summary: 大型粵語語料同模型，用嚟喺本機做粵語辨認同合成。約 21800 小時，附 CosyVoice2-Yue 同 ZoengJyutGaai 微調。要 Python 3.10，權重另外下載。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免安裝嘅 app。
projects.summary_en: A large Cantonese corpus and model set for recognition and synthesis on your machine. It is about 21,800 hours and includes CosyVoice2-Yue plus the ZoengJyutGaai fine-tune. It needs Python 3.10, and the weights download separately. Apache-2.0. This does not give you an install-free app.

projects.name: SenseVoice
projects.description: Open-source SenseVoiceSmall model for Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Japanese, and Korean ASR, language ID, emotion recognition, and audio event detection.
projects.summary: 語音理解模型，用嚟喺本機做你嘅語音轉文字、語種同情緒標記。SenseVoiceSmall 支援粵語、普通話、英日韓。情緒標籤只係聲學線索。MIT。呢個係辨認，唔會畀你合成聲音。
projects.summary_en: A speech-understanding model that transcribes audio on your machine and marks language and emotion. SenseVoiceSmall supports Cantonese, Mandarin, English, Japanese, and Korean. MIT. This recognizes speech. It does not synthesize a voice.

projects.name: CosyVoice
projects.description: Multi-lingual large voice generation model, providing inference, training and deployment full-stack ability.
projects.summary: 多語言語音生成，用嚟喺你嘅參考聲做零樣本克隆。覆蓋多種中文方言，包括廣東話，亦可以跨語言。主線而家去到第三代。要自己下載權重。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你一個固定香港講者。
projects.summary_en: Multilingual speech generation that does zero-shot cloning from a reference clip. It covers many Chinese dialects, including Cantonese, and it can cross languages. You download the weights yourself. Apache-2.0. This does not give you one fixed Hong Kong speaker.

projects.name: GPT-SoVITS
projects.description: 1 min voice data can also be used to train a good TTS model! (few shot voice cloning)
projects.summary: 少量樣本語音克隆，用嚟喺本機用你自己嘅參考聲。約五秒可零樣本，約一分鐘可微調。語言表有粵語。要 GPU 先順，CPU 會好慢。底模要另外下載。MIT。唔會畀你固定講者。
projects.summary_en: Few-shot voice cloning that uses a reference clip of your own on your machine. About five seconds can do zero-shot, and about one minute can fine-tune. Cantonese is in the language list. A GPU makes it practical. MIT. This does not give you a fixed speaker.

projects.name: VoxCPM
projects.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
projects.summary: 本機 TTS，用嚟喺短參考聲克隆你嘅音色，亦可以用文字描述設計新聲。VoxCPM2 約 2B，輸出 48kHz，中文方言包括粵語。要自己跑模型。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免安裝服務。
projects.summary_en: A local TTS that clones a voice from a short reference clip, or designs a new voice from a text description. VoxCPM2 is about 2B parameters, outputs 48 kHz, and its Chinese dialects include Cantonese. You run the model yourself. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a hosted service.

projects.name: JyutVoice
projects.description: NAR TTS for Cantonese
projects.summary: 粵語 TTS，用嚟喺你嘅參考聲做粵語、普通話或英文合成。以 CosyVoice2 解碼器做遷移，要 Python 3.11 同另外下載權重。專案仲細。MIT。唔會畀你雲端服務。
projects.summary_en: A Cantonese TTS that synthesizes Cantonese, Mandarin, or English from a reference clip. It transfers from a CosyVoice2 decoder. It needs Python 3.11 and a separate weight download. The project is still small. MIT. This does not give you a cloud service.

projects.name: whisper
projects.description: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
projects.summary: 通用語音轉文字，用嚟喺本機將你嘅錄音變成文字。支援多種語言，粵語唔係專門目標，長錄音都要自己切。要自己下載權重，模型分幾種體積。MIT。呢個係辨認，唔會畀你新聲音。
projects.summary_en: General speech-to-text that turns a recording into text on your machine. It supports many languages, and Cantonese is not a dedicated target. You download the weights yourself. MIT. This recognizes speech. It does not give you a new voice.

projects.name: TTS
projects.description: 🐸💬 - a deep learning toolkit for Text-to-Speech, battle-tested in research and production
projects.summary: 語音合成工具箱，用嚟喺研究或產品訓練同推理你揀嘅 TTS。有多種模型同聲線，權重同訓練數據都要自己準備好。MPL-2.0。唔係粵語專用，亦唔會自動畀你香港口音。
projects.summary_en: A speech-synthesis toolkit for training and running TTS in research or a product. It includes several models and voices, and you choose the weights. MPL-2.0. It is not a Cantonese specialist, and it does not automatically give you a Hong Kong accent.

projects.name: ChatTTS
projects.description: A generative speech model for daily dialogue.
projects.summary: 對話向語音合成，用嚟喺本機生成日常對白。程式係 AGPL-3.0，放出嘅模型權重係 CC-BY-NC，唔可以商用。唔係粵語模型，聲線亦係隨機。唔會畀你克隆指定人聲。
projects.summary_en: Dialogue speech synthesis that generates everyday conversation on your machine. The code is AGPL-3.0. The released model weights are CC-BY-NC, so they are not for commercial use. It is not a Cantonese model. This does not clone a named person.

projects.name: Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI
projects.description: Easily train a good VC model with voice data <= 10 mins!
projects.summary: 變聲器，用嚟喺本機用約十分鐘乾淨人聲訓練你嘅音色，再轉唱或轉講。底模來自 VCTK。建議先分開人聲再訓練。有網頁介面。MIT。唔係粵語合成器，亦唔會畀你文字轉語音。
projects.summary_en: A voice converter that trains a timbre on your machine from about ten minutes of clean speech, then converts singing or speech. The base model comes from VCTK. It has a web UI. MIT. It is not a Cantonese synthesizer, and it does not turn text into speech.

projects.name: OpenVoice
projects.description: Instant voice cloning by MIT and MyShell. Audio foundation model.
projects.summary: 即時音色克隆，用嚟喺短參考聲抽出你嘅音色，再配風格控制。V2 原生有中文，唔係專為粵語。參考聲三至十秒最穩妥。MIT，可以商用。要自己跑。唔會畀你香港口音成品。
projects.summary_en: Instant timbre cloning that takes a voice color from a short reference clip and adds style control. V2 includes Chinese natively, and it is not built for Cantonese. MIT, including commercial use. You run it yourself. This does not ship a finished Hong Kong accent.

projects.name: faster-whisper
projects.description: Faster Whisper transcription with CTranslate2
projects.summary: Whisper 嘅更快實作，用嚟喺本機用 CTranslate2 做語音轉文字。速度快過原版，粵語仍然唔係專門目標，模型要自己落。量化可以行 CPU。MIT。唔會畀你合成聲音。
projects.summary_en: A faster Whisper implementation that transcribes speech on your machine with CTranslate2. It is quicker than the original, and Cantonese is still not a dedicated target. MIT. This does not synthesize a voice.

projects.name: audiocraft
projects.description: Audiocraft is a library for audio processing and generation with deep learning. It features the state-of-the-art EnCodec audio compressor / tokenizer, along with MusicGen, a simple and controllable music generation LM with textual and melodic conditioning.
projects.summary: 音樂同音效生成庫，用嚟喺你嘅文字或旋律條件生成 MusicGen 同 AudioGen。程式係 MIT，權重係 CC-BY-NC，唔可以商用。唔係人聲克隆。唔會畀你粵語 TTS。
projects.summary_en: A music and sound generation library that runs MusicGen and AudioGen from text or a melody. The code is MIT. The weights are CC-BY-NC, so they are not for commercial use. It is not voice cloning, and it does not give you Cantonese TTS.

projects.name: FunASR
projects.description: Open-source speech recognition toolkit for training, inference, streaming ASR, VAD, punctuation, speaker diarization pipelines, and OpenAI-compatible/MCP serving.
projects.summary: 語音辨認工具箱，用嚟喺本機處理你嘅錄音：串起 VAD、ASR、標點同講者分離，亦支援串流。MIT。粵語要另揀模型，例如 SenseVoice。呢個套件唔會自動畀你粵語聲線。
projects.summary_en: A speech-recognition toolkit that chains VAD, ASR, punctuation, and speaker diarization on your machine, including streaming. MIT. Cantonese needs a separate model such as SenseVoice. This toolkit does not automatically give you a Cantonese voice.

projects.name: tortoise-tts
projects.description: A multi-voice TTS system trained with an emphasis on quality
projects.summary: 偏重音質嘅多聲線 TTS，用嚟喺本機慢慢生成語音。Apache-2.0。主要唔係粵語，亦唔係即時克隆，一段短句都可以好慢。要自己跑權重，你要自己等。唔會畀你香港口音。
projects.summary_en: A multi-voice TTS that favors quality and generates speech slowly on your machine. Apache-2.0. It is not mainly Cantonese, and it is not real time. You run the weights yourself. This does not give you a Hong Kong accent.

projects.name: F5-TTS
projects.description: Official code for "F5-TTS: A Fairytaler that Fakes Fluent and Faithful Speech with Flow Matching"
projects.summary: 流程匹配 TTS，用嚟喺你嘅參考聲做零樣本語音合成。程式係 MIT，預訓練權重係 CC-BY-NC，唔可以商用。主要係中英，其他語言要自己試。唔會畀你商用權重。
projects.summary_en: A flow-matching TTS that does zero-shot synthesis from a reference clip. The code is MIT. The pretrained weights are CC-BY-NC, so they are not for commercial use. It is mainly Chinese and English, not a Cantonese specialist. This does not give you commercial weights.

projects.name: YuE
projects.description: YuE2: frontier music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic music editing.
projects.summary: 音樂生成模型，用嚟喺你嘅歌詞同風格計劃出歌。YuE2 亦可以零樣本翻唱同改歌。要自己跑，顯存要求高。歌詞可以係中文。Apache-2.0。呢個係音樂，唔會畀你粵語語音合成。
projects.summary_en: A music model that plans a song from lyrics and style. YuE2 can also do a zero-shot cover and edit a track. You run it yourself. Apache-2.0. This is music. It does not give you Cantonese speech synthesis.

projects.name: kokoro
projects.description: https://hf.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M
projects.summary: 約 82M 嘅細 TTS，用嚟喺本機低成本出聲，適合 CPU。英文為主，其他語言要對返聲線。Apache-2.0。唔係粵語模型，要自己下載權重。唔會畀你克隆香港講者。
projects.summary_en: A small TTS of about 82M parameters for low-cost speech on your machine. Apache-2.0. It is not a Cantonese model, and you download the weights yourself. This does not clone a Hong Kong speaker.

projects.name: piper1-gpl
projects.description: Fast and local neural text-to-speech engine
projects.summary: 本機神經 TTS，用嚟喺 CPU 快速讀出你嘅文字。現用版本係 GPL-3.0。聲線要另外下載，espeak 負責音素，預設冇粵語。你要自己裝。唔會畀你克隆人聲。
projects.summary_en: A local neural TTS that reads text quickly on a CPU. The current line is GPL-3.0. Voices are downloaded separately, and Cantonese is not a default voice. This does not clone a person.

projects.name: ACE-Step
projects.description: ACE-Step: A Step Towards Music Generation Foundation Model
projects.summary: 音樂基礎模型，用嚟喺你嘅文字條件生成音樂。Apache-2.0。要自己跑權重，出嚟係一段音樂檔，唔係人聲對白，亦唔包歌手庫。呢個係作曲向工具，唔會畀你粵語講故。
projects.summary_en: A music foundation model that generates music from a text condition. Apache-2.0. You run the weights yourself. This is for composition. It does not tell a story in Cantonese.

projects.name: trading-terminal
projects.description: Self-hosted AI trading terminal for Hyperliquid: chart read in, validated Freqtrade/Nautilus-Trader strategy out, deployed live.
projects.summary: 自託管嘅 Hyperliquid 終端，用嚟喺圖上畫你嘅看法，再寫 Freqtrade 策略。自己跑要 Superior Trade API、OpenRouter key 同 Node 20.9。預覽圖唔包完整 TradingView。會落真單。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted Hyperliquid terminal that turns a drawing on your chart into a Freqtrade strategy. Your own copy still needs the Superior Trade API, an OpenRouter key, and Node 20.9. The preview chart does not include full TradingView. It can place real orders. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: AnyModelBot
projects.description: 🤖 Open-source, local-first alternative to Grok Bot, OpenAI dots and Claude Duet. Your own AI bots on any model: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and 70+ more through one Modelflare key. Reach them in the app, WeChat or Feishu; they remember you, work in the background, run commands and use your computer. Pay per use.
projects.summary: 本機優先嘅桌面 agent，用嚟喺 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 開住 bot。模型要經 Modelflare 帳戶按量計，請求會過佢哋部機，其餘留喺你部機。v0.1.19。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local-first desktop agent that keeps a bot running on Windows, macOS, or Linux. Models come through a Modelflare account and are billed by use, and those requests pass through their service. Everything else stays on your machine. v0.1.19. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: yovoice
projects.description: Open-source local AI audio & music studio for macOS & Windows. TTS, voice cloning, songs with lyrics, and multi-track scores — 100% offline, zero API fees.
projects.summary: 本機聲音同音樂工作室，用嚟喺你部機做語音、克隆同作曲。macOS 14 要 Apple 晶片，Windows 同 Linux 係 x64。模型要另外下載，部分權重唔可以商用。v0.5.0。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A local voice and music studio for speech, cloning, and songs on your machine. macOS 14 needs Apple silicon. Windows and Linux are x64. Models download separately, and some weights are not for commercial use. v0.5.0. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: Lampline
projects.description: Build AI phone agents on your own computer and test every change with an AI caller. Open source, runs free with no API keys, cents per call with your own keys. Imports Dialogflow CX.
projects.summary: 電話 agent 工作室，用嚟喺你部機寫同測試電話 agent。本地測試可以冇 API key，真模型要你自己嘅 key，真電話要線路。附 coding agent skill。v0.4.1。Apache-2.0。唔係粵語聲線，亦唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A phone-agent studio for writing and testing phone agents on your machine. Local tests can run without an API key. A real model needs your own key, and a real call needs a phone line. It also ships a coding-agent skill. v0.4.1. Apache-2.0. It is not a Cantonese voice, and it does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Ming-3.0-tts
projects.description: Ming-3.0-tts is an open-source TTS model family with 0.5B dense and 7.9B-A1.3B MoE variants, supporting multilingual speech, voice cloning, voice design, and natural-language control.
projects.summary: 多語言 TTS，用嚟喺本機克隆或設計你嘅聲音，語言包括粵語。有 0.5B 同 MoE 細版，權重要另外下載，建議用 NVIDIA GPU。粵語聲線相似度追唔上 CosyVoice2-Yue。MIT。唔會畀你免安裝 app。
projects.summary_en: A multilingual TTS that clones or designs a voice on your machine, and Cantonese is one of the languages. It has a 0.5B model and a smaller MoE. Weights download separately, and an NVIDIA GPU is the practical path. Cantonese speaker similarity trails CosyVoice2-Yue. MIT. This does not give you an install-free app.

projects.name: AgentVerse-OS
projects.description: Personal cloud OS for a developer and their AI agents on a single server. One-command install on Ubuntu, then everything in the browser: a windowed desktop, isolated workspaces with VS Code, Claude Code and Codex, a store of 944 self-hosted apps, backups and updates. Access only via Tailscale, nothing exposed to the internet. Rust core, Svelte UI.
projects.summary: 個人雲端桌面，用嚟喺一部 Ubuntu 22.04 伺服器跑你已有嘅 coding agent。要 Tailscale 先入到，alpha 0.2，而家得一個使用者。唔包含模型。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A personal cloud desktop that runs coding agents you already have on one Ubuntu 22.04 server. You reach it through Tailscale. It is alpha 0.2 and currently has a single user. It does not include a model. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: dscode
projects.description: A DeepSeek coding agent harness: persistent shell, Ultra subagents, auto approval, Chrome MCP and session telemetry
projects.summary: 終端 coding agent，用嚟喺 macOS 14 或 glibc Linux 寫程式，session 之間可以交功課。唔支援 Windows。要你自己嘅模型帳戶。v0.7.54。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A terminal coding agent for writing code on macOS 14 or glibc Linux, where sessions can hand work to each other. Windows is not supported. You bring your own model account. v0.7.54. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: claudemy
projects.description: Claudemy: an open-source alternative to Udemy and Coursera. Give Claude a topic, it researches the web and builds a course of 2-minute audio lessons with cited sources. A free Claude Code skill.
projects.summary: Claude Code skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Claude 做約十二課、每課兩分鐘嘅語音課。要 Python 3 同 ffmpeg。自然聲要 ElevenLabs key，冇就用 macOS 內置聲。v0.3.2。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code skill that builds about twelve two-minute audio lessons on a topic you name, using the Claude account you already have. It needs Python 3 and ffmpeg. Natural voices need an ElevenLabs key. Without one, it uses the built-in macOS voices. v0.3.2. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: FireRedTTS3
projects.description: FireRedTTS3: Multilingual and Multi-Dialect Voice Cloning with Instruction-Guided Voice Design and Speech Editing
projects.summary: 多語言語音克隆，用嚟喺本機用你嘅參考聲克隆。二十四種語言包括粵語，另有二十一款中文方言。權重要另外下載，要 GPU 先順。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免安裝 app。
projects.summary_en: Multilingual voice cloning that clones from a reference clip on your machine. Twenty-four languages include Cantonese, and there are twenty-one Chinese dialects. Weights download separately, and a GPU is the practical path. Apache-2.0. This does not give you an install-free app.

projects.name: AuK
projects.description: AuK: An Open-Source Foundational Model for Speech Generation and Editing
projects.summary: 1.5B 語音基礎模型，用嚟喺你部機做生成同編輯。要 Python 3.10，權重同 Qwen2.5-Omni 編碼器都要另外下載。程式同權重係 MIT。唔係粵語專用模型。唔會畀你免安裝嘅 app。
projects.summary_en: A 1.5B speech foundation model for generation and editing on your machine. It needs Python 3.10. The weights and the Qwen2.5-Omni encoder download separately. The code and weights are MIT. It is not a Cantonese specialist. This does not give you an install-free app.

projects.name: Lody
projects.description: Share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop
projects.summary: 團隊工作台，用嚟喺桌面、手機或網頁調度你已有嘅 coding agent。要登入，機器用 npx 連上。而家仲未做到完全本地。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A team workspace that dispatches coding agents you already have from desktop, phone, or the web. You sign in, and a machine connects with npx. It is not fully local yet. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: open-steps
projects.description: Plain-language agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI: honest session reports, straight verdicts, steps you can follow. MIT.
projects.summary: 一組 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或 Gemini CLI 用白話匯報進度同逐步指示。v0.4.8。MIT。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill pack that makes the coding agent you already use report in plain language and give steps you can follow. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. v0.4.8. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: pullboard
projects.description: Autonomous development for real products. Governed agents build from specs you approve, follow the rules you set, and nothing merges until another agent proves it. Your decisions, judgement and taste are the bar that work must clear. Declare your vision and let agents build it.
projects.summary: 協調板，用嚟喺你個 git repo 派工作畀你已有嘅 agent，另一個 agent 先核實先至合併。用 npx，v0.9.3。MIT。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A board in your git repo that assigns work to agents you already have, and another agent has to verify a change before it merges. You start it with npx. v0.9.3. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: reelmimic
projects.description: Show it a video you love. Get a new video in the same style. An AI crew (Claude Code or Codex) plans, builds and reviews it with you.
projects.summary: 影片風格模仿，用嚟喺你部機跟住參考片做新片。要你已有嘅 Claude Code 或 Codex，另要 Node 22.18 同 Python 3.10。唔包含影片模型。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A style-matching video tool that makes a new video on your machine from a reference clip. It needs Claude Code or Codex that you already have, plus Node 22.18 and Python 3.10. It does not include a video model. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: waku-agent
projects.description: Waku Waku! Waku Agent is a local-first AI agent harness you actually own, including loop, memory, eval, all in code built to stay legible as it grows.
projects.summary: 本機 agent，用嚟喺你部機行 loop、記憶同評測。記憶係一個 SQLite 檔。要你自己嘅模型 key。可開本機儀表板。v0.1.9。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local agent that runs a loop, memory, and evals on your machine. Memory is one SQLite file. You bring your own model key. A local dashboard is optional. v0.1.9. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: pgbot
projects.description: Postgres intelligence for ai agents
projects.summary: 唯讀 Postgres 檢查工具，用嚟喺本機睇 14 至 18 嘅健康報告，agent 可以用 MCP 叫佢。beta，v0.9.0。Apache-2.0。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新 agent。
projects.summary_en: A read-only Postgres checker that prints a health report for versions 14 through 18 on your machine. An agent can call it through MCP. It is beta, v0.9.0. Apache-2.0. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new agent.

projects.name: natural-japanese
projects.description: 仕事の日本語を、読みやすくわかりやすく書く・直すための Agent Skill です。
projects.summary: 一組 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 改工作用日文文件，唔會加原文冇嘅事實。v1.6.4。MIT。呢個係日文，唔係粵語，亦唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill that rewrites workplace Japanese inside the coding agent you already use, and it does not add facts the source did not have. v1.6.4. MIT. This is Japanese, not Cantonese, and it does not give you a new model.

projects.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
projects.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
projects.summary: 短片生成器，用嚟喺你畀嘅主題自動出腳本、配音同成片。要你自己嘅 LLM 同素材 API key，另要 FFmpeg。自己跑。v1.3.9。MIT。唔包含影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A short-video generator that turns a topic you give it into a script, voiceover, and finished clip. You bring your own LLM and media API keys, and it needs FFmpeg. You run it yourself. v1.3.9. MIT. It does not include a video model.

projects.name: VoiceStudio
projects.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
projects.summary: 本機嘅聲音工作室，用嚟喺你部機做克隆同配音。模型要另外下載，macOS 穩定版要 Apple 晶片，CPU 會慢啲。v0.5.7。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A local voice studio for cloning and dubbing on your machine. Models download separately. The stable macOS build needs Apple silicon, and CPU inference is slower. v0.5.7. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: beautify-github-readme
projects.description: README design skill for Claude Code & Codex. 帮你把 GitHub README 做得好看又好懂。
projects.summary: 一組 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Claude Code 或 Codex 設計 repo 嘅 README，令安裝同界限易睇。佢唔包含模型。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill that designs a repository README inside Claude Code or Codex that you already have, so install steps and limits are easier to see. It does not include a model. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: attention-span
projects.description: Make your agents talk human. ADHD-friendly output styles for Claude Code, Codex, and others. So you can pay attention, not tokens.
projects.summary: 一組輸出風格，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Claude Code 改佢點樣同你講，唔改寫程式嘅能力。而家有三款風格。v0.12。AGPL-3.0。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A set of output styles that change how Claude Code talks to you, not how it writes code. There are three styles. You use the Claude account you already have. v0.12. AGPL-3.0. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: PiG
projects.description: PiG (Pi in Go) is a faithful Go port of upstream Pi, the TypeScript codebase behind the Pi coding agent. It is a parity-bound translation, not a rewrite: upstream behavior is the contract, and Go is the implementation language.
projects.summary: Go 寫嘅 Pi coding agent，用嚟喺終端跑你已有嘅模型。安裝好嘅二進制唔使 Node。v0.5.3 未穩定，Windows 係預覽。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A Go port of the Pi coding agent that runs the model you already have in the terminal. The installed binary does not need Node. v0.5.3 is not stable yet, and Windows is a preview. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Real-Time-Voice-Cloning
projects.description: Clone a voice in 5 seconds to generate arbitrary speech in real-time
projects.summary: 即時語音克隆工具箱，用嚟喺幾秒你嘅參考聲合成英文語音。預訓練權重要自己下載，GPU 先順。架構比較舊，唔係粵語模型。程式係 MIT。唔會畀你一個免安裝嘅 app。
projects.summary_en: A real-time voice-cloning toolbox that synthesizes English from a few seconds of reference audio. Pretrained weights download separately, and a GPU is the practical path. The architecture is old, and it is not Cantonese. The code is MIT. This does not give you an install-free app.

projects.name: MockingBird
projects.description: 🚀Clone a voice in 5 seconds to generate arbitrary speech in real-time
projects.summary: 中文語音克隆工具箱，用嚟喺幾秒你嘅參考聲合成普通話。要 Python 3.7 同 GPU，權重另外用。維護者話而家唔再積極更新。MIT。唔係粵語，亦唔會畀你雲端服務。
projects.summary_en: A Chinese voice-cloning toolbox that synthesizes Mandarin from a few seconds of reference audio. It needs Python 3.7 and a GPU, and the weights are separate. The maintainer says this repo is no longer actively updated. MIT. It is not Cantonese, and it does not give you a cloud service.

projects.name: claude-remotion-skill
projects.description: Open-source Claude agent skill that teaches Claude Code, Claude Desktop & Claude AI to create and edit professional motion graphics videos with Remotion. AI video editing, B-roll, captions, sound design — from one prompt.
projects.summary: 一組 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Claude 用 Remotion 寫動態圖形片。出嚟係可重渲嘅程式，唔係像素影片模型。要自己裝 Remotion。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill that makes motion-graphics videos with Remotion inside Claude that you already have. The result is re-renderable code, not a pixel video model. You install Remotion yourself. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: vibe-knowledge
projects.description: Vibe 知识大赏：一个知识点 → 一条有旁白、每句有出处的精品知识短片（Claude Code skill · 44 套风格 · 代码逐帧成片）
projects.summary: Claude Code skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Claude 將一個知識點做成有旁白嘅短片。配音要 MiMo key，另要 FFmpeg。質檢用 macOS Vision。v1.0.0。MIT。唔會畀你影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code skill that turns one fact into a narrated short video inside Claude that you already have. Narration needs a MiMo key, and it also needs FFmpeg. The quality check uses macOS Vision. v1.0.0. MIT. This does not give you a video model.

projects.name: waku
projects.description: ⚡ A native app for all your coding agents.
projects.summary: 原生桌面，用嚟喺一部機睇你已有嘅 coding agent。要先裝並登入至少一個 CLI。macOS、Linux 同 Windows 都有。v0.1.20。GPL-3.0。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A native desktop that shows coding agents you already have on one machine. You install and sign in to at least one agent CLI first. v0.1.20. GPL-3.0. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: autoprompt-skill
projects.description: Autoprompt is a coding-agent skill that cuts failures by 45% on agentic coding tasks.
projects.summary: 一組 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 先審、再改、再核對。改完會再對一次。本身唔係新 agent。v2.1.0。MIT。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill that makes the coding agent you already use review, fix, and check its work again. v2.1.0. MIT. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: ALTA
projects.description: Autonomous LLM Trading Asterism — a research-only multi-agent trading platform with evidence-first research, an auditable console, Shadow simulation and explicitly authorized broker execution.
projects.summary: 研究用嘅多 agent 交易台，用嚟喺本機做查證同 Shadow 模擬。真單要你授權嘅券商 API。唔係投資建議，亦唔包含模型。v0.25.0。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A research trading desk where several agents check evidence and run a Shadow simulation on your machine. A real order needs a broker API you authorize. It is not investment advice, and it does not include a model. v0.25.0. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: ebook2audiobook
projects.description: Generate audiobooks from e-books, 50+ TTS engines with voice cloning and 1696 languages!
projects.summary: 電子書轉有聲書，用嚟喺你部機配章節同聲線。可以克隆聲音，CPU 或 GPU 都行。README 寫 1158 種語言，唔係粵語專用。v26.10.1。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A converter that turns an e-book into an audiobook with chapters and voices on your machine. It can clone a voice, on CPU or GPU. The README says 1,158 languages, and Cantonese is not a dedicated target. v26.10.1. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: pyvideotrans
projects.description: Translate the video from one language to another and embed dubbing & subtitles.
projects.summary: 影片翻譯工具，用嚟喺本機翻譯你嘅影片，再加字幕同配音。可揀本地模型或網上 API，克隆要另外接引擎。要 Python 3.10。v4.17。GPL-3.0。唔會畀你免設定嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A video translator that adds subtitles and dubbing to a video on your machine. You can pick a local model or an online API, and voice cloning needs a separate engine. It needs Python 3.10. v4.17. GPL-3.0. This does not give you a model with nothing to set up.

projects.name: fullstack-agent
projects.description: Give your AI a full stack: memory, voice, face, and hands. This is the "I want an AI agent" shortcut. It sets up the entire jaredrhod stack for you with an installation wizard. Select which pieces you want or do it all!
projects.summary: Claude Code 安裝精靈，用嚟喺你部機組裝記憶、語音同畫面。要你已有嘅 Claude 訂閱。Mac、Linux 同 Windows 都行。可選鏡頭手勢。AGPL-3.0。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code installer that assembles memory, voice, and a face on your machine. It needs the Claude subscription you already have. It runs on Mac, Linux, and Windows. Webcam hands are optional. AGPL-3.0. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: openharness
projects.description: The ultimate harness for coding agents and beyond. All your agents. All your machines. One command center. Start with code, then follow your curiosity and build across disciplines: CAD, circuits, robots, games and music.
projects.summary: 原生桌面，用嚟喺一部畫面睇你已有嘅 coding agent，可以跨幾部機。macOS 同 Linux。中繼只轉送密文。v1.3.56。MIT。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A native desktop that shows coding agents you already have, including agents on other machines. The app is for macOS and Linux. The relay only forwards ciphertext. v1.3.56. MIT. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: agents-universe
projects.description: 不是问答机器人，而是能真正干活的数字分身。共享智能体，共享项目上下文，让项目所有成员一起协同工作。同时智能体会像人一样通过资料或者工作抽象和总结经验到项目上下文中
projects.summary: 自託管嘅企業 agent 平台，用嚟喺 Docker 跑十個現成角色。模型要你自己嘅 API key。本地預設免登入，正式環境要關。Apache-2.0。Python 3.12。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted company agent platform that runs ten ready-made roles in Docker. The model needs an API key you provide. Local setup skips sign-in by default, and a real deployment should turn that off. Apache-2.0. Python 3.12. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: dia
projects.description: A TTS model capable of generating ultra-realistic dialogue in one pass.
projects.summary: 1.6B 對話語音模型，用嚟喺 GPU 由對白稿直接出英語。可以克隆 5 至 10 秒參考聲。權重另外下載，bfloat16 約 4.4GB。Apache-2.0。只係英語，唔係粵語。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A 1.6B dialogue speech model that turns a script into English on a GPU. It can clone a 5 to 10 second reference clip. Weights download separately, and bfloat16 uses about 4.4 GB. Apache-2.0. English only, not Cantonese. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: VideoLingo
projects.description: Netflix-level subtitle cutting, translation, alignment, and even dubbing - one-click fully automated AI video subtitle team | Netflix级字幕切割、翻译、对齐、甚至加上配音，一键全自动视频搬运AI字幕组
projects.summary: 影片字幕組，用嚟喺本機做辨認、翻譯、對齊同配音。要你自己嘅模型 API key，另要 FFmpeg。配音引擎另外接。v3.1.1。Apache-2.0。輸入有中文，唔係粵語專用。唔會畀你影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A video subtitle bench that transcribes, translates, aligns, and dubs on your machine. It needs your own model API key, and it also needs FFmpeg. Dubbing uses a separate engine. v3.1.1. Apache-2.0. Chinese is an input language, and Cantonese is not a dedicated target. This does not give you a video model.

projects.name: whip
projects.description: A fast coding-agent harness in Go. Tool-use loop, bubbletea TUI, provider-routable models with live catalog discovery, MCP support, background subagents. One binary, no runtime, built for open-source models.
projects.summary: Go 寫嘅 coding agent，用嚟喺你部機做長任務。桌面測試版要 Apple Silicon 同 macOS 14。CLI 有 macOS 同 Linux。模型要你自己嘅 key。v1.0.0。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A coding agent written in Go for long tasks on your machine. The desktop beta needs Apple Silicon and macOS 14. The CLI runs on macOS and Linux. The model needs a key you provide. v1.0.0. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: gbro-collage-broll
projects.description: 半调纸拼贴 B-roll 生成 skill：三闸门审批，Gemini Omni Flash 首尾帧组装动画 | Editorial halftone paper-collage B-roll agent skill
projects.summary: 一個 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 agent 將約 5 秒口播變成半調紙拼貼 B-roll。要過三個閘門。影片要 Gemini key，按量收費。預設 9:16、無聲。MIT。唔會畀你影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill that turns about five seconds of voiceover into halftone paper-collage B-roll inside the agent you already use. You approve three gates first. The video needs a Gemini key and is billed by use. The default is 9:16 and silent. MIT. This does not give you a video model.

projects.name: human-review
projects.description: A visual tool to edit HTML and Markdown files, leave comments like a Google Doc, and send feedback to your AI agent. Works inside your favorite AI harness.
projects.summary: 一個 skill，用嚟喺瀏覽器改 HTML 同 Markdown，再一次過將意見交畀你已有嘅 coding agent。全部喺你部機，唔使帳號同 API key。v0.8.2。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill that lets you edit HTML and Markdown in the browser, then send the comments to the coding agent you already use. It stays on your machine, with no account and no API key. v0.8.2. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: OmniVoice
projects.description: High-Quality Voice Cloning TTS for 600+ Languages
projects.summary: 600 幾種語言嘅零樣本語音模型，用嚟喺 GPU 克隆聲線，清單有粵語。權重要另外下載。NVIDIA 或 Intel Arc。v0.2.1。Apache-2.0。唔係單一港式聲線。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A zero-shot speech model for 600-plus languages that clones a voice on a GPU. Cantonese is on the language list. Weights download separately. It runs on NVIDIA or Intel Arc. v0.2.1. Apache-2.0. It is not one fixed Hong Kong voice. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: sherpa-onnx
projects.description: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, speaker diarization, speech enhancement, source separation, and VAD using next-gen Kaldi with onnxruntime without Internet connection. Support embedded systems, Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, Raspberry Pi, RISC-V, RK NPU, Axera NPU, Ascend NPU, x86_64 servers, websocket server/client, support 12 programming languages
projects.summary: 離線語音工具，用嚟喺本機做辨認、合成同靜音偵測。模型要另外下載。部分辨認模型有粵語，唔係每一個都有。Android 到 Linux 都有。v2.0.1。Apache-2.0。唔使上網。唔會畀你預載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: An offline speech toolkit for recognition, synthesis, and voice-activity detection on your machine. Models download separately. Some recognition models include Cantonese, and not every model does. It runs from Android through Linux. v2.0.1. Apache-2.0. It can run without the internet. This does not give you a preloaded model.

projects.name: shisei
projects.description: 💃 Free CC0 mannequin pose reference library for AI image tools (Nano Banana, ChatGPT, ComfyUI, Midjourney) — 250+ poses × 5 angles in line art, names in ja/zh/en/ko
projects.summary: 人偶姿勢參考庫，用嚟喺你已有嘅生圖工具對位。280 個姿勢、五個角度，圖 CC0，程式 Apache-2.0。有成人向系列，預設模糊。v0.4.1。唔係生圖模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A mannequin pose library for lining up a shot in the image tool you already use. It has 280 poses and five angles. The images are CC0 and the code is Apache-2.0. An adult series stays blurred until you open it. v0.4.1. It is not an image model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: carrel
projects.description: Ontology-Augmented Generation for AI agents.
projects.summary: 自託管知識庫，用嚟喺你已有嘅 agent 查文件同圖片。答案由 agent 寫。要 Python 3.12 同 Docker，模型要你自己接。附搜尋 skill。v0.4.0。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted knowledge base that lets the agent you already use look up documents and images. The agent writes the answer. It needs Python 3.12 and Docker, and you connect the models. A search skill is included. v0.4.0. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: okf-agent-memory
projects.description: Git-native persistent memory for AI coding agents. Implements Google OKF v0.2 with sub-300µs in-memory BM25 search, embedded MCP server, and progressive disclosure. Slashes token bloat by 80% with zero external databases or dependencies. Built in pure Go.
projects.summary: Go 寫嘅記憶庫，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 記住專案決定。資料留喺 git，唔使外部資料庫。附 MCP。v0.7.2。MIT。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A memory store written in Go so the coding agent you already use can keep project decisions. The notes stay in git, with no external database. It includes an MCP server. v0.7.2. MIT. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: ACE-Step-1.5
projects.description: The most powerful local music generation model that outperforms almost all commercial alternatives, supporting Mac, AMD, Intel, and CUDA devices.
projects.summary: 本地音樂模型 1.5，用嚟喺你部機由文字同歌詞出音樂。同舊 ACE-Step 係另一個倉庫。權重要另外下載。6GB 顯存可試 2B。v0.1.8。MIT。歌詞有五十幾種語言，唔係粵語專用。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: ACE-Step 1.5 is a local music model that turns text and lyrics into music on your machine. It is a different repository from the older ACE-Step. Weights download separately. A 6 GB GPU can try the 2B model. v0.1.8. MIT. Lyrics cover 50-plus languages, and Cantonese is not a dedicated target. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: Qwen3-TTS
projects.description: Qwen3-TTS is an open-source series of TTS models developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud, supporting stable, expressive, and streaming speech generation, free-form voice design, and vivid voice cloning.
projects.summary: 語音系列，用嚟喺本機做聲線設計同 3 秒克隆。有 0.6B 同 1.7B，權重要另外下載。十種語言有中文同英語，聲線有北京話同四川話，唔係粵語。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A speech series for voice design and a 3-second clone on your machine. It has 0.6B and 1.7B sizes, and the weights download separately. Ten languages include Chinese and English, with Beijing and Sichuan voices, and Cantonese is not one of them. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: Meldwork
projects.description: Local-first AI agent workspace for multi-agent collaboration, agent orchestration, scoped permissions, evidence-aware runs, and human-in-the-loop decisions.
projects.summary: 本地工作台，用嚟喺 Apple Silicon macOS 召集你已有嘅 agent 一齊做。寫入要你授權。預覽包未公證。V1.0.9。Apache-2.0。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local workspace that gathers agents you already have on an Apple silicon Mac. Writes need your permission. The preview build is not notarized. V1.0.9. Apache-2.0. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: fastctx
projects.description: Fast, context-efficient repository tools for AI agents (MCP)
projects.summary: MCP 工具，用嚟喺你已有嘅 agent 跨你自己嘅機執行同記錄。桌面有 Windows、macOS 同 Linux，另有 Android 同 CLI。數據經你嘅 Hub。v0.2.6。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An MCP tool that lets the agent you already use run and record work across your own machines. The desktop app covers Windows, macOS, and Linux, and there is also an Android app and a CLI. Data goes through your Hub. v0.2.6. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: voice-pro
projects.description: Gradio WebUI for creators and developers, featuring key TTS (Edge-TTS, kokoro) and zero-shot Voice Cloning (E2 & F5-TTS, CosyVoice), with Whisper audio processing, YouTube download, Demucs vocal isolation, and multilingual translation.
projects.summary: 本機語音介面，用嚟喺 Windows 配 NVIDIA 跑現成模型，做辨認、翻譯同克隆。Mac 同 Linux 未驗證。權重各自下載，Edge-TTS 要上網。v4.0.0。GPL-3.0。唔係粵語專用。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A local voice interface that runs existing models for recognition, translation, and cloning. The README says Windows with an NVIDIA GPU is the verified setup, and Mac and Linux are not verified. Weights download separately, and Edge-TTS needs the internet. v4.0.0. GPL-3.0. Cantonese is not a dedicated target. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: PaddleSpeech
projects.description: Easy-to-use Speech Toolkit including Self-Supervised Learning model, SOTA/Streaming ASR with punctuation, Streaming TTS with text frontend, Speaker Verification System, End-to-End Speech Translation and Keyword Spotting. Won NAACL2022 Best Demo Award.
projects.summary: Paddle 語音工具箱，用嚟喺本機做辨認、合成同翻譯。有粵語合成例子，唔係成個工具箱都係粵語。模型要另外準備。r1.5.0。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免設定嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A Paddle speech toolkit for recognition, synthesis, and translation on your machine. It includes a Cantonese synthesis example, and the rest of the toolkit is not Cantonese. Models are prepared separately. r1.5.0. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model with nothing to set up.

projects.name: bot-crossing
projects.description: A video game for AI agents. Created by Jarren Rocks
projects.summary: 本機畫面，用嚟喺你部機睇 coding agent 嘅對話線，變成一隻隻機器人。只讀 harness 檔，唔寫返去。要 Node 22.13。MIT。作者話未必再維護。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local view that turns coding-agent threads on your machine into little bots. It only reads harness files and does not write back to them. It needs Node 22.13. MIT. The author says it may not be maintained. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: task-state-guard
projects.description: Reconcile stuck AI-agent tasks after restarts and timeouts. Preview SQLite changes, close stale delivery states, and never guess success.
projects.summary: 嵌入式 SQLite 對賬，用嚟喺重啟之後收斂卡住嘅 agent 任務。未知結果唔會猜成成功。可以先預覽再套用。v0.1.0。Apache-2.0。唔係隊列。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An embedded SQLite check that closes stuck agent tasks after a restart. It does not guess that an unknown result succeeded. You can preview the change before applying it. v0.1.0. Apache-2.0. It is not a queue. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: edge-tts
projects.description: Use Microsoft Edge's online text-to-speech service from Python WITHOUT needing Microsoft Edge
projects.summary: Python 模組，用嚟喺程式叫 Microsoft Edge 嘅網上語音。要上網，唔使裝 Edge。聲線跟微軟清單，唔係粵語模型。v7.3.1。主體 LGPL-3.0。唔會畀你本地模型。
projects.summary_en: A Python module that calls Microsoft Edge's online voices from your program. It needs the internet, and you do not install Edge. Voices follow Microsoft's list, and this is not a Cantonese model. v7.3.1. Most of the code is LGPL-3.0. This does not give you a local model.

projects.name: Amphion
projects.description: Amphion (/æmˈfaɪən/) is a toolkit for Audio, Music, and Speech Generation. Its purpose is to support reproducible research and help junior researchers and engineers get started in the field of audio, music, and speech generation research and development.
projects.summary: 研究用工具箱，用嚟喺本機做語音、唱歌同聲音轉換。程式 MIT。Emilia 數據集係 CC BY-NC，權重要另外準備。v0.1.1-alpha。唔係粵語專用。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
