projects.summary_en: A research toolkit for speech, singing, and voice conversion on your machine. The code is MIT. The Emilia dataset is CC BY-NC, and weights are prepared separately. v0.1.1-alpha. Cantonese is not a dedicated target. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: keypaste
projects.description: A KeePass-compatible password and secrets manager for people who work with AI agents.
projects.summary: KeePass 相容嘅本地密碼庫，用嚟喺你批准之後先畀 agent 一個欄位。已發布嘅係 v0.3.0 CLI，桌面未有公開版本。保險庫唔使帳號。分享連結會經 keypaste.com。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A KeePass-compatible vault on your machine that gives an agent one field only after you allow it. The published piece is the v0.3.0 CLI, and the desktop app has no public release yet. The vault needs no account. Share links go through keypaste.com. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: agenttrail
projects.description: Local observability for AI coding agents. Agenttrail Map shows your project as a live map of what each agent is working on, in the browser or natively in Herdr.
projects.summary: 本機觀察畫面，用嚟喺你部機睇你已有嘅 coding agent 做緊咩。Kitchen 係實驗預覽，要 Node 20。佢唔會行 agent。MIT。唔包含模型。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local view of what the coding agents you already use are doing on your machine. Kitchen is an experimental preview and needs Node 20. It does not run the agents. MIT. It does not include a model. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: paritok-4b-v1
projects.description: Non-destructive compression gateway for AI coding agents. Cuts token bills 25% on turn 1 to past 85% in long or saturated sessions, and fits ~3× more turns in the same context window. Powered by our open-source code-native 4B model. Drop-in for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenHands, and any BASE_URL agent.
projects.summary: 壓縮中間層，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 同模型 API 之間縮短輸入。預設自己跑 4B，約 2.5GB，唔離開你部機。開咗佢哋 GPU 伺服器先會外送。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A compression layer between the coding agent you already use and your model API. By default it runs a 4B model of about 2.5 GB on your machine, and that traffic stays local. Turning on their GPU server sends it out. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: TTS
projects.description: :robot: :speech_balloon: Deep learning for Text to Speech  (Discussion forum: https://discourse.mozilla.org/c/tts)
projects.summary: 舊 Mozilla 文字轉語音庫，用嚟訓練同生成語音。README 寫超過 20 種語言，權重另外準備。最後推送喺 2023 年 11 月。MPL-2.0。同 Coqui TTS 唔係同一個倉庫。唔係粵語專用。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: An older Mozilla text-to-speech library for training and generating speech. The README says more than 20 languages, and the weights are separate. The last push was in November 2023. MPL-2.0. It is a different repository from Coqui TTS. Cantonese is not a dedicated target. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: espnet
projects.description: End-to-End Speech Processing Toolkit
projects.summary: 端到端語音工具箱，用嚟喺 PyTorch 做辨認、合成同翻譯。有現成模型可以下載，訓練要跟 recipe。部分 recipe 提到粵語，唔係一個現成粵語模型。v202611。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免設定嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: An end-to-end speech toolkit for recognition, synthesis, and translation on PyTorch. Pretrained models can be downloaded, and training follows a recipe. Some recipes mention Cantonese, and it is not one ready-made Cantonese model. v202611. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model with nothing to set up.

projects.name: LTX-2
projects.description: Official Python inference and LoRA trainer package for the LTX-2 audio–video generative model.
projects.summary: 官方 LTX-2.5 套件入面嘅 AlphaGen pipeline，用嚟喺一條參考片同 IC-LoRA 做單段影片生成。22B 權重要另外下載。年收入一千萬美元或以上要另買商業授權。授權係 LTX-2.x Community License。唔係 OSI 開源。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: The AlphaGen pipeline inside the official LTX-2.5 package. It generates one stage from a reference video and an IC-LoRA. The 22B weights download separately. A company with annual revenue of 10 million US dollars or more needs a separate commercial license. The license is the LTX-2.x Community License, which is not an OSI open-source license. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: RobustVideoMatting
projects.description: Robust Video Matting in PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorFlow.js, ONNX, CoreML!
projects.summary: 人像影片摳像模型，用嚟喺唔使綠幕嘅片出 alpha。用循環網絡記住時間。README 寫 1080 Ti 上 HD 張量約 104 FPS，轉片腳本會慢啲。有 MobileNetV3 同 ResNet50。v1.0.0。GPL-3.0。唔係通用物件摳像。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A human video-matting model that makes an alpha from a video without a green screen. It uses a recurrent network to remember time. The README says about 104 FPS of HD tensor throughput on a GTX 1080 Ti, and the conversion script is slower. MobileNetV3 and ResNet50 are both available. v1.0.0. GPL-3.0. It is not a general-object matte. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: BackgroundMattingV2
projects.description: Real-Time High-Resolution Background Matting
projects.summary: 高清背景摳像，用嚟喺你預先影低嘅空鏡同人物片出 alpha。要一張背景相，唔係綠幕。作者其後出咗 RVM，呢個係舊方法。README 寫 RTX 2080 Ti 上 HD 張量約 60 FPS，轉片腳本唔係即時。權重要另外下載。v1.0.0。MIT。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: High-resolution background matting that makes an alpha from a person video plus an empty-background photo you captured first. It needs that background photo, and it is not a green screen. The author later released RVM, and this is the older method. The README says about 60 FPS of HD tensor throughput on an RTX 2080 Ti, and the video conversion script is not real-time. Weights download separately. v1.0.0. MIT. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: simplified-technical-english
projects.description: An Agent Skill that makes an LLM write in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Rules, approved word list, and a check tool.
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟叫你已有嘅 LLM 喺技術說明度寫簡化技術英文。檢查腳本只係 Python 3，捉唔到全部錯，亦唔證明符合官方規格。詞表來自 ASD-STE100 2017，版權係 ASD。技能文字同腳本係 MIT。唔係官方文件。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that tells the LLM you already have to write technical text in Simplified Technical English. The checker is Python 3 only. It cannot find every error, and it does not prove that the text meets the official specification. The word list comes from ASD-STE100 Issue 7 (2017), and that list is ASD's property. The skill text and scripts are MIT. It is not an official ASD document. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: deja-vu
projects.description: Claude Code memory, Codex memory, Cursor memory, OpenCode memory, Gemini CLI memory, Windsurf memory & Cline memory across 43 agents. AI coding memory, Claude Code history, Cursor history, local coding agent memory, MCP memory server & Claude compaction.
projects.summary: 本機記憶索引，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 紀錄搵返舊 session。README 列出 43 個 harness。預設冇 LLM，搜尋留喺你部機。語義搜尋先至打去你自己設嘅端點。v0.23.5。MIT。唔會幫你跑 agent，亦唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local memory index that searches session history your coding agents already saved. The README lists 43 harnesses. Search stays on your machine and does not call an LLM by default. Semantic search sends the query to an embedding endpoint you configure. v0.23.5. MIT. It does not run the agents, and it does not give you a new model.

projects.name: kill-ai-slop
projects.description: A field guide to the visual & copy tics of AI-generated products — and an Agent Skill that scans your project and strips them out. https://killaislop.com
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟掃描網頁專案入面常見嘅 AI 畫面同文案習慣，再解釋點解似機器出。網站目錄有 33 項，有英、中、日、韓。掃描器唔會改檔。Apache-2.0。唔係模型。要你已有嘅 agent 先會喺專案度動手改，唔會畀你新介面。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that scans a web project for common AI visual and copy habits and explains why each one reads as machine-made. The site catalogues 33 items in English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. The scanner does not edit files. Apache-2.0. It is not a model. Only the coding agent you already have applies changes, and this does not give you a new interface.

projects.name: so-vits-svc-fork
projects.description: so-vits-svc fork with realtime support, improved interface and more features.
projects.summary: 唱歌變聲分叉，用嚟喺本機即時轉音色。模型跟 so-vits-svc 4.0，4.1 唔支援。安裝會自動下載預訓練權重。最新 tag v4.2.30。授權檔以 MIT 開頭，後面夾住 Apache-2.0。README 仍然寫已經停止維護。唔係文字轉語音。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A singing-voice conversion fork for real-time timbre change on your machine. Models follow so-vits-svc 4.0, and 4.1 models are not supported. Install downloads pretrained weights automatically. The latest tag is v4.2.30. The license file starts with MIT and also includes the Apache-2.0 text. The README still says the project is no longer maintained. It does not turn text into speech, and it does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: EmotiVoice
projects.description: EmotiVoice 😊: a Multi-Voice and Prompt-Controlled TTS Engine
projects.summary: 多音色文字轉語音，用嚟用一句情緒提示讀英文同中文。README 寫超過 2000 個聲。權重喺 ModelScope 另外下載。Docker 要 NVIDIA GPU。日文同韓文仲未做。Apache-2.0。唔係粵語。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A multi-voice text-to-speech engine that reads English and Chinese from an emotion prompt. The README says more than 2000 voices. Weights download separately from ModelScope. The Docker path needs an NVIDIA GPU. Japanese and Korean are still unfinished. Apache-2.0. Cantonese is not included. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: mlx-audio
projects.description: A text-to-speech (TTS), speech-to-text (STT) and speech-to-speech (STS) library built on Apple's MLX framework, providing efficient speech analysis on Apple Silicon.
projects.summary: Apple Silicon 上嘅語音工具箱，用嚟喺本機跑現成嘅文字轉語音、語音轉文字同語音對語音。要 M 系 Mac。模型例如 Kokoro、Qwen3-TTS、Whisper，權重要另外下載。有啲模型有中文，唔係粵語專用。v0.6.4。MIT。唔會畀你一個新模型。
projects.summary_en: An Apple Silicon toolbox that runs existing text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and speech-to-speech models on your Mac. It needs an M-series Mac. Models such as Kokoro, Qwen3-TTS, and Whisper download separately. Some models include Chinese, and Cantonese is not a dedicated target. v0.6.4. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: vits
projects.description: VITS: Conditional Variational Autoencoder with Adversarial Learning for End-to-End Text-to-Speech
projects.summary: VITS 論文嘅官方程式，用嚟由文字端到端生成語音。論文評測用 LJ Speech 單講者英文。另外有 VCTK 多講者訓練路徑。預訓練權重喺 Google Drive。最後推送喺 2023 年 12 月。MIT。唔係現成產品，亦唔係粵語。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: The official code for the VITS paper. It turns text into speech in one stage. The paper's listening test uses the single-speaker English LJ Speech set, and there is also a multi-speaker VCTK training path. Pretrained weights are on Google Drive. The last push was in December 2023. MIT. It is not a finished product, and it is not Cantonese. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: agent-skills
projects.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
projects.summary: 25 個工程 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 跟規格、計劃、寫碼、測試同發佈。npx 可裝入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等。只裝一個 skill 會缺共用 checklist。0.6.15。MIT。唔係模型，亦唔會畀你新 agent。
projects.summary_en: Twenty-five engineering skills for the coding agent you already have. They cover the spec, the plan, the code, the tests, and the release. npx can install them into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and others. Installing one skill leaves out the shared checklists. 0.6.15. MIT. This is not a model, and it does not give you a new agent.

projects.name: taste-skill
projects.description: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 做網站同 app 畫面，而唔係通用落地頁。要 Node 22 同 Chrome、Edge 或 Chromium。搵圖要上網，圖來自公有領域或 CC。一次 30 至 45 分鐘。v2.1.5。MIT。唔使 API key。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that makes the coding agent you already have design websites and app screens instead of a generic landing page. It needs Node 22 and Chrome, Edge, or Chromium. Finding pictures needs the network, and the pictures come from the public domain or Creative Commons. One build takes about 30 to 45 minutes. v2.1.5. MIT. It does not need an API key, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: MeloTTS
projects.description: High-quality multi-lingual text-to-speech library by MyShell.ai. Support English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
projects.summary: 多語文字轉語音庫，用嚟喺本機讀英文、西班牙文、法文、中文、日文同韓文。中文講者可以中英夾雜。README 寫 CPU 都夠即時。權重喺 Hugging Face。有網頁同 CLI。最後推送喺 2024 年 12 月。MIT。唔係粵語。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A multilingual text-to-speech library that reads English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean on your machine. The Chinese speaker can mix Chinese and English. The README says CPU inference is fast enough for real time. Weights are on Hugging Face. It has a web page and a CLI. The last push was in December 2024. MIT. Cantonese is not included. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: rea-video
projects.description: Reverse-engineer any video, shot by shot: filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. 逆向一切视频，逐个镜头看是拍的、AI 生成的还是代码做的，再告诉你怎么复刻。
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺 Claude Code 或 Codex 逐鏡拆一條片，再寫復刻方案。要 ffmpeg 同 Python 3.10。想分得準同反推提示詞，要自己帶一個識睇片嘅模型同 API key。唔配都行。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill for Claude Code or Codex. It splits a video shot by shot and writes a plan to remake it. You need ffmpeg and Python 3.10. A model that can watch video, plus your own API key, makes the split and the prompts more precise. It still runs without that model. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: open-design
projects.description: The 1st Collaborative AI Design Agent Workspace. Local-first and open source. Create motion, prototypes, websites, apps, dashboards, presentations, images, and videos with your team and AI agents. Share work, exchange feedback, and iterate together in one workspace.
projects.summary: 本機設計工作台，用嚟喺你部機同已有嘅 AI agent 一齊做原型、網頁、簡報同片。有 macOS 同 Windows 安裝包，Linux 要自己編譯。模型用你自己嘅 API key。安全遙測開住。v0.27.0。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A local design workspace for making prototypes, pages, decks, and video with the AI agent you already have. Installers exist for macOS and Windows. Linux has to be built from source. Models use your own API key. Scrubbed safety telemetry stays on. v0.27.0. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: impeccable
projects.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
projects.summary: 設計詞彙 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 用指令改畫面同捉 AI 味。CLI 唔使 agent 都可以掃檔。掃網頁要 Chrome 或 Edge。cli-v4.8.0。Apache-2.0。出圖先至可以先生圖再寫碼。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A design-vocabulary skill that lets the coding agent you already have restyle a screen and catch AI-looking UI. The CLI can scan files without an agent. Scanning a web page needs Chrome or Edge. cli-v4.8.0. Apache-2.0. Generating a picture first is only available when your agent can make images. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: espeak-ng
projects.description: eSpeak NG is an open source speech synthesizer that supports more than hundred languages and accents.
projects.summary: 細小嘅文字轉語音，用嚟喺 Linux、Windows、Android 讀一百幾個語言同口音，包括粵語。用共振峰合成，聲線夾喺程式，唔似錄音咁自然。最新發行版 1.52.0。GPL-3.0。唔使下載大模型，亦唔會畀你神經網絡聲線。
projects.summary_en: A small text-to-speech program for Linux, Windows, and Android. It speaks more than a hundred languages and accents, including Cantonese. It uses formant synthesis, the voices ship inside the program, and the speech is less natural than recorded voices. The latest release is 1.52.0. GPL-3.0. It does not need a large downloaded model, and it does not give you a neural voice.

projects.name: argmax-oss-swift
projects.description: On-device Speech AI for Apple Silicon
projects.summary: 本機 Swift SDK，用嚟喺 macOS 14 跑現成嘅 Whisper、Pyannote 同 Qwen-TTS。要 Xcode 16。Android 同即時分講者喺另一個 Pro SDK。v1.1.1。MIT。權重要另外下載。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A local Swift SDK that runs existing Whisper, Pyannote, and Qwen-TTS models on macOS 14. It needs Xcode 16. Android and live speaker labels are in a separate Pro SDK. v1.1.1. MIT. Weights download separately. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: MasterAgent
projects.description: Build AI agents that run 100% on-device. Sub-100ms latency on Qualcomm NPU. Zero cloud dependency.
projects.summary: 本機 C++ agent runtime，用嚟喺你部機先跑固定技能，再按需要叫你自己嘅模型。示範唔使模型、網絡或者車機。Qualcomm NPU 呢版未驗證。開源版係 0.4.0-alpha.3，唔係專有核心。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A local C++ agent runtime. It runs fixed skills on your machine first, then calls a model you already have only when needed. The demo needs no model, network, or vehicle hardware. Qualcomm NPU support is not verified in this release. The open build is 0.4.0-alpha.3, and it is not the proprietary kernel. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: Understand-Anything
projects.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 將程式庫畫成可搜尋嘅知識圖。結構靠 Tree-sitter，解釋靠 agent 嘅模型。睇圖嘅 viewer 只要 Node 18，唔使 API key。最新發行版 v2.9.0。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that turns a codebase into a searchable knowledge graph inside the coding agent you already have. Tree-sitter reads the structure, and the agent's model writes the explanations. The graph viewer needs only Node 18 and no API key. The latest release is v2.9.0. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: abogen
projects.description: Generate audiobooks from EPUBs, PDFs and text with synchronized captions.
projects.summary: 有聲書工具，用嚟喺本機將 EPUB、PDF 同文字讀出聲，並出對齊字幕。用現成嘅 Kokoro-82M。中文係普通話，要另外裝 misaki。Mac 要 espeak-ng。Windows 嘅 AMD GPU 未支援。MIT。唔係粵語。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An audiobook tool that reads EPUBs, PDFs, and text on your machine and writes matching subtitles. It uses the existing Kokoro-82M model. Chinese means Mandarin and needs the extra misaki package. Mac needs espeak-ng. AMD GPUs are not supported on Windows. MIT. Cantonese is not included. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: diagram-design
projects.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 畫 45 種圖，輸出一個 HTML 加 SVG 檔。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等。唔出 Mermaid。MIT。唔會畀你繪圖模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that draws 45 kinds of diagrams inside the coding agent you already have. Each diagram is one HTML file plus SVG. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others. It does not emit Mermaid. MIT. This does not give you a drawing model.

projects.name: dograh
projects.description: Open source voice AI platform. Self-hosted alternative to Vapi and Retell. On Prem, BYOK across  Speech to Speech or LLM/STT/TTS, with a visual workflow builder, MCP native and telephony support.
projects.summary: 語音 agent 平台，用嚟喺你部機用 Docker 自托管打電話同對話流程。預設有佢哋嘅 LLM、TTS、STT，亦可以換你自己嘅 key。電話要接 Twilio 呢類供應商。dograh-v1.51.0。BSD-2-Clause。唔會畀你新語音模型。
projects.summary_en: A voice-agent platform you self-host with Docker on your machine for phone calls and conversation flows. It ships with their LLM, TTS, and STT, and you can switch in your own keys. Phone calls need a provider such as Twilio. dograh-v1.51.0. BSD-2-Clause. This does not give you a new speech model.

projects.name: SmartSub
projects.description: 视频转字幕、字幕翻译、AI 配音与声音克隆、字幕烧录——免费开源的一站式桌面工具。基于 Whisper / FunASR 等本地模型离线语音转文字，批量处理 + 全平台 GPU 加速，跨 Windows / macOS / Linux。Free, open-source desktop app to generate, translate, dub & burn video subtitles — local Whisper speech-to-text, AI dubbing & voice cloning, offline, GPU-accelerated.
projects.summary: 桌面字幕工具，用嚟喺本機轉寫、翻譯、配音同燒字幕。轉寫可以用 Whisper 或 FunASR，檔案唔使上傳。SenseVoice 引擎有粵語選項，唔係成個程式都係粵語。配音用現成嘅模型。v3.12.1。MIT。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A desktop subtitle tool for transcription, translation, dubbing, and burning subtitles on your machine. Transcription can use Whisper or FunASR, and the file does not have to be uploaded. The SenseVoice engine has a Cantonese option, and the whole app is not Cantonese. Dubbing uses existing models. v3.12.1. MIT. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: humanizer
projects.description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 改 AI 腔，內容保持不變。基於維基百科嘅 AI 寫作特徵。README 寫偵測器仍然會標大部分輸出。v3.1.0。MIT。唔係過檢測工具，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that rewrites AI-sounding text inside the coding agent you already have, without changing what it says. It follows Wikipedia's signs of AI writing. The README says detectors still flag most of the output. v3.1.0. MIT. It is not a tool for passing detectors, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: i-have-adhd
projects.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
projects.summary: Agent skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 先講答案，步驟編號，少埋收尾客套。README 寫唔使 ADHD 診斷。v0.4.1。MIT。唔係醫療工具，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that makes the coding agent you already have lead with the answer, number the steps, and drop the closing filler. The README says you do not need an ADHD diagnosis. v0.4.1. MIT. It is not a medical tool, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: YouDub-webui
projects.description: Open-source AI video localization and dubbing for YouTube/Bilibili: speech recognition, subtitle translation, voice cloning, audio mixing and rendering. 开源 AI 视频翻译配音工具。
projects.summary: 影片本地化桌面程式，用嚟喺本機識別、翻譯同逐句克隆原聲，再出字幕同配音片。語言目錄有英、中、日。用現成嘅模型，要另外安裝。v0.0.12。Apache-2.0。唔係粵語。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A desktop app for localizing a video on your machine. It transcribes, translates, and clones the original voice sentence by sentence, then writes subtitles and a dubbed video. The language list is English, Chinese, and Japanese. It uses existing models that you install separately. v0.0.12. Apache-2.0. Cantonese is not included. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Kokoro-FastAPI
projects.description: Dockerized OpenAI-compatible wrapper for Kokoro-82M text-to-speech w/multiplatform CPU, AMD, NVIDIA GPU PyTorch; multi-speaker, clone-tuning, caption timestamps, SSML, websockets, optional readalong web UI
projects.summary: Kokoro-82M 嘅 API 包裝，用嚟喺 Docker 開一個相容 OpenAI 嘅文字轉語音接口。語言有英、西、法、印地、意、日、葡同普通話。NVIDIA 有映像，AMD 係實驗。Apple Silicon 要直接跑，唔係映像。v0.9.2。Apache-2.0。唔係粵語。唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: An API wrapper around Kokoro-82M. It opens an OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech endpoint in Docker. Languages include English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, and Mandarin. NVIDIA has an image, and AMD is experimental. Apple Silicon runs directly and is not a container image. v0.9.2. Apache-2.0. Cantonese is not included. This does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Locals
projects.description: Run many AI agents at once on your Mac, up to 3x faster.
projects.summary: Mac 本機推理伺服器，用嚟喺 Apple Silicon 同時跑你已有嘅 coding agent。預設 Qwen3.5-4B，約 2.8GB，一次只跑一個模型。單一請求同 mlx-lm 差唔多。3 倍只係多請求先至有。0.2.2。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你新 agent。
projects.summary_en: A local inference server for Apple Silicon Macs. It runs the coding agents you already have at the same time. The default model is Qwen3.5-4B, about 2.8 GB, and it runs one model at a time. A single request is about the same speed as mlx-lm. The README's 3x figure is for many requests at once. PyPI 0.2.2. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a new agent.

projects.name: marketingskills
projects.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
projects.summary: 一組 marketing skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 寫轉換、文案、SEO 同分析。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor。v2.14.0。MIT。唔會自己投放廣告，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A set of marketing skills for the coding agent you already have. They cover conversion, copy, SEO, and analytics. Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor are supported. v2.14.0. MIT. It does not place ads by itself, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: LuxTTS
projects.description: A high-quality rapid TTS voice cloning model that reaches speeds of 150x realtime.
projects.summary: 語音克隆模型，用嚟喺本機用一段參考聲讀文字。README 寫單 GPU 可以去到約 150 倍即時，1GB 顯示記憶體都裝到。權重喺 Hugging Face。CPU 同 Mac 都有路徑。Apache-2.0。README 冇列語言。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A voice-cloning model that reads text on your machine from a reference recording. The README says one GPU can reach about 150 times real time, and it fits in 1 GB of video memory. Weights are on Hugging Face. CPU and Mac paths exist. Apache-2.0. The README does not list languages. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: scientific-agent-skills
projects.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
projects.summary: 一組科研 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 查資料庫同寫分析。README 寫 177 個，涵蓋生物、化學、醫學同數據。支援 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等。有啲資料庫要自己申請。v2.72.0。MIT。唔會幫你做實驗，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A pack of scientific skills for the coding agent you already have. The README says 177 skills, covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and data analysis. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other hosts are supported. Some databases need you to apply for access. v2.72.0. MIT. It does not run lab experiments, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: awesome-openclaw-skills
projects.description: The awesome collection of OpenClaw skills. 5,400+ skills filtered and categorized from the official OpenClaw Skills Registry.🦞
projects.summary: OpenClaw 嘅 skill 清單，用嚟喺你部機揀 ClawHub 上面嘅 skill。README 標題寫 5300+，徽章寫 5200，簡介寫 5400+，數字唔一致。清單寫明未逐個審核。MIT。呢個 repo 唔包含 skill 程式，亦唔會幫你跑 OpenClaw，唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A list of OpenClaw skills you pick from ClawHub and use on your own machine. The README title says 5300+, the badge says 5200, and the GitHub description says 5400+, so the counts do not match. The list says the skills are not audited one by one. MIT. This repo does not contain the skill code, it does not run OpenClaw for you, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: DiffSinger
projects.description: DiffSinger: Singing Voice Synthesis via Shallow Diffusion Mechanism (SVS & TTS); AAAI 2022; Official code
projects.summary: 官方 PyTorch 唱歌同 TTS 程式，用嚟喺本機由歌詞或文字出聲。TTS 用 LJSpeech 英文，唱歌用 PopCS 同 OpenCpop。Python 3.8、torch 1.9.0。權重喺 2022 年 release。MIT。PopCS 冇寫語言。唔係廣東話，唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: Official PyTorch code for singing-voice synthesis and text-to-speech. It runs on your machine from lyrics or text. The TTS docs use English LJSpeech, and the singing docs use PopCS and OpenCpop. The README specifies Python 3.8 and torch 1.9.0. Weights are on a 2022 GitHub release and download separately. MIT. The PopCS docs do not name a language. This is not Cantonese, and it does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: fastrtc
projects.description: The python library for real-time communication
projects.summary: Python 即時通訊庫，用嚟喺 WebRTC 或 WebSocket 串流你自己嘅音頻同視像函數。可選 VAD 同 TTS extra。語音例子要你自己嘅 API key。電話功能要 Hugging Face token。0.0.34。MIT。唔包含語音模型，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A Python library that turns your own function into a real-time audio or video stream over WebRTC or WebSockets. Voice-activity detection and text-to-speech are optional extras. The voice examples need your own API key. The phone helper needs a Hugging Face token. 0.0.34. MIT. It does not include a speech model, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: open-code-review
projects.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
projects.summary: 程式碼審查 CLI，用嚟喺你個 git diff 出逐行意見。要 Git 2.41 或以上，同你自己嘅模型端點同 API key。代理模式可以用 agent 自己嘅模型。v1.13.5。Apache-2.0。README 話精度高過一般 agent，但召回率較低。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A code-review CLI that writes line-level comments on your git diff. It needs Git 2.41 or newer, plus your own model endpoint and API key. Delegation mode can use the model of the coding agent you already have. v1.13.5. Apache-2.0. The README says its precision is higher than a general agent, but its recall is lower. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: agentic-awesome-skills
projects.description: 2,955+ reusable AI agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. AAS Core adds local catalog discovery, agent-owned selection and plan preview. CLI, MCP and plugins.
projects.summary: 一組可安裝嘅 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 揀同預覽計劃。README 寫 2923+，GitHub 簡介寫 2884+，數字唔一致。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor。v20.5.0。MIT。AAS Core 唔會幫你排名。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A pack of installable skills for the coding agent you already have. You use them to pick skills and preview a plan. The README says 2923+, while the GitHub description says 2884+, so the counts do not match. Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor are supported. v20.5.0. MIT. AAS Core does not rank skills for you. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: MOSS-TTS-Nano
projects.description: A 100M-parameter multilingual TTS model for real-time CPU inference, voice cloning, and 48 kHz stereo generation
projects.summary: 0.1B 多語言 TTS，用嚟喺 CPU 做即時語音同參考聲克隆，48 kHz 立體聲。README 寫 20 種語言，表列 19 個，有中文同英文，冇廣東話。權重喺 Hugging Face。模型卡同 LICENSE 係 Apache-2.0。README 授權段仲寫未發布。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A 0.1B multilingual text-to-speech model for real-time speech and reference-voice cloning on CPU, with 48 kHz stereo output. The README says 20 languages, but the table lists 19, including Chinese and English, and not Cantonese. Weights are on Hugging Face. The model card and the LICENSE file both say Apache-2.0. The README license section still says the license is unpublished. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: WhisperLive
projects.description: A nearly-live implementation of OpenAI's Whisper.
projects.summary: 近乎即時嘅 Whisper 轉錄伺服器，用嚟喺你部機跑現成模型。支援 faster-whisper、TensorRT 同 OpenVINO。模型要另外下載。v0.10.0。MIT。唔係新模型，亦唔會畀你權重。
projects.summary_en: A nearly live Whisper transcription server that runs an existing model on your machine. It supports faster-whisper, TensorRT, and OpenVINO. The model downloads separately. v0.10.0. MIT. This is not a new model, and it does not give you the weights.

projects.name: reactive-resume
projects.description: A one-of-a-kind resume builder that keeps your privacy in mind. Completely secure, customizable, portable, open-source and free forever. Try it out today!
projects.summary: 履歷編輯器，用嚟喺瀏覽器寫同出 PDF，亦可以自託管。附帶 32 個履歷 skill 同 MCP。選用 AI 要你自己嘅供應商。v6.1.0。MIT。唔係一般 coding agent，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A resume editor for writing and exporting a PDF in the browser. You can also self-host it. It includes 32 resume skills and an MCP server. Optional AI needs a provider you connect yourself. v6.1.0. MIT. This is not a general coding agent, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: agents
projects.description: Plugins, agents, skills, and commands for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi, written once in Markdown and adapted to each tool by generators with validation and evals.
projects.summary: 一組 coding agent 插件，用嚟喺你已有嘅工具裝 skill 同子代理。README 寫 94 個插件、185 個 skill、202 個 agent。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等。兩個外部插件有自己嘅授權。MIT。冇 release。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A pack of coding-agent plugins that installs skills and subagents into the tool you already have. The README says 94 plugins, 185 skills, and 202 agents. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other hosts are supported. Two external plugins have their own licenses. MIT. There is no GitHub release. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: MOSS-TTS
projects.description: An open-source model family for long-form speech, dialogue synthesis, voice design, sound effects, and real-time streaming TTS
projects.summary: 語音模型家族，用嚟喺本機做長文、對話同聲音設計。v1.5 係 8B，README 寫 31 種語言，包括廣東話。TTSD 同 Realtime 跟各自模型卡。權重喺 Hugging Face。llama.cpp 低記憶體模式話 8GB GPU 跑 8B。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A family of speech models for long-form speech, dialogue, and voice design on your machine. v1.5 is 8B. The README says 31 languages, including Cantonese. TTSD and Realtime follow their own model cards. Weights are on Hugging Face. The README says the llama.cpp low-memory mode can run the 8B model on an 8 GB GPU. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: metavoice-src
projects.description: Foundational model for human-like, expressive TTS
projects.summary: 1.2B 英文 TTS，用嚟喺本機克隆美國或英國，要 30 秒參考聲。GPU 至少 12GB，Python 3.10 至 3.12 前，torch 2.2.1。任意長度未完成。權重喺 Hugging Face。Apache-2.0。最後 push 2024-07。唔係廣東話，唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A 1.2B English text-to-speech model that clones American or British voices on your machine from about 30 seconds of reference audio. The README asks for at least 12 GB of GPU memory, Python 3.10 up to but not including 3.12, and torch 2.2.1. Arbitrary-length text is still unfinished. Weights are on Hugging Face. Apache-2.0. The last push was 2024-07. This is not Cantonese, and it does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: oh-my-claudecode
projects.description: Teams-first Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code
projects.summary: Claude Code 嘅多代理編排插件，用嚟喺你已有嘅工作階段開團隊同技能。要你自己嘅登入或 API key。團隊 CLI 可以開 tmux worker。v5.7.30。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent orchestration plugin for the Claude Code session you already have. It opens teams and skills there. It needs your own login or API key. The team CLI can open tmux workers. v5.7.30. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: RealtimeTTS
projects.description: Converts text to speech in realtime
projects.summary: 即時 TTS 程式庫，用嚟喺你部機接現成引擎。推薦 Qwen，第一次會下載模型。亦有系統聲同雲端引擎，雲端要你自己嘅 key。v0.8.10。MIT。唔係新模型，亦唔會畀你權重。
projects.summary_en: A realtime text-to-speech library that connects existing engines on your machine. Qwen is the recommended engine, and the first run downloads its model. System voices and cloud engines are also included. Cloud engines need your own key. v0.8.10. MIT. This is not a new model, and it does not give you the weights.

projects.name: audio.cpp
projects.description: An all-in-one, pure C++ inference engine for audio models, powered by ggml. Supports TTS, STT, VAD, voice conversion, music generation, and more, with highly optimized performance. No Python dependency.
projects.summary: 純 C++ 音頻推理引擎，用嚟喺本機跑現成嘅模型，唔使 Python。README 寫 143 個模型家族。權重另下載，授權跟原模型，有啲唔畀商用。支援 NVIDIA、AMD、Apple 同 CPU。v0.9.4。程式係 Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A pure C++ audio inference engine that runs existing models on your machine, with no Python. The README says 143 model families. Weights download separately and keep the original model license, and some of those licenses do not allow commercial use. NVIDIA, AMD, Apple, and CPU are supported. v0.9.4. The program is Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: agent-plugin
projects.description: AI video editor for agents. ChatCut plugin and MCP server for Codex, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, WorkBuddy, Doubao Work and Qwen Work: edit your own footage by chatting, add captions and subtitles, remove silences and filler words, create motion graphics, and export an editable timeline.
projects.summary: 剪片插件，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 改你自己嘅片段、加字幕同動態圖。要 ChatCut 帳戶。Desktop 係 macOS 13+、Windows 10+，Linux 裝唔到。重做影片要批核 credits。Apache-2.0。冇 release。唔包含剪片程式，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A video-editing plugin for the coding agent you already have. It changes your own footage, adds captions, and adds motion graphics. It needs a ChatCut account. Desktop is only macOS 13 or newer and Windows 10 or newer, so Linux cannot install Desktop. Remaking a video needs credit approval first. Apache-2.0. There is no release. It does not include the editor program, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: SuperMimic-Reproduced
projects.description: Reproduction of SuperMimic (arXiv:2610.28480): learned differentiable world model + BPTT policy for G1 humanoid motion tracking, on mjlab/MuJoCo Warp
projects.summary: 獨立復現嘅世界模型，用嚟喺仿真跟 G1 動作。唔係官方，亦唔係真機。LAFAN1 係 CC BY-NC-ND，資料集冇附帶。檢查點係 e8-boneseed-100k。3.12、torch 2.14.1，喺 RTX 5090 試過。翻跟頭全部失敗。MIT。唔會畀你資料集。
projects.summary_en: An independent reproduction of a world model that tracks G1 motion in simulation. It is not official code, and it is not a real robot. LAFAN1 is CC BY-NC-ND, and the datasets are not included. The checkpoint is e8-boneseed-100k. It uses Python 3.12 and torch 2.14.1, and it was tried on an RTX 5090. Every flip still fails. MIT. This does not give you the datasets.

projects.name: ai-website-cloner-template
projects.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
projects.summary: 一個網站重做 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 將網站做成 Next.js。要 Node.js 24+。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode。v0.6.1。MIT。README 寫明唔可以用嚟釣魚或冒充。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A website-rebuild skill for the coding agent you already have. It turns a site into a Next.js app. It needs Node.js 24 or newer. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode are supported. v0.6.1. MIT. The README says it must not be used for phishing or impersonation. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: CopilotKit
projects.description: The Frontend Stack for Agents & Generative UI. React, Angular, Mobile, Slack, and more.  Makers of the AG-UI Protocol
projects.summary: Agent 前端套件，用嚟喺你已有嘅 agent 加聊天同生成介面。支援 React、Angular、Vue、React Native、Slack、Teams。v1.84.1。MIT。Intelligence 係另外產品。唔包含 agent，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A frontend kit that adds chat and generative UI to the agent you already have. React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack, and Teams are supported. v1.84.1. MIT. CopilotKit Intelligence is a separate product. It does not include the agent, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: TensorFlowTTS
projects.description: :stuck_out_tongue_closed_eyes: TensorFlowTTS: Real-Time State-of-the-art Speech Synthesis for Tensorflow 2 (supported including English, French, Korean, Chinese, German and Easy to adapt for other languages)
projects.summary: TensorFlow 2 嘅 TTS 程式，用嚟喺本機讀中文、韓文、英文、法文同德文。建議 TensorFlow 2.6.0。最後 release 係 2021 v1.8，最後 push 係 2024-07。權重喺 Hugging Face。Apache-2.0。唔係廣東話，唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A TensorFlow 2 text-to-speech program that reads Chinese, Korean, English, French, and German on your machine. It recommends TensorFlow 2.6.0. The last release is v1.8 from 2021, and the last push was 2024-07. Weights are on Hugging Face. Apache-2.0. This is not Cantonese, and it does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: Applio
projects.description: A simple, high-quality voice conversion tool focused on ease of use and performance.
projects.summary: 語音轉換工具，用嚟喺本機改你有權用嘅聲。程式同 repo 入面嘅權重係 MIT，官方未改版仲有使用條款。3.7.1。README 話之後主要做安全修補。Gradio 介面。唔係新嘅基礎模型，亦唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: A voice-conversion tool that changes audio you have the rights to use, on your machine. The program and the weights in this repo are MIT, and the official unmodified build also has terms of use. 3.7.1. The README says later work is mainly security fixes. It has a Gradio interface. This is not a new foundation model, and it does not give you a new model.

projects.name: Vane
projects.description: Vane is an AI-powered answering engine.
projects.summary: 自託管嘅 AI 答題引擎，用嚟喺你部機搜尋並附出處。Docker 會包 SearxNG。模型要用 Ollama 或你自己嘅雲端 key。最新 release v1.12.2，最後 push 係 2026-09。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted AI answering engine that searches on your machine and cites sources. Docker bundles SearxNG. The model comes from Ollama or your own cloud key. The latest release is v1.12.2, and the last push was 2026-09. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: oh-my-pi
projects.description: ⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.
projects.summary: 終端 coding agent，用嚟喺你部機改程式。要你自己嘅模型供應商，README 寫 60 多個。推薦用 Bun。核心有 Rust。v18.16.0。MIT。唔包含模型，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A terminal coding agent that edits code on your machine. It needs your own model provider. The README says more than 60 providers. Bun is recommended, and the core includes Rust. v18.16.0. MIT. It does not include a model, and it does not give you one.

projects.name: riffusion-hobby
projects.description: Stable diffusion for real-time music generation
projects.summary: 即時音樂生成程式，用嚟喺本機由文字出聲。程式係 MIT，權重係 CreativeML OpenRAIL-M，唔係 OSI。Python 3.9 或 3.10。即時要好快嘅 GPU，例子係 3090 或 A10G。CPU 好慢。項目話不再維護。最後 release v0.3.0。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A realtime music program that turns text into sound on your machine. The code is MIT. The weights are CreativeML OpenRAIL-M, which is not OSI, and they download separately. Python 3.9 or 3.10. Realtime needs a fast GPU; the README names a 3090 or A10G. CPU is slow. The project says it is no longer maintained. The last release is v0.3.0. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: heartlib
projects.description: HeartMuLa Official Repo: The Most Powerful Open-Source Music Generation Model of 2026
projects.summary: 音樂生成模型，用嚟喺本機按歌詞同標籤出歌。推薦 3B 同 HeartCodec，7B 未出。權重喺 Hugging Face。單卡要用 lazy load。話幾乎所有語言，冇逐隻列出，亦冇寫明廣東話。程式同權重都係 Apache-2.0。冇 release。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A music model that writes a song on your machine from lyrics and tags. The README recommends the 3B checkpoint and HeartCodec. The 7B version is not released. Weights are on Hugging Face and download separately. A single GPU needs lazy load. The README says almost all languages, but it does not list them and does not name Cantonese. The code and weights are Apache-2.0. There is no release. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: QwenPaw
projects.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
projects.summary: 個人 AI 助理，用嚟喺你部機或雲端聊天。本地模型喺介面下載，唔使 API key；亦可以接 Ollama 或雲端。Python 3.11 到 3.14 之前。最新 release 係 v2.3.0-beta.2，仍然係 beta。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A personal AI assistant that chats on your machine or in the cloud. Local models download in the interface and do not need an API key. It can also use Ollama or a cloud provider. Python 3.11 up to but not including 3.14. The latest release is v2.3.0-beta.2, and it is still a beta. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: book-to-skill
projects.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
projects.summary: 一個 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 把你有權用嘅文件變成技能。支援 PDF、EPUB、DOCX 等。README 話版權書嘅 skill 唔好再公開發佈。v1.4.0。MIT。唔包含書，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill for the coding agent you already have. It turns a document you have the rights to use into a skill. PDF, EPUB, DOCX, and other formats are supported. The README says not to publish a skill made from a copyrighted book. v1.4.0. MIT. It does not include the book, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: TTS-WebUI
projects.description: A single Gradio + React WebUI with extensions for ACE-Step, OmniVoice, Kimi Audio, Piper TTS, GPT-SoVITS, CosyVoice, XTTSv2, DIA, Kokoro, OpenVoice, ParlerTTS, Stable Audio, MMS, StyleTTS2, MAGNet, AudioGen, MusicGen, Tortoise, RVC, Vocos, Demucs, SeamlessM4T, and Bark!
projects.summary: 多模型語音介面，用嚟喺本機跑現成嘅 TTS 同音樂模型。延伸預設唔裝，每個大約 2 到 8GB，授權跟原模型。Python 3.10 或 3.11，唔支援 3.12。底層安裝約 10.7GB。v1.5.2。介面 MIT。唔係新模型，唔會畀你權重。
projects.summary_en: A multi-model voice interface that runs existing text-to-speech and music models on your machine. Extensions are not installed by default. Each one is about 2 to 8 GB, and it keeps the original model license. Python 3.10 or 3.11; 3.12 is not supported. The base install is about 10.7 GB. v1.5.2. The interface is MIT. This is not a new model, and it does not give you the weights.

projects.name: suno-api
projects.description: Use API to call the music generation AI of suno.ai, and easily integrate it into agents like GPTs.
projects.summary: 非官方客戶端，用嚟喺你部機叫 suno.ai 出歌。Suno 本身唔係開源，亦冇官方 API。要你自己嘅帳戶同付費驗證碼服務。程式係 LGPL-3.0。最後 push 係 2026-03。冇 release。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial client that asks suno.ai to make music from your machine. Suno itself is not open source, and it has no official API. You need your own account and a paid captcha service. The program is LGPL-3.0. The last push was 2026-03. There is no release. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: awesome-agent-skills
projects.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and more.
projects.summary: 一個 skill 目錄，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 搵技能連結。GitHub 簡介寫 1000+，徽章寫 1497+，兩個數字唔一致。清單本身係 MIT，每項技能跟原作者授權，有啲上游未必開源。冇 release。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill catalog for finding links to existing skills in the coding agent you already have. The GitHub description says 1000+, and the badge says 1497+, so the two numbers do not match. The list itself is MIT. Each skill keeps its author's license, and some upstream projects may not be open source. There is no release. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
projects.description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
projects.summary: 開源編程助手，用嚟喺你部機讀寫專案同跑指令。模型要你自己揀同付費，有 DeepSeek 嘅預設，但唔係 DeepSeek 官方產品。2.x 最新 release 係 v2.57.0，1.x 係另一條維護線。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An open-source coding assistant that reads and edits a project and runs commands on your machine. You choose and pay for the model. A DeepSeek preset is included, but this is not an official DeepSeek product. The latest 2.x release is v2.57.0, and 1.x is a separate maintenance line. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: musiclm-pytorch
projects.description: Implementation of MusicLM, Google's new SOTA model for music generation using attention networks, in Pytorch
projects.summary: 非官方 PyTorch 重現，用嚟喺研究環境跟論文砌 MusicLM。你要自己訓練，權重同 Google 模型都唔喺度，仲要另裝 audiolm-pytorch。仍有未完成項目。最後 release 0.2.8，push 停喺 2023-09。MIT。唔會畀你練好嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial PyTorch reimplementation for building MusicLM in a research setting. You train it yourself. The weights and Google's model are not included, and it also needs the separate audiolm-pytorch package. Some items are still unfinished. The last release is 0.2.8, and the last push stopped in 2023-09. MIT. This does not give you a trained model.

projects.name: elevenlabs-python
projects.description: The official Python SDK for the ElevenLabs API.
projects.summary: 官方 Python SDK，用嚟喺你嘅程式呼叫 ElevenLabs 雲端語音。服務本身唔開源，要你自己嘅 API key，模型留喺佢哋部機。Python 3.8 或以上。最新 release 係 v2.76.0。SDK 係 MIT。唔會畀你本機模型。
projects.summary_en: The official Python SDK for calling ElevenLabs cloud voices from your program. The service itself is not open source. You need your own API key, and the models stay on their machines. Python 3.8 or newer. The latest release is v2.76.0. The SDK is MIT. This does not give you a local model.

projects.name: muse4ai
projects.description: Muse4AI — let your AI agent make the pictures and the videos. Local Windows bridge for Muse via REST, MCP, and OAuth.
projects.summary: 本機 Windows 橋，用嚟喺你部機把已登入嘅 Muse 交畀 agent。非官方，同 Meta 無關，自動化未必符合條款。只打包 Windows，macOS 同 Linux 未測。Node.js 22+。徽章 v2.0.0-beta.32，冇 release。MIT。唔會畀你 Muse 或模型。
projects.summary_en: A local Windows bridge that hands your signed-in Muse session to a coding agent on your machine. It is unofficial, not affiliated with Meta, and automating it may not fit the service terms. Only Windows is packaged; macOS and Linux are not tested. Node.js 22 or newer. The badge says v2.0.0-beta.32, and there is no release. MIT. This does not give you Muse or a model.

projects.name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
projects.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
projects.summary: 一套 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Claude Code 把對話變成遊戲工作室。徽章寫 49 個 agent、74 個 skill，簡介寫 72 個 skill。要你自己嘅 Claude Code、Python 3 同 Bash。v1.2.0。MIT。唔包含遊戲，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code skill pack that turns one session of the Claude Code you already have into a game-studio workflow. The README badge says 49 agents and 74 skills, while the GitHub description says 72 skills. You need your own Claude Code, Python 3, and Bash. v1.2.0. MIT. It does not include a game, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: VieNeu-TTS
projects.description: Vietnamese TTS with instant voice cloning • On-device • Real-time CPU inference • 48kHz audio quality • Chuyển văn bản thành giọng nói tiếng Việt • Text to speech tiếng Việt • TTS tiếng Việt
projects.summary: 越南語同英文嘅本機 TTS，用嚟喺你部機即時克隆聲音。預設係 v3 Turbo，48 kHz；完整 v3 仍未出。權重喺 Hugging Face，程式同權重都係 Apache-2.0。唔係粵語。最新 release 係 app-v0.18.22。macOS 安裝檔未有。唔會畀你免下載嘅權重。
projects.summary_en: An on-device text-to-speech model for Vietnamese and English that clones a voice on your machine. The default is v3 Turbo at 48 kHz. The full v3 model is not out yet. Weights are on Hugging Face. The code and the weights are Apache-2.0. It is not Cantonese. The latest GitHub release is app-v0.18.22. There is no macOS installer yet. This does not give you the weights without a download.

projects.name: GPA
projects.description: [AutoArk] GPA (General Purpose Audio) can do ASR, TTS and voice conversion with one tiny model!
projects.summary: 一個語音模型，用嚟做語音辨識同文字轉語音。簡介話可以變聲，但 v1.5 嘅變聲路徑仍未做好。約 0.6B，中文同英文，唔係粵語。權重要另喺 Hugging Face 下載，程式同權重都係 Apache-2.0。冇 release，最後 push 係 2026-05。唔會畀你免下載嘅權重。
projects.summary_en: A speech model for speech recognition and text to speech. The description also says it can convert voices, but the v1.5 voice-conversion path is not finished. v1.5 is about 0.6B, in Chinese and English, and it is not Cantonese. Download the weights separately from Hugging Face. The code and the weights are Apache-2.0. There is no release, and the last push was 2026-05. This does not give you the weights without a download.

projects.name: Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
projects.description: 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents · Mapped to 6 frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND, NIST AI RMF & MITRE F3 (Fight Fraud) · agentskills.io standard · Works with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI & 20+ platforms · 29 security domains · Apache 2.0
projects.summary: 一套 skill，用嚟喺你已有嘅 coding agent 做安全工作。唔係 Anthropic 官方。簡介寫 817 個 skill，徽章寫 818。要你自己嘅 agent。v1.3.0，最後 push 係 2026-08。Apache-2.0。README 話只可以測你有權嘅系統。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill pack for security work in the coding agent you already have. It is not an official Anthropic product. The description says 817 skills, and the badge says 818. You need your own agent. v1.3.0, and the last push was 2026-08. Apache-2.0. The README says to test only systems you are allowed to test. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: vall-e
projects.description: An unofficial PyTorch implementation of the audio LM VALL-E
projects.summary: 非官方 PyTorch 重現，用嚟喺研究環境跟論文砌 VALL-E。你要自己訓練，預訓練權重未有。只試過 Python 3.10.7。解碼用 EnCodec，佢係 CC-BY-NC，唔係 OSI。冇 release，最後 push 係 2023-05。程式 MIT。唔會畀你練好嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial PyTorch reimplementation for building VALL-E in a research setting. You train it yourself, and there is no pretrained checkpoint. It was only tested on Python 3.10.7. Decoding uses EnCodec, which is CC-BY-NC and is not OSI. There is no release, and the last push was 2023-05. The code is MIT. This does not give you a trained model.

projects.name: Bark-Voice-Cloning
projects.description: Bark Voice Cloning and Voice Cloning for Chinese Speech
projects.summary: 現成語音克隆介面，用嚟喺本機跑 Bark 同其他已有模型。唔係新模型。Bark 中文較弱，中文克隆另走 Sambert，唔係粵語。權重第一次先下載，各模型授權唔同。Python 3.10 或以上。冇 release，最後 push 係 2026-05。介面 MIT。唔會畀你免下載嘅權重。
projects.summary_en: A voice-cloning interface that runs Bark and other existing models on your machine. It is not a new model. Bark is weak at Chinese, and Chinese cloning uses Sambert instead. It is not Cantonese. Weights download on first run, and each model keeps its own license. Python 3.10 or newer. There is no release, and the last push was 2026-05. The interface is MIT. This does not give you the weights without a download.

projects.name: AionUi
projects.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
projects.summary: 桌面程式，用嚟喺你部機同時用內置 agent 同你已有嘅 CLI agent。模型要你自己嘅 API key，或者接 Ollama。macOS、Windows 同 Linux。最新 release v2.2.2，其後 push 到 2026-11。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A desktop app that uses its built-in agent and the CLI agents you already have, on your machine. The model needs your own API key, or you can connect Ollama. macOS, Windows, and Linux. The latest release is v2.2.2, and there were later pushes through 2026-11. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: pentagi
projects.description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks
projects.summary: 自託管多智能體，用嚟喺你有權測試嘅系統做滲透測試。模型要你自己揀，可以係雲端或者 Ollama。工作喺隔離嘅 Docker 入面。v2.2.0，最後 push 係 2026-10。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted multi-agent system for penetration testing on systems you are allowed to test. You choose the model, which can be a cloud provider or Ollama. The work runs inside an isolated Docker sandbox. v2.2.0, and the last push was 2026-10. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: aeneas
projects.description: aeneas is a Python/C library and a set of tools to automagically synchronize audio and text (aka forced alignment)
projects.summary: 強制對齊工具，用嚟喺錄音同文字之間對時間，唔係語音合成模型。內部預設用 eSpeak，要另裝 FFmpeg。README 確認 38 種語言，名單冇中文同粵語。最新 release 係 2017 年嘅 v1.7.3，最後 push 係 2026-07。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你語音模型。
projects.summary_en: A forced-alignment tool that lines up a recording with text. It is not a speech-synthesis model. It uses eSpeak by default, and you also install FFmpeg. The README confirms 38 languages, and the list does not include Chinese or Cantonese. The latest release is v1.7.3 from 2017, and the last push was 2026-07. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a speech model.

projects.name: whisper-vits-svc
projects.description: Core Engine of Singing Voice Conversion & Singing Voice Clone
projects.summary: 唱歌變聲引擎，用嚟喺本機把歌聲轉做另一個音色。唔係文字轉語音，亦唔支援即時。README 話已經停止升級。權重要另下載。訓練至少 6GB 顯存。最新 release 係 HiFTNet，最後 push 係 2024-04。程式 MIT。唔會畀你免下載嘅權重。
projects.summary_en: A singing-voice conversion engine that turns a sung voice into another timbre on your machine. It does not turn text into speech, and it does not work in real time. The README says it is no longer being upgraded. Weights are a separate download. Training needs at least 6 GB of VRAM. The latest release is HiFTNet, and the last push was 2024-04. The code is MIT. This does not give you the weights without a download.

projects.name: claude-code-templates
projects.description: Open-source registry and CLI for Claude Code components: agents, commands, skills, hooks, MCPs, settings and mods
projects.summary: Claude Code 組件目錄，用嚟喺你已有嘅 Claude Code 裝 skill 同 agent。唔係 Anthropic 官方。README 話大約 1,900 個組件，skill 寫 890+。最新 release 係 v1.29.7，其後仲有 push。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A component catalog and CLI for installing skills and agents into the Claude Code you already have. It is not an official Anthropic product. The README says about 1,900 components, and the skills column says 890+. The latest release is v1.29.7, and there were later pushes. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: cognee
projects.description: Cognee is the open-source AI memory platform for agents. Give your AI agents persistent long-term memory with small models for free
projects.summary: 智能體記憶庫，用嚟喺你部機把文件變成可搜尋嘅知識圖。冇 API key 時用本地小模型，但第一次要下載；生成答案就要另接 LLM。Python 3.10 到 3.14。最新 release 係 v1.6.6，其後 push 到 2026-11。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你免下載嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent memory library that turns documents into a searchable knowledge graph on your machine. With no API key it uses a small local model, but that model downloads on first use. Generating an answer needs a separate LLM. Python 3.10 through 3.14. The latest release is v1.6.6, and there were later pushes through 2026-11. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model without a download.

projects.name: MARS5-TTS
projects.description: MARS5 speech model (TTS) from CAMB.AI
projects.summary: 英文 TTS，用嚟喺本機跟參考聲克隆講稿。開源版只得英文，140 多種語言係閉源產品。程式同權重係 AGPL-3.0，EnCodec 依賴係 CC-BY-NC。Python 3.10 或以上。v0.4，最後 push 係 2024-08。唔係粵語。唔會畀你免下載嘅權重。
projects.summary_en: An English text-to-speech model that clones a reference voice on your machine. The open release is English only. The 140-plus languages belong to the closed product. The code and the weights are AGPL-3.0. The EnCodec dependency is CC-BY-NC. Python 3.10 or newer. v0.4, and the last push was 2024-08. It is not Cantonese. This does not give you the weights without a download.

projects.name: CloakBrowser
projects.description: Stealth Chromium that passes every bot detection test. Drop-in Playwright replacement with source-level fingerprint patches. 50+ tests passed.
projects.summary: Playwright 替代包裝，用嚟喺你部機開一個聲稱可以過偵測嘅 Chromium。包裝程式係 MIT，瀏覽器二進位係 CloakHQ 專有，最新 major 要付費。README 嘅測試結果係宣稱，唔係保證。最新 release 標籤帶 pro。唔係模型。唔會畀你開源瀏覽器本體。
projects.summary_en: A Playwright replacement wrapper that launches a Chromium build the README says can pass bot-detection tests. That result is a claim, not a guarantee. The wrapper is MIT. The browser binary is CloakHQ's proprietary build, and the latest major version requires a paid subscription. The latest release tag includes pro. This is not a model, and it does not give you an open-source browser binary.

projects.name: Jobs_Applier_AI_Agent
projects.description: AI job application bot: automated job search and job hunting, auto-apply to resume-matching jobs while you sleep.
projects.summary: 求職代理，用嚟喺你部機按你已有嘅履歷搵工同交表。要你自己嘅 OrcaRouter key。自動交表未必符合網站條款。最新 release 標籤係 jobs-20261105-080345。MIT。唔包含職位，亦唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A job agent that searches and submits applications on your machine from a resume you already have. You need your own OrcaRouter key. Automatic applications may not fit a site's terms. The latest release tag is jobs-20261105-080345. MIT. It does not include the jobs, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: riffusion-app-hobby
projects.description: Stable diffusion for real-time music generation (web app)
projects.summary: 即時音樂網頁，用嚟喺本機接一個另裝嘅推理伺服器。README 話 GPU 要夠快先至即時，而且已經停止維護。Node.js 18 或以上。冇 release，最後 push 係 2024-07。介面 MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A real-time music web app that connects to an inference server you run separately. The README says the GPU has to be fast enough for real time, and the project is no longer maintained. Node.js 18 or newer. There is no release, and the last push was 2024-07. The interface is MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: cli
projects.description: Google Workspace CLI — one command-line tool for Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat, Admin, and more. Dynamically built from Google Discovery Service. Includes AI agent skills.
projects.summary: Workspace 命令列，用嚟喺你部機叫 Drive、Gmail 同日曆。要你自己嘅 Google 帳戶。開頭寫 40+ skill，技能一節寫 100+。最新 release v0.22.5（2026-03），其後 push 到 2026-11。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: The Workspace command line that calls Drive, Gmail, and Calendar on your machine. You need your own Google account. The opening says 40+ skills, and the skills section says 100+. The latest release is v0.22.5 from 2026-03, and there were later pushes through 2026-11. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: 9router
projects.description: Unlimited FREE AI coding. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Copilot, Antigravity to FREE Claude/GPT/Gemini via 40+ providers. Auto-fallback, RTK -40% tokens, never hit limits.
projects.summary: 本機路由，用嚟喺你部機把已有嘅 coding agent 接到其他模型供應商。README 話可以慳 token 同無限用，但係宣稱；各供應商有自己限額同條款。最新 GitHub release 係 v0.5.35，package.json 寫 0.5.112。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A local router that connects a coding agent you already have to other model providers on your machine. The README says it can save tokens and be used without limits, but that is a claim. Each provider keeps its own quota and terms. The latest GitHub release is v0.5.35, and package.json says 0.5.112. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: gTTS
projects.description: Python library and CLI tool to interface with Google Translate's text-to-speech API
projects.summary: 非官方客戶端，用嚟喺你嘅程式叫 Google Translate 出語音。唔係 Google Cloud TTS，亦唔係本機模型。同 Google 無關，上游可以無通知改。Python 3.7 或以上。最新 release 係 v2.5.4，最後 push 係 2026-04。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial client that asks Google Translate to speak from your program. It is not Google Cloud text-to-speech, and it is not a local model. It is not affiliated with Google, and the upstream service can change without notice. Python 3.7 or newer. The latest release is v2.5.4, and the last push was 2026-04. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: cua
projects.description: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
projects.summary: 電腦操作工具，用嚟喺你部機畀已有嘅 agent 用沙盒同桌面。SDK、Driver 同 Lume 係 MIT。Spaces 同 Driver Bench 係 FSL-1.1，唔係 OSI，兩年後先變 MIT，唔可以做競爭託管。唔會畀你通用模型。最新 release v0.12.1（2026-11）。
projects.summary_en: A computer-use tool that lets an agent you already have use sandboxes and desktops on your machine. The SDK, Driver, and Lume are MIT. Spaces and Driver Bench are FSL-1.1, which is not an OSI license. They become MIT after two years, and you cannot offer them as a competing hosted service. This does not give you a general model. The latest release is v0.12.1 from 2026-11.

projects.name: nanoclaw
projects.description: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw that runs in containers for security. Connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail and other messaging apps,, has memory, scheduled jobs, and runs directly on Anthropic's Agents SDK
projects.summary: 訊息助手，用嚟喺容器跑你已有嘅 agent，再接 Telegram 等頻道。預設 Anthropic 嘅 Claude，要你自己嘅帳戶。頻道用 skill 加，產品係助手。要 Docker，Node 22.23 或以上。最新 release v2026.10.1-rc.2。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A messaging assistant that runs an agent you already have inside a container, then connects channels such as Telegram. It defaults to Anthropic's Claude, and you need your own account. Channels are added with skills, and the product is the assistant. It needs Docker and Node 22.23 or newer. The latest release is v2026.10.1-rc.2. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: marytts
projects.description: MARY TTS -- an open-source, multilingual text-to-speech synthesis system written in pure java
projects.summary: Java 嘅文字轉語音，用嚟喺你部機開伺服器出聲。語言模組有英、德、法、意、俄等，冇廣東話。例子聲線係美式英文，其他聲線要另外下載。最新 release 係 v5.2.1（2022），主線係 5.3-SNAPSHOT，最後 push 係 2025-01。LGPL-3.0。唔係雲端，唔會畀你新模型。
projects.summary_en: Java text-to-speech that starts a server on your machine. Language modules include English, German, French, Italian, Russian, and others, and there is no Cantonese. The example voice is American English, and other voices are downloaded separately. The latest release is v5.2.1 from 2022, the main line is 5.3-SNAPSHOT, and the last push was 2025-01. LGPL-3.0. This is not a cloud service, and it does not give you a new model.

projects.name: sand3d
projects.description: 3D modeling in Python, built for LLMs.
projects.summary: Python 程式庫，用嚟喺 Blender 嘅 bpy 寫程式砌 3D。畀你已有嘅 LLM 用。Python 只係 3.11 或 3.13，bpy 係 4.5 或 5.2。README 話慳 token 係宣稱。最新 release v1.6.2。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for writing programs that build 3D on Blender's bpy. It is for an LLM you already have. Python is only 3.11 or 3.13, and bpy is 4.5 or 5.2. The README's claim that it saves tokens is a claim. The latest release is v1.6.2. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: composio
projects.description: Composio powers 1000+ toolkits, tool search, context management, authentication, and a sandboxed workbench to help you build AI agents that turn intent into action.
projects.summary: SDK，用嚟畀你已有嘅 agent 接應用工具。README 話 1000+ 工具，係宣稱。要你自己嘅 API key，工具喺佢哋雲端。Node 22 或以上，Python 3.11 或以上。最新 release 係 CLI beta 0.6.1-beta.534。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An SDK that connects an agent you already have to app tools. The README says 1000+ tools, and that is a claim. You need your own API key, and the tools run on their cloud. Node 22 or newer, and Python 3.11 or newer. The latest release is CLI beta 0.6.1-beta.534. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: OpenCLI
projects.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
projects.summary: 命令列，用嚟喺你已登入嘅 Chrome 畀 agent 操作網站。要你自己嘅帳戶，網站條款仍然適用。附帶 skill，但產品係 CLI。npm 要 Node 20.18 或以上。最新 release v2.0.2（2026-10），其後有 push。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A command line that lets an agent operate websites in Chrome where you are already signed in. You need your own account, and each site's terms still apply. It includes skills, and the product is the CLI. npm needs Node 20.18 or newer. The latest release is v2.0.2 from 2026-10, and there were later pushes. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: pyttsx3
projects.description: Offline Text To Speech synthesis for python
projects.summary: 離線 Python 庫，用嚟喺你部機叫已有嘅系統語音。Windows 用 SAPI5，macOS 用系統聲，Linux 要 eSpeak。AVSpeech 仍然係實驗。冇廣東話保證。最新 release v2.99（2025-07），最後 push 係 2026-10。MPL-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An offline Python library that calls the system voices already on your machine. Windows uses SAPI5, macOS uses the system voice, and Linux needs eSpeak. AVSpeech is still experimental. Cantonese is not guaranteed. The latest release is v2.99 from 2025-07, and the last push was 2026-10. MPL-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: claude-code-video-toolkit
projects.description: Make videos with Claude Code: script, AI voiceover, music, video clips and render, on open-source models that cost cents
projects.summary: Claude Code 嘅影片技能包，用嚟喺你部機寫稿、配音同出片。要你已有嘅 Claude Code，同 Node 22 或以上。聲線同影片模型要你自己部署，README 嘅價錢係宣稱。最新 release v0.25.0（2026-11）。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code skill pack for writing a script, adding a voice, and rendering a video on your machine. You need Claude Code you already have, and Node 22 or newer. Voice and video models have to be deployed by you, and the README prices are claims. The latest release is v0.25.0 from 2026-11. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: TencentDB-Agent-Memory
projects.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
projects.summary: 團隊記憶伺服器，用嚟喺你部機把對話、文件同程式變成可重用記憶。要你自己嘅 LLM，Node 要 22.16 或以上。會抽出 skill，但產品係記憶服務。MongoDB 後端係實驗。最新 release v2.0.3（2026-10），其後有 push。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A team memory server that turns conversations, documents, and code into reusable memory on your machine. You need your own LLM, and Node 22.16 or newer. It can extract skills, and the product is the memory service. The MongoDB backend is experimental. The latest release is v2.0.3 from 2026-10, and there were later pushes. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: infisical
projects.description: Infisical is the open-source platform for securing secrets, certificates, access, and AI Agents.
projects.summary: 秘密同憑證平台，用嚟喺你部機管匙、證書同 agent 權限，亦可以用佢哋雲端。ee 目錄嘅企業功能要另外授權。最新 release v0.167.6（2026-11），其後有 push。主體係 MIT。唔係 agent，唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A secrets and certificate platform for keys, certificates, and agent access on your machine, or on their cloud. Enterprise features in the ee directories need a separate license. The latest release is v0.167.6 from 2026-11, and there were later pushes. The main license is MIT. This is not an agent, and it does not give you a model.

projects.name: mlx-serve
projects.description: Native LLM inference server for Apple Silicon. OpenAI + Anthropic API compatible. No Python. Zig backend, Swift frontend macOS app with chat, music, voice, video generation.
projects.summary: 本機模型伺服器，用嚟喺 Apple Silicon 跑你下載嘅模型，亦有 Linux NVIDIA 版。Mac app 要 macOS 26.2。聊天、圖、片、音樂同語音都係功能。最新 release v26.11.2。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A local model server that runs models you download on Apple Silicon, with a Linux build for NVIDIA. The Mac app needs macOS 26.2. Chat, images, video, music, and speech are all features. The latest release is v26.11.2. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: hifi-gan
projects.description: HiFi-GAN: Generative Adversarial Networks for Efficient and High Fidelity Speech Synthesis
projects.summary: 聲碼器，用嚟喺你嘅電腦把 mel 頻譜變成波形，唔係完整 TTS。預訓練權重係英文 LJSpeech、VCTK 同通用模型，要另外下載，冇廣東話。冇 GitHub release，最後 push 係 2024-07。程式 MIT。唔會畀你現成聲。
projects.summary_en: A vocoder that turns a mel spectrogram into a waveform on your computer. It is not a complete text-to-speech system. The pretrained weights are English LJSpeech, VCTK, and a universal model, downloaded separately, and there is no Cantonese. There is no GitHub release, and the last push was 2024-07. The code is MIT. This does not give you a ready voice.

projects.name: trompe
projects.description: Texture a whole game level from a gray blockout with image models: plan cameras, paint, project, bake. Real shadows, glTF out.
projects.summary: 瀏覽器工具，用嚟喺灰模關卡上面投影貼圖，再匯出 glTF。規劃同烘焙喺你部機嘅 GPU，圖像模型喺 fal，要你自己嘅 key。適合寫實建築，唔適合風格化，亦唔係第一身腳下地面。關卡要自備 UV。未有本機模型。冇 GitHub release。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A browser tool that projects textures onto a gray level and exports glTF. Planning and baking run on your machine's GPU. The image models run on fal, and you need your own key. It suits realistic buildings, not a stylized look, and not the ground at a first-person player's feet. The level must already have UVs. There is no local model yet, and there is no GitHub release. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: ABot-Recon
projects.description: Streaming 3D reconstruction from only video input: Revisiting Local Context for Long-Horizon Streaming 3D Reconstruction
projects.summary: 串流三維重建，用嚟喺你嘅影片幀估點雲同相對姿態。只用最近 12 幀，唔靠長程記憶。要 Linux、Python 3.10 或以上同 CUDA 12.1。權重 CC BY-NC，唔可以商用，要另外下載。程式 Apache-2.0。冇 GitHub release。唔會畀你商用授權。
projects.summary_en: Streaming 3D reconstruction that estimates a point cloud and a relative pose for frames of your video. It uses only the latest 12 frames and does not keep long-range memory. It needs Linux, Python 3.10 or newer, and CUDA 12.1. The weights are CC BY-NC, not for commercial use, and must be downloaded separately. The code is Apache-2.0. There is no GitHub release. This does not give you a commercial license.
projects.paper_title: Revisiting Local Context for Long-Horizon Streaming 3D Reconstruction

projects.name: pinky
projects.description: Let AI agents use your phone, with you in the loop.
projects.summary: 手機閘道，用嚟喺你部機畀已有嘅 agent 操作 iPhone 或 Android，高風險步驟要你批准。pre-alpha。要你自己嘅手機同 agent。最新 release v2026.1109.17。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A phone gateway that lets an agent you already have operate an iPhone or Android from your machine. Risky steps wait for your approval. It is pre-alpha. You need your own phone and agent. The latest release is v2026.1109.17. Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: cinecode
projects.description: Films made with code. Short films, long YouTube videos, ads, explainers and music videos: an AI coding agent writes the script, builds every frame in code, designs the sound and hands you an MP4.
projects.summary: 影片 skill，用嚟叫 Claude Code 或 Cursor 喺你部機用程式砌片。要 Node 22、Python 3.9、ffmpeg 同 Chrome。Windows 全程出片未試過。外來配音要你自己嘅 key。冇 GitHub release。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A video skill that asks Claude Code or Cursor to build a film in code on your machine. It needs Node 22, Python 3.9, ffmpeg, and Chrome. A full film has not been tested end to end on Windows. Extra narration needs your own key. There is no GitHub release. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: agent_skills
projects.description: Agent skills
projects.summary: Jane Street 嘅 skill 包，而家只有 socratic-tutor，用嚟喺你部機叫已有嘅 agent 一問一答教學。要你自己嘅模型。冇 GitHub release。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A Jane Street skill pack. It currently has only socratic-tutor, which asks an agent you already have to teach with one question at a time on your machine. You need your own model. There is no GitHub release. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: OpenAmika
projects.description: OpenAmika: MekaHime's AI companion Amika, open source. Live2D avatar, real-time voice, long-term memory, OpenRouter or Ollama brain.
projects.summary: Live2D 同伴，用嚟喺 Windows 同你傾計同記住你。程式 MIT。聲線同 Live2D 係個人使用授權，唔係 OSI。要你自己嘅 OpenRouter key 或 Ollama。Linux 未測。Python 3.11。最新 release v1.0.0，其後有push。唔會畀你語言模型。
projects.summary_en: A Live2D companion that talks with you and remembers you on Windows. The code is MIT. The voice and Live2D model are under a personal-use license, which is not OSI. You need your own OpenRouter key or Ollama. Linux is untested. Python 3.11. The latest release is v1.0.0, and there were later pushes. This does not give you a language model.

projects.name: video-director
projects.description: A Claude skill for directing, building and verifying code-rendered videos (HTML/Canvas → MP4): principles, gated workflow, QA scripts and evals.
projects.summary: Claude Code skill，用嚟喺你嘅電腦用程式砌短片再檢查。README 推薦 Opus 5.5，其他 agent 都可以跟。要 ffmpeg 同 Python。冇 GitHub release。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code skill that builds a short film in code on your computer and then checks it. The README recommends Opus 5.5, and other agents can follow it too. It needs ffmpeg and Python. There is no GitHub release. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: procraft
projects.description: An open-source painting app for Android tablets, Windows and Linux: pressure-sensitive brushes, layers, adjustments, animation and 3D painting on its own Rust engine and GPU renderer.
projects.summary: 畫圖軟件，用嚟喺你嘅 Android 平板、Windows 同 Linux 畫畫，有壓感筆、圖層同三維上色。beta。要 Android 10 或以上。最新 release v0.0.5-beta。MIT 或 Apache-2.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A painting app for drawing on your Android tablet, Windows, and Linux, with pressure brushes, layers, and 3D painting. It is in beta. It needs Android 10 or newer. The latest release is v0.0.5-beta. MIT or Apache-2.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: voxcpm2-turkce-ses-tasarimi
projects.description: Turkish voice design with VoxCPM2 on a 4 GB GPU: describe a voice, pick a variant, read text in 30 languages. Patched audio.cpp, local UI in 30 languages, 14 ready-made voices.
projects.summary: 本機聲線設計，用嚟喺 NVIDIA 顯卡描述把聲再朗讀。現成聲有土耳其話同普通話，冇廣東話。4GB 係 GTX 1050 Ti 嘅測試。程式同權重 README 話係 Apache-2.0。最新 release v0.3.2。唔會畀你廣東話聲。
projects.summary_en: Local voice design that describes a voice and reads it on an NVIDIA card. Ready-made voices include Turkish and Mandarin, and there is no Cantonese. The 4 GB figure is a test on a GTX 1050 Ti. The README says the code and weights are Apache-2.0. The latest release is v0.3.2. This does not give you a Cantonese voice.

projects.name: huashu-art-motion
projects.description: 艺术动画skill：35种艺术风格、9种解说语法，用代码让画动起来。
projects.summary: 藝術動畫 skill，用嚟叫已有嘅 coding agent 喺你部機用程式畫會郁嘅畫。要 uv、ffmpeg 同 Playwright Chromium。說明係中文。角色圖只供示範，唔隨 MIT。最新 release v1.2.0。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: An art-animation skill that asks a coding agent you already have to draw moving pictures in code on your machine. It needs uv, ffmpeg, and Playwright Chromium. The instructions are in Chinese. The character art is for demos only and is not under MIT. The latest release is v1.2.0. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: ff-ruyijs
projects.description: This is a lightweight, headless browser purpose-built for AI agents (such as Codex or Claude Code) to perform browser automation tasks; it is designed to navigate through various web protection systems, login processes, and reverse-engineering scenarios
projects.summary: 無頭 Firefox 引擎，用嚟喺你部機畀已有嘅 agent 跑網站 JavaScript。要 Python 3.10。閉源使用要另外買商業授權。最新 release v0.3.6。AGPL-3.0。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A headless Firefox engine that lets an agent you already have run a site's JavaScript on your machine. It needs Python 3.10. Closed-source use needs a separate commercial license. The latest release is v0.3.6. AGPL-3.0. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: BUI
projects.description: Blender's GPU Accelerated UI, Decoupled from it's original codebase. Supports Rust, Python, JS, Lua, C & C++. Twice as good as GPUI
projects.summary: Blender 介面庫，用嚟喺你嘅程式畫 Blender 風格介面，唔包括 Blender 本體。冇無障礙支援。macOS 只得 CPU 繪圖。最新 release v0.5.0。GPL-3.0-or-later。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A Blender interface library for drawing a Blender-style interface inside your own program. It does not include Blender itself. It has no accessibility support. On macOS it draws on the CPU only. The latest release is v0.5.0. GPL-3.0-or-later. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: shrimpreel
projects.description: Open-source template for "one photo → AI video that follows a viral template" SaaS sites, one site per trending keyword. Cloudflare Workers + D1/R2/KV/Queues, TanStack Start + Hono, Google sign-in, credit packs (Waffo/Dodo), fal.ai video generation, admin console.
projects.summary: 付費影片網站模板，用嚟喺 Cloudflare 賣一張相變影片。影片要你自己嘅 fal.ai 或其他供應商，要 Google 登入同付款商。本地可以用 mock。冇 GitHub release。MIT。唔會畀你影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A paid video-site template for selling a one-photo-to-video service on Cloudflare. Video needs your own fal.ai account or another provider, plus Google sign-in and a payment provider. Local development can use mock. There is no GitHub release. MIT. This does not give you a video model.

projects.name: mojo-dllm
projects.description: Local inference for diffusion language models (LLaDA, Dream), written in Mojo
projects.summary: 擴散語言模型本機推理，用嚟喺 Linux x86-64 跑 LLaDA 同 Dream。要 Mojo 1.1、AVX2 同大約 6GB 記憶體。GPU 只係一部 RTX 3050 筆電嘅測試。權重要你自己下載。最新 release v0.1.0，其後有push。Apache-2.0。唔會畀你權重。
projects.summary_en: Local inference for diffusion language models, for running LLaDA and Dream on Linux x86-64. It needs Mojo 1.1, AVX2, and about 6 GB of memory. The GPU path was tried on one RTX 3050 laptop. You download the weights yourself. The latest release is v0.1.0, and there were later pushes. Apache-2.0. This does not give you the weights.

projects.name: B
projects.description: An autonomous, context-aware AI desktop companion. Built with Python, featuring real-time screen vision, custom ONNX voice synthesis, active window tracking, and a dynamic floating UI with reactive facial expressions.
projects.summary: 桌面同伴，用嚟喺你自己部 Windows 睇你個畫面同傾計。Linux 同 macOS 只係實驗。語言模型要 Groq 或你自己嘅 llama.cpp。最後 push 2026-07-07。冇 GitHub release。Python 3.10+。MIT。唔會畀你模型。
projects.summary_en: A desktop companion that watches your own screen and talks with you on your Windows machine. Linux and macOS are experimental. The language model needs Groq or your own llama.cpp model. The last push was 2026-07-07. There is no GitHub release. Python 3.10+. MIT. This does not give you a model.

projects.name: mcp
projects.description: Connect AI agents to real iPhones and Androids
